import calendar
from datetime import date, datetime
from django.db.models import Q

from apps.attendance.models import ClassAttendance, DailyAttendance
from apps.school.models import GradeLevel, SchoolHoliday, SchoolYear, Section
from apps.school.selectors import get_school_metadata
from apps.students.models import Enrollment
from common.exceptions import AppError
from .sf2 import resolve_month


def make_triplet(m=0, f=0) -> dict:
    total = m + f
    return {
        "m": round(m, 1) if isinstance(m, float) else int(m),
        "f": round(f, 1) if isinstance(f, float) else int(f),
        "total": round(total, 1) if isinstance(total, float) else int(total),
    }


def add_triplets(t1: dict, t2: dict) -> dict:
    return make_triplet(t1["m"] + t2["m"], t1["f"] + t2["f"])


def compute_attendance_pct(ada: dict, reg: dict) -> dict:
    return {
        "m": round((ada["m"] / reg["m"]) * 100, 1) if reg["m"] > 0 else 0.0,
        "f": round((ada["f"] / reg["f"]) * 100, 1) if reg["f"] > 0 else 0.0,
        "total": round((ada["total"] / reg["total"]) * 100, 1) if reg["total"] > 0 else 0.0,
    }


def empty_summary_row(section_id: str, section_name: str, grade_level: str) -> dict:
    zero = make_triplet(0, 0)
    return {
        "section_id": section_id,
        "section_name": section_name,
        "grade_level": grade_level,
        "adviser_name": "",
        "registered_end": dict(zero),
        "daily_average": make_triplet(0.0, 0.0),
        "attendance_percentage": {"m": 0.0, "f": 0.0, "total": 0.0},
        "dropped_out_prev": dict(zero),
        "dropped_out_month": dict(zero),
        "dropped_out_cumulative": dict(zero),
        "transferred_out_prev": dict(zero),
        "transferred_out_month": dict(zero),
        "transferred_out_cumulative": dict(zero),
        "transferred_in_prev": dict(zero),
        "transferred_in_month": dict(zero),
        "transferred_in_cumulative": dict(zero),
    }


SUMMABLE_KEYS = (
    "registered_end",
    "daily_average",
    "dropped_out_prev",
    "dropped_out_month",
    "dropped_out_cumulative",
    "transferred_out_prev",
    "transferred_out_month",
    "transferred_out_cumulative",
    "transferred_in_prev",
    "transferred_in_month",
    "transferred_in_cumulative",
)


def generate_sf4_report(*, month_name: str = "October", year: int = 2026, school_year: str = "", request=None) -> dict:
    month_num, clean_month = resolve_month(month_name)
    year = int(year)
    if not (1900 <= year <= 2100):
        raise AppError("INVALID_YEAR", "Year must be between 1900 and 2100.", 400)
    _, num_days = calendar.monthrange(year, month_num)
    start_dt, end_dt = date(year, month_num, 1), date(year, month_num, num_days)

    holiday_dates = set(
        SchoolHoliday.objects.filter(holiday_date__range=(start_dt, end_dt)).values_list("holiday_date", flat=True)
    )
    school_days = [
        date(year, month_num, d)
        for d in range(1, num_days + 1)
        if date(year, month_num, d).weekday() < 5 and date(year, month_num, d) not in holiday_dates
    ]
    n_days = len(school_days) or 1

    target_sy = None
    if school_year:
        sy_clean = str(school_year).strip()
        target_sy = (
            SchoolYear.objects.filter(id=int(sy_clean)).first()
            if sy_clean.isdigit()
            else SchoolYear.objects.filter(code__iexact=sy_clean).first()
        )
    if target_sy is None:
        target_sy = SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first() or SchoolYear.objects.first()

    sections_qs = Section.objects.select_related("grade_level", "school_year", "adviser").filter(is_active=True)
    if target_sy:
        sections_qs = sections_qs.filter(Q(school_year=target_sy) | Q(school_year__isnull=True))
    sections = list(sections_qs.order_by("grade_level__level_order", "name"))

    enr_qs = Enrollment.objects.filter(section__in=sections, student__is_active=True).select_related("student")
    if target_sy:
        enr_qs = enr_qs.filter(Q(school_year=target_sy) | Q(school_year__isnull=True))

    enr_by_sec: dict[int, list] = {}
    all_student_ids = set()
    for enr in enr_qs:
        enr_by_sec.setdefault(enr.section_id, []).append(enr)
        all_student_ids.add(enr.student_id)

    present_codes = ["PRESENT", "LATE", "CUTTING", "EXCUSED"]
    present_pairs = set()
    if all_student_ids:
        present_pairs.update(
            DailyAttendance.objects.filter(
                section__in=sections,
                student_id__in=all_student_ids,
                attendance_date__range=(start_dt, end_dt),
                status__in=present_codes,
            ).values_list("student_id", "attendance_date")
        )
        present_pairs.update(
            ClassAttendance.objects.filter(
                class_period__section__in=sections,
                student_id__in=all_student_ids,
                attendance_date__range=(start_dt, end_dt),
                status__in=present_codes,
            ).values_list("student_id", "attendance_date")
        )

    grade_names = list(GradeLevel.objects.order_by("level_order").values_list("name", flat=True))
    groups_map: dict[str, list] = {g: [] for g in grade_names if g}

    for sec in sections:
        g_label = (sec.grade_level.name if sec.grade_level else "NON-GRADED").strip() or "NON-GRADED"
        adviser_label = (sec.adviser.full_name if sec.adviser else "Unassigned").upper()

        reg_m = reg_f = att_m = att_f = 0
        drop_prev_m = drop_prev_f = drop_mo_m = drop_mo_f = 0
        tout_prev_m = tout_prev_f = tout_mo_m = tout_mo_f = 0
        tin_prev_m = tin_prev_f = tin_mo_m = tin_mo_f = 0

        for enr in enr_by_sec.get(sec.id, []):
            st = enr.student
            is_m = str(st.sex or "").upper().startswith("M")
            enr_dt = enr.enrollment_date.date() if isinstance(enr.enrollment_date, datetime) else enr.enrollment_date
            if enr_dt and enr_dt > end_dt:
                continue

            status_val = str(enr.status or "").upper()
            exit_dt = enr.status_date.date() if isinstance(enr.status_date, datetime) else enr.status_date

            if "DROP" in status_val:
                if exit_dt and exit_dt < start_dt:
                    if is_m:
                        drop_prev_m += 1
                    else:
                        drop_prev_f += 1
                    continue
                if not exit_dt or exit_dt <= end_dt:
                    if is_m:
                        drop_mo_m += 1
                    else:
                        drop_mo_f += 1
            elif "TRANSFERRED" in status_val and "OUT" in status_val:
                if exit_dt and exit_dt < start_dt:
                    if is_m:
                        tout_prev_m += 1
                    else:
                        tout_prev_f += 1
                    continue
                if not exit_dt or exit_dt <= end_dt:
                    if is_m:
                        tout_mo_m += 1
                    else:
                        tout_mo_f += 1

            if "TRANSFERRED" in status_val and "IN" in status_val:
                if enr_dt and enr_dt < start_dt:
                    if is_m:
                        tin_prev_m += 1
                    else:
                        tin_prev_f += 1
                else:
                    if is_m:
                        tin_mo_m += 1
                    else:
                        tin_mo_f += 1

            if status_val not in ("DROPPED", "TRANSFERRED_OUT") or (exit_dt and exit_dt > end_dt):
                if is_m:
                    reg_m += 1
                else:
                    reg_f += 1
                for s_day in school_days:
                    if (st.id, s_day) in present_pairs:
                        if is_m:
                            att_m += 1
                        else:
                            att_f += 1

        reg = make_triplet(reg_m, reg_f)
        ada = make_triplet(round(att_m / n_days, 1), round(att_f / n_days, 1))
        d_prev, d_mo = make_triplet(drop_prev_m, drop_prev_f), make_triplet(drop_mo_m, drop_mo_f)
        to_prev, to_mo = make_triplet(tout_prev_m, tout_prev_f), make_triplet(tout_mo_m, tout_mo_f)
        ti_prev, ti_mo = make_triplet(tin_prev_m, tin_prev_f), make_triplet(tin_mo_m, tin_mo_f)

        groups_map.setdefault(g_label, []).append(
            {
                "section_id": sec.id,
                "section_name": sec.name,
                "grade_level": g_label,
                "adviser_name": adviser_label,
                "registered_end": reg,
                "daily_average": ada,
                "attendance_percentage": compute_attendance_pct(ada, reg),
                "dropped_out_prev": d_prev,
                "dropped_out_month": d_mo,
                "dropped_out_cumulative": add_triplets(d_prev, d_mo),
                "transferred_out_prev": to_prev,
                "transferred_out_month": to_mo,
                "transferred_out_cumulative": add_triplets(to_prev, to_mo),
                "transferred_in_prev": ti_prev,
                "transferred_in_month": ti_mo,
                "transferred_in_cumulative": add_triplets(ti_prev, ti_mo),
            }
        )

    grade_groups = []
    total_summary = empty_summary_row("grand-total", "TOTAL", "ALL")

    for g_label, sec_rows in groups_map.items():
        subtotal = empty_summary_row(f"subtotal-{g_label}", "SUBTOTAL", g_label)
        for row in sec_rows:
            for key in SUMMABLE_KEYS:
                subtotal[key] = add_triplets(subtotal[key], row[key])
        subtotal["attendance_percentage"] = compute_attendance_pct(
            subtotal["daily_average"], subtotal["registered_end"]
        )
        grade_groups.append(
            {
                "grade_level": g_label,
                "sections": sec_rows,
                "subtotal": subtotal,
            }
        )
        for key in SUMMABLE_KEYS:
            total_summary[key] = add_triplets(total_summary[key], subtotal[key])

    total_summary["attendance_percentage"] = compute_attendance_pct(
        total_summary["daily_average"], total_summary["registered_end"]
    )

    active_sy = target_sy or SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()
    resolved_sy = active_sy.code if active_sy else (str(school_year).strip() or f"{year}-{year + 1}")

    return {
        **get_school_metadata(request),
        "school_year": resolved_sy,
        "month": clean_month,
        "year": year,
        "grade_groups": grade_groups,
        "non_graded_summary": None,
        "total_summary": total_summary,
    }

from django.http import HttpResponse, JsonResponse

def _parse_int_param(raw, *, default: int, name: str, min_val: int, max_val: int) -> int:
    if raw in (None, ""):
        return default
    try:
        val = int(str(raw).strip())
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise AppError(f"INVALID_{name.upper()}", f"{name} must be a valid integer.", 400)
    if not (min_val <= val <= max_val):
        raise AppError(f"INVALID_{name.upper()}", f"{name} must be between {min_val} and {max_val}.", 400)
    return val


def _parse_month_int(raw, default: int) -> int:
    if raw in (None, ""):
        return default
    num, _ = resolve_month(raw)
    return num


def _authorize_section_access(user, section_id: int) -> bool:
    if is_school_leader(user):
        return True
    teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
    return bool(teacher and section_id in get_teacher_section_ids(teacher))


def _require_staff(user) -> None:
    if get_user_role(user) == "PARENT" and not is_school_leader(user):
        raise AppError("FORBIDDEN", "Staff or school leadership access required.", 403)


class DashboardOverviewView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        _require_staff(request.user)
        return Response(get_dashboard_overview(user=request.user, request=request))


class Sf1ReportView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, pk: int | None = None):
        raw_id = pk or request.query_params.get("section_id")
        if not raw_id or not str(raw_id).isdigit():
            return Response({"error": "Valid section_id is required."}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        sec_id = int(raw_id)
        if not _authorize_section_access(request.user, sec_id):
            return Response({"error": "Access denied to this section."}, status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)
        return Response(
            generate_sf1_report(
                section_id=sec_id,
                school_year=request.query_params.get("school_year"),
                request=request,
            )
        )


class Sf1PrintView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        raw_id = request.query_params.get("section_id")
        if not raw_id or not str(raw_id).isdigit():
            return Response({"error": "Valid section_id is required."}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        sec_id = int(raw_id)
        if not _authorize_section_access(request.user, sec_id):
            return Response({"error": "Access denied to this section."}, status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)
        context = generate_sf1_report(section_id=sec_id, request=request)
        return render(request, "reports/sf1.html", context)


class Sf2ReportView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, pk: int | None = None):
        raw_id = pk or request.query_params.get("section_id")
        if not raw_id or not str(raw_id).isdigit():
            return Response({"error": "Valid section_id is required."}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        sec_id = int(raw_id)
        if not _authorize_section_access(request.user, sec_id):
            return Response({"error": "Access denied to this section."}, status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)
        month = request.query_params.get("month", "October")
        year = _parse_int_param(
            request.query_params.get("year"),
            default=timezone.localdate().year,
            name="year",
            min_val=1900,
            max_val=2100,
        )
        return Response(generate_sf2_report(section_id=sec_id, month_name=month, year=year, request=request))


class Sf4ReportView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        if not is_school_leader(request.user):
            return Response({"error": "Leadership access required."}, status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)
        month = request.query_params.get("month", "October")
        year = _parse_int_param(
            request.query_params.get("year"),
            default=timezone.localdate().year,
            name="year",
            min_val=1900,
            max_val=2100,
        )
        sy = request.query_params.get("school_year", "")
        return Response(generate_sf4_report(month_name=month, year=year, school_year=sy, request=request))


class MonthlyDtrView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, pk: int | None = None):
        _require_staff(request.user)
        month = _parse_month_int(request.query_params.get("month"), timezone.localdate().month)
        year = _parse_int_param(
            request.query_params.get("year"),
            default=timezone.localdate().year,
            name="year",
            min_val=1900,
            max_val=2100,
        )
        raw_tid = pk or request.query_params.get("faculty_id") or request.query_params.get("teacher_id")
        t_id = int(raw_tid) if (raw_tid and str(raw_tid).isdigit()) else None
        list_only = str(request.query_params.get("list", "")).lower() in ("1", "true", "yes")
        return Response(
            get_monthly_dtr_data(
                user=request.user,
                month=month,
                year=year,
                teacher_id=t_id,
                list_only=list_only,
                request=request,
            )
        )

    def post(self, request, pk: int | None = None):
        from .services import process_monthly_dtr_action

        _require_staff(request.user)
        month = _parse_month_int(request.data.get("month"), timezone.localdate().month)
        year = _parse_int_param(
            request.data.get("year"),
            default=timezone.localdate().year,
            name="year",
            min_val=1900,
            max_val=2100,
        )
        raw_tid = pk or request.data.get("faculty_id") or request.data.get("teacher_id")
        t_id = int(raw_tid) if (raw_tid and str(raw_tid).isdigit()) else None

        result = process_monthly_dtr_action(
            request=request,
            action=str(request.data.get("action") or ""),
            month=month,
            year=year,
            teacher_id=t_id,
            data=request.data,
        )
        return Response(result, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


class ReportExportView(APIView):
    """Generates printable HTML exports for SF1, SF2, SF4, and DTR reports."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def _handle(self, request, params):
        _require_staff(request.user)
        report_type = str(params.get("report_type") or params.get("type") or "SF1").strip().upper()
        year = _parse_int_param(
            params.get("year"),
            default=timezone.localdate().year,
            name="year",
            min_val=1900,
            max_val=2100,
        )
        raw_sec = params.get("section_id")
        sec_id = int(raw_sec) if (raw_sec and str(raw_sec).isdigit()) else None

        wants_json = (
            str(params.get("format") or "").strip().lower() == "json"
            or "application/json" in str(request.headers.get("Accept") or "").lower()
        )

        def _respond(title: str, html: str):
            if wants_json:
                return Response({"title": title, "html": html})
            return HttpResponse(html, content_type="text/html; charset=utf-8")

        if report_type == "SF1":
            if not sec_id:
                raise AppError("SECTION_REQUIRED", "Valid section_id is required for SF1 export.", 400)
            if not _authorize_section_access(request.user, sec_id):
                raise AppError("FORBIDDEN", "Access denied to this section.", 403)
            context = generate_sf1_report(section_id=sec_id, school_year=params.get("school_year"), request=request)
            html = render_to_string("reports/sf1.html", context, request=request)
            return _respond(f"SF1_{context.get('section_name', sec_id)}", html)

        if report_type == "SF2":
            if not sec_id:
                raise AppError("SECTION_REQUIRED", "Valid section_id is required for SF2 export.", 400)
            if not _authorize_section_access(request.user, sec_id):
                raise AppError("FORBIDDEN", "Access denied to this section.", 403)
            data = generate_sf2_report(
                section_id=sec_id,
                month_name=params.get("month") or "October",
                year=year,
                request=request,
            )
            rows_html = "".join(
                f"<tr><td>{escape(r['lrn'])}</td><td>{escape(r['name'])}</td><td>{escape(r['sex'])}</td>"
                f"<td>{r['total_absent']}</td><td>{r['total_tardy']}</td></tr>"
                for r in (data["males"] + data["females"])
            )
            html = (
                f"<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'><title>SF2 - {escape(data['section_name'])}</title>"
                "<style>body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}"
                "th,td{border:1px solid #333;padding:4px 6px;text-align:left}</style></head><body>"
                f"<h2>School Form 2 (SF2) — {escape(data['school_name'])}</h2>"
                f"<p>Section: <b>{escape(data['grade_level'])} - {escape(data['section_name'])}</b> | "
                f"Month: <b>{escape(data['month'])} {data['year']}</b> | Adviser: <b>{escape(data['adviser_name'])}</b></p>"
                "<table><thead><tr><th>LRN</th><th>Learner Name</th><th>Sex</th><th>Total Absent</th><th>Total Tardy</th></tr></thead>"
                f"<tbody>{rows_html}</tbody></table></body></html>"
            )
            return _respond(f"SF2_{data['section_name']}_{data['month']}_{data['year']}", html)

        if report_type == "SF4":
            if not is_school_leader(request.user):
                raise AppError("FORBIDDEN", "Leadership access required for SF4 export.", 403)
            data = generate_sf4_report(
                month_name=params.get("month") or "October",
                year=year,
                school_year=params.get("school_year") or "",
                request=request,
            )
            rows_html = ""
            for grp in data.get("grade_groups", []):
                for sec in grp.get("sections", []):
                    rows_html += (
                        f"<tr><td>{escape(grp['grade_level'])}</td><td>{escape(sec['section_name'])}</td>"
                        f"<td>{escape(sec['adviser_name'])}</td><td>{sec['registered_end']['total']}</td>"
                        f"<td>{sec['daily_average']['total']}</td><td>{sec['attendance_percentage']['total']}%</td></tr>"
                    )
            html = (
                f"<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'><title>SF4 - {escape(data['month'])} {data['year']}</title>"
                "<style>body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}"
                "th,td{border:1px solid #333;padding:4px 6px;text-align:left}</style></head><body>"
                f"<h2>School Form 4 (SF4) — {escape(data['school_name'])}</h2>"
                f"<p>Month: <b>{escape(data['month'])} {data['year']}</b></p>"
                "<table><thead><tr><th>Grade</th><th>Section</th><th>Adviser</th><th>Registered</th><th>ADA</th><th>% Attendance</th></tr></thead>"
                f"<tbody>{rows_html}</tbody></table></body></html>"
            )
            return _respond(f"SF4_{data['month']}_{data['year']}", html)

        if report_type == "DTR":
            month_num = _parse_month_int(params.get("month"), timezone.localdate().month)
            raw_tid = params.get("faculty_id") or params.get("teacher_id")
            t_id = int(raw_tid) if (raw_tid and str(raw_tid).isdigit()) else None
            data = get_monthly_dtr_data(user=request.user, month=month_num, year=year, teacher_id=t_id, request=request)
            rows_html = "".join(
                f"<tr><td>{r['day']}</td><td>{escape(r['am_arrival'])}</td><td>{escape(r['am_departure'])}</td>"
                f"<td>{escape(r['pm_arrival'])}</td><td>{escape(r['pm_departure'])}</td><td>{escape(r['status'])}</td></tr>"
                for r in data["rows"]
                if r["status"] != "OUT_OF_MONTH"
            )
            html = (
                f"<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset='utf-8'><title>CSC Form 48 - {escape(data['faculty_name'])}</title>"
                "<style>body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}"
                "th,td{border:1px solid #333;padding:4px 6px;text-align:center}</style></head><body>"
                f"<h2>Civil Service Form No. 48 (DTR) — {escape(data['faculty_name'])}</h2>"
                f"<p>Month: <b>{escape(data['month'])} {data['year']}</b> | Days Present: <b>{data['days_present']}</b></p>"
                "<table><thead><tr><th>Day</th><th>AM In</th><th>AM Out</th><th>PM In</th><th>PM Out</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>"
                f"<tbody>{rows_html}</tbody></table></body></html>"
            )
            return _respond(f"CSC_Form_48_{data['faculty_name']}_{data['month']}_{data['year']}", html)

        raise AppError("INVALID_REPORT_TYPE", f"Unsupported report type '{report_type}'.", 400)

    def get(self, request):
        return self._handle(request, request.query_params)

    def post(self, request):
        return self._handle(request, request.data)


class EdFiExportView(APIView):
    """Exports live school, roster, staff, and attendance data in Ed-Fi Data Standard v6.0 JSON format."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        if not is_school_leader(request.user):
            raise AppError("FORBIDDEN", "School leadership access required.", 403)

        days = _parse_int_param(
            request.query_params.get("days"),
            default=30,
            name="days",
            min_val=1,
            max_val=90,
        )
        anonymize = str(request.query_params.get("anonymize") or "").strip().lower() in (
            "1",
            "true",
            "yes",
        )
        payload = build_edfi_v6_export(request=request, days=days, anonymize=anonymize)
        today = timezone.localdate()
        mode_tag = "gdpr_pseudonymized" if anonymize else "standard"

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name="edfi_export",
            record_id=0,
            action="EXPORT",
            new_data={
                "standard": "Ed-Fi v6.0",
                "anonymize": anonymize,
                "days": days,
                "events": payload["recordCounts"]["studentSchoolAttendanceEvents"],
            },
        )

        response = JsonResponse(payload)
        response["Content-Disposition"] = f'attachment; filename="attendsure_edfi_v6_{mode_tag}_{today}.json"'
        return response


class ReportAuditLogView(APIView):
    """Lists and records audit entries whenever SF1, SF2, SF4, or DTR forms are printed or exported."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        from apps.accounts.models import AuditLog
        from apps.accounts.views import _format_audit_row

        _require_staff(request.user)
        qs = AuditLog.objects.select_related("performed_by").filter(
            table_name__in=["deped_reports", "edfi_export"]
        ).order_by("-created_at")
        if not is_school_leader(request.user):
            qs = qs.filter(performed_by=request.user)
        records = [_format_audit_row(row) for row in qs[:100]]
        return Response({"count": len(records), "records": records, "results": records})

    def post(self, request):
        _require_staff(request.user)
        raw_section = request.data.get("section_id")
        record_id = int(raw_section) if (raw_section and str(raw_section).isdigit()) else 0
        action_code = str(request.data.get("action") or "EXPORT").strip().upper()[:10]
        report_name = str(request.data.get("report_name") or "School Form").strip()[:80]
        tracking_id = str(request.data.get("document_tracking_id") or "").strip()[:80]

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name="deped_reports",
            record_id=record_id,
            action=action_code,
            new_data={"report_name": report_name, "tracking_id": tracking_id},
        )
        return Response({"ok": True, "logged": True}, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

class SystemStatusView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        _require_staff(request.user)
        return Response(get_system_status())

    def post(self, request):
        if not is_school_leader(request.user):
            raise AppError("FORBIDDEN", "School leadership access required.", 403)

        action_name = str(request.data.get("action") or "RETRY_FAILED").strip().upper()
        retried = 0
        unlocked = 0

        if action_name in ("RETRY_FAILED", "SYNC_PUSH", "DISPATCH_PUSH", ""):
            retried = retry_pending_push_notifications()
        elif action_name in ("UNLOCK_ACCOUNTS", "UNLOCK_FACULTY"):
            unlocked = unlock_all_locked_accounts()

        data = dict(get_system_status())
        data["ok"] = True
        data["retried_count"] = retried
        data["unlocked_count"] = unlocked
        data["message"] = (
            f"Unlocked {unlocked} account(s)."
            if action_name in ("UNLOCK_ACCOUNTS", "UNLOCK_FACULTY")
            else f"Queued {retried} pending push alert(s) for delivery."
        )
        return Response(data)

            )
            seeded_students.append((student, sec, pattern))

        # 5. 14 Recent School Days of Attendance + Today's Live Scans
        school_days = []
        cursor = today
        while len(school_days) < 14:
            if cursor.weekday() < 5 or cursor == today:
                school_days.append(cursor)
            cursor -= timedelta(days=1)

        for day_idx, att_date in enumerate(school_days):
            for st_idx, (student, sec, pattern) in enumerate(seeded_students):
                if pattern == "critical_sardo":
                    if day_idx == 0:
                        st_status = "ABSENT"
                    elif day_idx in (1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 9):
                        st_status = "ABSENT"
                    elif day_idx in (4, 6, 8):
                        st_status = "CUTTING"
                    else:
                        st_status = "LATE"
                elif pattern == "early_warning":
                    if day_idx in (1, 4, 8):
                        st_status = "ABSENT"
                    elif day_idx in (2, 6):
                        st_status = "LATE"
                    else:
                        st_status = "PRESENT"
                elif pattern == "late":
                    st_status = "LATE" if day_idx % 3 == 0 else "PRESENT"
                else:
                    st_status = "PRESENT" if (day_idx + st_idx) % 11 != 0 else "LATE"

                DailyAttendance.objects.update_or_create(
                    student=student,
                    attendance_date=att_date,
                    defaults={
                        "section": sec,
                        "status": st_status,
                        "remarks": "Flagged for home visit" if pattern == "critical_sardo" and st_status == "ABSENT" else "",
                    },
                )

                sec_periods = periods_by_section.get(sec.id, [])
                for p_idx, period in enumerate(sec_periods):
                    scan_hour = min(16, period.start_time.hour)
                    scan_minute = min(55, (st_idx * 2 + p_idx * 5) % 50)
                    scanned_dt = timezone.make_aware(
                        datetime.combine(att_date, time(scan_hour, scan_minute, 10))
                    )
                    ClassAttendance.objects.update_or_create(
                        student=student,
                        class_period=period,
                        attendance_date=att_date,
                        defaults={
                            "recorded_by": period.teacher or adviser_teacher,
                            "scanned_at": scanned_dt,
                            "scan_method": "QR" if st_status != "ABSENT" else "MANUAL",
                            "status": st_status,
                        },
                    )

        # 6. Teacher Campus GPS Telemetry & DTR
        for teacher in (principal_teacher, adviser_teacher, dept_head_teacher, admin_teacher):
            for att_date in school_days[:10]:
                for ping_time in (time(7, 42), time(12, 3), time(13, 5), time(16, 48)):
                    ts = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(att_date, ping_time))
                    if not TeacherLocationLog.objects.filter(teacher=teacher, recorded_at=ts).exists():
                        TeacherLocationLog.objects.create(
                            teacher=teacher,
                            latitude=Decimal("8.4858120"),
                            longitude=Decimal("124.6567150"),
                            battery_level=86,
                            is_inside_geofence=True,
                            recorded_at=ts,
                        )
            MonthlyTimeRecord.objects.update_or_create(
                teacher=teacher,
                month=today.month,
                year=today.year,
                defaults={
                    "is_submitted": teacher == adviser_teacher,
                    "submitted_at": now if teacher == adviser_teacher else None,
                    "regular_hours": "7:30 AM - 12:00 PM / 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM",
                    "saturday_hours": "As Required",
                },
            )

        BoundaryAlert.objects.get_or_create(
            teacher=dept_head_teacher,
            incident_date=today - timedelta(days=2),
            defaults={
                "trigger_reason": "Division Office Official Curriculum Briefing (Excused)",
                "status": "EXCUSED",
                "remarks": "Verified against Division Memorandum No. 2026-114.",
            },
        )

        # 7. Gate Exit Passes
        first_student = seeded_students[0][0]
        ExitPass.objects.update_or_create(
            pass_number="GP-DEMO-2026-001",
            defaults={
                "student": first_student,
                "issued_by": adviser_teacher,
                "pass_type": "Medical / Clinic Clearance",
                "reason": "Scheduled pediatric dental follow-up with guardian escort.",
                "valid_from": now - timedelta(minutes=30),
                "valid_until": now + timedelta(hours=3),
                "status": "ACTIVE",
            },
        )
        ExitPass.objects.update_or_create(
            pass_number="GP-DEMO-2026-002",
            defaults={
                "teacher": adviser_teacher,
                "issued_by": adviser_teacher,
                "pass_type": "Official Travel Order",
                "reason": "Regional STEM Robotics Coaches Orientation at Division Office.",
                "valid_from": now + timedelta(hours=1),
                "valid_until": now + timedelta(hours=5),
                "status": "PENDING",
            },
        )

        # 8. Notifications, Parent-Teacher Chat & Tamper-Evident Audit Logs
        if not Notification.objects.filter(recipient=parent_user, title__contains="Arrived Safely").exists():
            Notification.objects.create(
                recipient=parent_user,
                student=first_student,
                title=f"{first_student.first_name} Arrived Safely in Class",
                message=f"Signed QR check-in verified for {first_student.full_name} in Mathematics 7 (Room 101).",
                category="ATTENDANCE",
                is_pushed=True,
                is_read=False,
            )
            Notification.objects.create(
                recipient=parent_user,
                student=seeded_students[2][0],
                title="Early-Warning Attendance Follow-Up",
                message="Your child's adviser has requested a brief check-in regarding recent absences.",
                category="CUTTING_ALERT",
                is_pushed=True,
                is_read=False,
            )

        if not ChatMessage.objects.filter(student=first_student, teacher=adviser_teacher, parent=parent_user).exists():
            ChatMessage.objects.create(
                student=first_student,
                teacher=adviser_teacher,
                parent=parent_user,
                sender=teacher_user,
                body="Good morning Ms. Alvarez! Mateo checked in on time for Mathematics 7 and scored 98% on today's quiz.",
                is_read=False,
            )
            ChatMessage.objects.create(
                student=first_student,
                teacher=adviser_teacher,
                parent=parent_user,
                sender=parent_user,
                body="Thank you Sir Marco! We really appreciate the real-time arrival notifications on AttendSure.",
                is_read=True,
            )

        if AuditLog.objects.count() < 5:
            for table, action, detail in [
                ("subject_attendance_logs", "CREATE", {"summary": "Batch signed QR check-in verified (Grade 7 - Newton)"}),
                ("deped_reports", "EXPORT", {"report_name": "SF2 Monthly Attendance Register"}),
                ("edfi_export", "EXPORT", {"standard": "Ed-Fi v6.0", "anonymize": True}),
                ("faculty_heartbeats", "VERIFY", {"geofence": "Inside 150m Campus Boundary"}),
            ]:
                AuditLog.objects.create(
                    table_name=table,
                    record_id=1,
                    action=action,
                    new_data=detail,
                    performed_by=admin_user,
                    client_ip="127.0.0.1",
                )

        self.stdout.write(
            self.style.SUCCESS(
                "AttendSure Competition Demo Dataset seeded successfully!\n"
                "Demo Accounts (password: AttendSure2026!):\n"
                "  - Admin:     demo_admin\n"
                "  - Principal: demo_principal\n"
                "  - Teacher:   demo_teacher\n"
                "  - Parent:    demo_parent\n"
                "1-Click Judge Demo Login is active whenever DEBUG=True or ENABLE_JUDGE_DEMO=True."
            )
        )

from django.db import models, transaction

DAY_OF_WEEK_CHOICES = [
    (1, "Monday"), (2, "Tuesday"), (3, "Wednesday"),
    (4, "Thursday"), (5, "Friday"), (6, "Saturday"), (7, "Sunday"),

class SchoolYear(models.Model):
    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    code = models.CharField(max_length=20, unique=True)
    start_date = models.DateField()
    baseline_cutoff_date = models.DateField(db_column="first_friday_june")
    end_date = models.DateField()
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "academic_years"
        ordering = ["-start_date"]

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        with transaction.atomic():
            if self.is_active:
                SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).exclude(pk=self.pk).update(is_active=False)
            super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def __str__(self):
        return self.code

from django.core.cache import cache
from django.db.models import Count, Q

from apps.accounts.selectors import get_teacher_section_ids, resolve_teacher_for_user
from common.media import build_media_url, save_base64_logo_to_disk
from common.permissions import is_school_leader
from .models import ClassPeriod, SchoolSettings, Section

SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY = "school:metadata:raw"


def format_section_label(grade_name: str, section_name: str) -> str:
    g, s = str(grade_name or "").strip(), str(section_name or "").strip()
    if not g:
        return s
    if not s or g.lower().endswith(s.lower()):
        return g
    return f"{g} - {s}"


def migrate_inline_logos_to_files(school: SchoolSettings) -> SchoolSettings:
    """Replaces raw Base64 logo strings in PostgreSQL with lightweight /media/ paths."""
    updates = {}
    for field_name in ("school_logo", "left_logo", "right_logo"):
        val = getattr(school, field_name, None)
        if val and isinstance(val, str) and (
            val.startswith("data:image") or val.startswith(("/9j/", "iVBORw0KGgo"))
        ):
            disk_path = save_base64_logo_to_disk(val)
            if disk_path:
                updates[field_name] = disk_path
                setattr(school, field_name, disk_path)

    if updates:
        SchoolSettings.objects.filter(pk=school.pk).update(**updates)
        cache.delete(SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY)
    return school


def get_school_metadata(request=None, school: SchoolSettings | None = None) -> dict:
    raw = cache.get(SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY)
    if raw is None:
        school = school or SchoolSettings.objects.select_related("principal_teacher").first()
        if not school:
            return {"school_id": "", "school_name": "", "is_configured": False}

        school = migrate_inline_logos_to_files(school)
        head_name = school.principal_name or (
            school.principal_teacher.full_name if school.principal_teacher else ""
        )
        raw = {
            "school_id": school.school_id,
            "school_name": school.school_name,
            "region": school.region,
            "division": school.division,
            "district": school.district,
            "academic_year": school.academic_year,
            "school_address": school.address,
            "school_contact": school.contact_number,
            "school_email": school.email,
            "website": school.website,
            "school_head": head_name.upper(),
            "principal_title": school.principal_title,
            "superintendent_name": school.superintendent_name,
            "left_logo_path": school.left_logo,
            "right_logo_path": school.right_logo,
            "school_logo_path": school.school_logo,
            "is_configured": bool(school.school_name and school.school_id),
        }
        cache.set(SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY, raw, timeout=300)

    return {
        "school_id": raw["school_id"],
        "school_name": raw["school_name"],
        "region": raw["region"],
        "division": raw["division"],
        "district": raw["district"],
        "academic_year": raw["academic_year"],
        "school_address": raw["school_address"],
        "school_contact": raw["school_contact"],
        "school_email": raw["school_email"],
        "website": raw["website"],
        "school_head": raw["school_head"],
        "principal_title": raw["principal_title"],
        "superintendent_name": raw["superintendent_name"],
        "left_logo": build_media_url(raw["left_logo_path"], request),
        "right_logo": build_media_url(raw["right_logo_path"], request),
        "school_logo": build_media_url(raw["school_logo_path"], request),
        "is_configured": raw["is_configured"],
    }


def get_sections_for_user(user, *, include_inactive: bool = False):
    qs = Section.objects.all()
    if not (include_inactive and is_school_leader(user)):
        qs = qs.filter(is_active=True)
    qs = (
        qs.select_related("grade_level", "school_year", "adviser", "room")
        .annotate(
            enrolled_count=Count(
                "enrollments",
                filter=Q(
                    enrollments__status__in=["ENROLLED", "TRANSFERRED_IN"],
                    enrollments__student__is_active=True,
                ),
                distinct=True,
            )
        )
        .order_by("grade_level__level_order", "name")
    )
    if not is_school_leader(user):
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        qs = qs.filter(id__in=get_teacher_section_ids(teacher)) if teacher else qs.none()
    return qs


def get_class_periods_for_user(user, section_id: int | None = None):
    qs = ClassPeriod.objects.select_related(
        "section", "section__grade_level", "subject", "teacher", "room"
    ).order_by("start_time")
    if section_id:
        qs = qs.filter(section_id=section_id)
    if not is_school_leader(user):
        teacher = resolve_teacher_for_user(user)
        if teacher:
            qs = qs.filter(
                Q(teacher=teacher) | Q(section_id__in=get_teacher_section_ids(teacher))
            ).distinct()
        else:
            qs = qs.none()
    return qs

class SchoolHolidaySerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    date = serializers.DateField(source="holiday_date")
    reason = serializers.CharField(source="title", required=False, write_only=True)
    type = serializers.CharField(required=False, write_only=True, default="HOLIDAY")

    class Meta:
        model = SchoolHoliday
        fields = ["id", "date", "title", "reason", "type", "created_at"]
        extra_kwargs = {"title": {"required": False}}

    def _split_existing_title(self):
        raw_title = str(self.instance.title or "") if self.instance else ""
        exc_type = "HOLIDAY"
        clean_reason = raw_title
        for prefix in ("SUSPENSION", "HOLIDAY", "EVENT"):
            tag = f"[{prefix}] "
            if raw_title.upper().startswith(tag):
                exc_type = prefix
                clean_reason = raw_title[len(tag):]
                break
        return exc_type, clean_reason

    def to_internal_value(self, data):
        mutable = {k: data.get(k) for k in data.keys()} if hasattr(data, "keys") else dict(data)
        has_title_or_reason = ("title" in mutable and mutable.get("title") is not None) or (
            "reason" in mutable and mutable.get("reason") is not None
        )
        has_type = "type" in mutable and str(mutable.get("type") or "").strip() != ""

        if not mutable.get("title") and mutable.get("reason"):
            mutable["title"] = mutable["reason"]

        existing_type, existing_reason = self._split_existing_title()
        exc_type = str(mutable.get("type") or (existing_type if self.instance else "")).strip().upper()
        raw_title = str(mutable.get("title") or (existing_reason if (self.instance and has_type and not has_title_or_reason) else "")).strip()

        if has_title_or_reason or has_type:
            if exc_type in ("SUSPENSION", "HOLIDAY", "EVENT") and raw_title and not raw_title.startswith("["):
                mutable["title"] = f"[{exc_type}] {raw_title}"[:150]
            elif raw_title:
                mutable["title"] = raw_title[:150]

        mutable.pop("reason", None)
        return super().to_internal_value(mutable)

    def validate(self, attrs):
        if self.partial and "title" not in attrs:
            attrs.pop("type", None)
            return attrs
        if not str(attrs.get("title") or "").strip():
            raise serializers.ValidationError({"title": "A holiday or calendar title/reason is required."})
        attrs.pop("type", None)
        return attrs

    def to_representation(self, instance):
        data = super().to_representation(instance)
        raw_title = str(instance.title or "")
        exc_type = "HOLIDAY"
        clean_reason = raw_title
        for prefix in ("SUSPENSION", "HOLIDAY", "EVENT"):
            tag = f"[{prefix}] "
            if raw_title.upper().startswith(tag):
                exc_type = prefix
                clean_reason = raw_title[len(tag):]
                break
        data["type"] = exc_type
        data["reason"] = clean_reason
        data["affects_all_grades"] = True
        return data

            "school_logo",
            "left_logo",
            "right_logo",
            "latitude",
            "longitude",
            "geofence_radius_meters",
            "updated_at",
        ]
        extra_kwargs = {
            "school_id": {"required": False, "allow_blank": True},
            "school_name": {"required": False, "allow_blank": True},
            "principal_teacher": {"required": False, "allow_null": True},
        }

    def to_internal_value(self, data):
        mutable = {k: data.get(k) for k in data.keys()} if hasattr(data, "keys") else dict(data)

        alias_map = {
            "school_address": "address",
            "school_contact": "contact_number",
            "school_email": "email",
            "school_head": "principal_name",
            "radius_meters": "geofence_radius_meters",
            "geofence_radius": "geofence_radius_meters",
            "emblem": "school_logo",
            "main_logo": "school_logo",
            "principal_faculty": "principal_teacher",
        }
        for src_key, dest_key in alias_map.items():
            if src_key in mutable and dest_key not in mutable:
                mutable[dest_key] = mutable[src_key]
        mutable.pop("principal_faculty", None)

        if "principal_teacher" in mutable and str(mutable["principal_teacher"]).strip().lower() in (
            "",
            "null",
            "none",
            "undefined",
        ):
            mutable["principal_teacher"] = None

        if "website" in mutable:
            raw_web = str(mutable.get("website") or "").strip()
            if raw_web and not raw_web.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
                mutable["website"] = f"https://{raw_web}"
            else:
                mutable["website"] = raw_web

        for coord_key in ("latitude", "longitude"):
            if coord_key in mutable:
                raw_coord = mutable[coord_key]
                if raw_coord in (None, "", "null", "undefined"):
                    mutable.pop(coord_key, None)
                else:
                    try:
                        parsed = float(raw_coord)
                        if not math.isfinite(parsed):
                            raise ValueError("non-finite")
                        mutable[coord_key] = Decimal(f"{parsed:.7f}")
                    except (TypeError, ValueError, InvalidOperation):
                        raise serializers.ValidationError({coord_key: f"Invalid {coord_key} value."})

        if "geofence_radius_meters" in mutable:
            raw_rad = mutable["geofence_radius_meters"]
            if raw_rad in (None, "", "null", "undefined"):
                mutable.pop("geofence_radius_meters", None)
            else:
                try:
                    parsed_rad = float(raw_rad)
                    if not math.isfinite(parsed_rad):
                        raise ValueError("non-finite")
                    mutable["geofence_radius_meters"] = max(20, min(5000, int(parsed_rad)))
                except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
                    raise serializers.ValidationError({"geofence_radius_meters": "Invalid radius in meters."})

        return super().to_internal_value(mutable)

    def update(self, instance, validated_data):
        instance = super().update(instance, validated_data)
        if instance.principal_teacher:
            if not instance.principal_name:
                instance.principal_name = instance.principal_teacher.full_name
            if not instance.principal_title and instance.principal_teacher.position:
                instance.principal_title = instance.principal_teacher.position
            instance.save(update_fields=["principal_name", "principal_title", "updated_at"])
        return instance

    def get_principal_photo_url(self, obj):
        if obj.principal_teacher and obj.principal_teacher.photo:
            return build_media_url(obj.principal_teacher.photo, self.context.get("request"))
        return None

    def get_principal_employee_id(self, obj) -> str:

    def get_principal_department(self, obj) -> str:

    def get_principal_email(self, obj) -> str:
        return obj.principal_teacher.email if obj.principal_teacher else ""

    def get_principal_contact_number(self, obj) -> str:

            mutable["adviser"] = mutable.get("adviser_id")

        if obj.adviser and obj.adviser.photo:
            return build_media_url(obj.adviser.photo, self.context.get("request"))
        return None

        return format_section_label(obj.grade_level.name if obj.grade_level else "", obj.name)

    def validate(self, attrs):
        sy = attrs.get("school_year") or (self.instance.school_year if self.instance else None)
        if not sy:
            sy = SchoolYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first() or SchoolYear.objects.first()
            if not sy:
                raise serializers.ValidationError(
                    {"school_year": "Create an active School Year before adding sections."}
                )
            attrs["school_year"] = sy
        grade_level = attrs.get("grade_level") or (self.instance.grade_level if self.instance else None)
        name = attrs.get("name") if "name" in attrs else (self.instance.name if self.instance else None)
        if sy and grade_level and name:
            dup_qs = Section.objects.filter(school_year=sy, grade_level=grade_level, name=name)
            if self.instance:
                dup_qs = dup_qs.exclude(pk=self.instance.pk)
            if dup_qs.exists():
                raise serializers.ValidationError(
                    {"name": "A section with this name already exists for this grade level and school year."}
                )
        return attrs

    def create(self, validated_data):
        section = super().create(validated_data)
        sync_uniform_subjects_for_section(section)
        return section

from datetime import time
from .models import ClassPeriod, ClassPeriodDay, Section, Subject


def sync_uniform_subjects_for_section(section: Section) -> None:
    if not section or not section.grade_level_id:
        return
    subjects = list(Subject.objects.filter(grade_level_id=section.grade_level_id).order_by("id"))
    existing_ids = set(ClassPeriod.objects.filter(section=section).values_list("subject_id", flat=True))
    to_create = []
    for idx, subj in enumerate(subjects):
        if subj.id in existing_ids:
            continue
        start_hr = min(7 + idx, 16)
        to_create.append(
            ClassPeriod(
                section=section,
                subject=subj,
                start_time=time(start_hr, 30),
                end_time=time(min(start_hr + 1, 17), 30),
                days_of_week="MON-FRI",
                room=section.room,
                room_number=section.room_number or "",
                is_active=True,
            )
        )
    if to_create:
        ClassPeriod.objects.bulk_create(to_create, ignore_conflicts=True)


def sync_period_days(period: ClassPeriod, days_text: str) -> None:
    presets = {"MON-FRI": [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], "MWF": [1, 3, 5], "TTH": [2, 4], "SAT": [6]}
    lookup = {"MON": 1, "TUE": 2, "WED": 3, "THU": 4, "FRI": 5, "SAT": 6, "SUN": 7}
    clean = str(days_text or "MON-FRI").upper().strip()
    day_nums = presets.get(clean) or [lookup[p.strip()] for p in clean.split(",") if p.strip() in lookup] or [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

    ClassPeriodDay.objects.filter(class_period=period).exclude(day_of_week__in=day_nums).delete()
    existing = set(ClassPeriodDay.objects.filter(class_period=period).values_list("day_of_week", flat=True))
    ClassPeriodDay.objects.bulk_create(
        [ClassPeriodDay(class_period=period, day_of_week=d) for d in day_nums if d not in existing]
    )

from django.core.cache import cache
from django.db import transaction
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.views import APIView

from apps.campus.models import CampusBoundary
from common.audit import AuditedModelViewSet, record_audit_log
from common.permissions import IsLeadershipOrReadOnly, is_school_leader
from .models import GradeLevel, Room, SchoolHoliday, SchoolSettings, SchoolYear, Subject
from .selectors import (
    SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY,
    get_class_periods_for_user,
    get_school_metadata,
    get_sections_for_user,

def _wants_fresh_cache(request) -> bool:
    flag = str(request.query_params.get("nocache", "")).strip().lower()
    return flag in ("1", "true", "yes")


def _resolve_clean_school_id(school_obj: SchoolSettings | None, meta: dict) -> str:
    if school_obj and getattr(school_obj, "school_id", None):
        clean_db_id = str(school_obj.school_id).strip()
        if clean_db_id:
            return clean_db_id
    return str(meta.get("school_id") or meta.get("deped_school_id") or "").strip()


class PublicSchoolBrandingView(APIView):
    """Returns non-sensitive public school letterhead info for Web & Mobile Sign-In screens."""

    permission_classes = [permissions.AllowAny]

    def get(self, request):
        if _wants_fresh_cache(request):
            cache.delete(SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY)

        school = SchoolSettings.objects.select_related("principal_teacher").first()
        meta = get_school_metadata(request, school=school) if school else get_school_metadata(request)
        resolved_school_id = _resolve_clean_school_id(school, meta)

        return Response(
            {
                "school_id": resolved_school_id,
                "deped_school_id": resolved_school_id,
                "school_name": (school.school_name if school and school.school_name else meta.get("school_name", "")) or "",
                "short_name": (getattr(school, "short_name", "") if school else meta.get("short_name", "")) or "",
                "region": (school.region if school and school.region else meta.get("region", "")) or "",
                "division": (school.division if school and school.division else meta.get("division", "")) or "",
                "district": (school.district if school and school.district else meta.get("district", "")) or "",
                "address": (getattr(school, "address", "") if school else meta.get("address", "")) or "",
                "contact_number": (getattr(school, "contact_number", "") if school else meta.get("contact_number", "")) or "",
                "email": (getattr(school, "email", "") if school else meta.get("email", "")) or "",
                "principal_name": meta.get("principal_name") or (getattr(school, "principal_name", "") if school else "") or "",
                "principal_title": meta.get("principal_title") or (getattr(school, "principal_title", "") if school else "") or "",
                "academic_year": meta.get("academic_year", ""),
                "school_logo": meta.get("school_logo"),
                "left_logo": meta.get("left_logo"),
                "right_logo": meta.get("right_logo"),
                "is_configured": bool(school and (resolved_school_id or school.school_name)) or bool(meta.get("is_configured", False)),
            }
        )


class SchoolSettingsView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsLeadershipOrReadOnly]

    def get(self, request):
        if _wants_fresh_cache(request):
            cache.delete(SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY)

        school = SchoolSettings.objects.select_related("principal_teacher").first()
        if not school:
            meta = get_school_metadata(request)
            sid = str(meta.get("school_id") or "").strip()
            meta["school_id"] = sid
            meta["deped_school_id"] = sid
            return Response(meta)

        school = migrate_inline_logos_to_files(school)
        serialized = dict(SchoolSettingsSerializer(school, context={"request": request}).data)
        meta = get_school_metadata(request, school=school)

        # Merge metadata without allowing a blank cached value to erase real DB columns
        merged = {**meta, **{k: v for k, v in serialized.items() if v not in (None, "")}}
        resolved_school_id = _resolve_clean_school_id(school, merged)
        merged["school_id"] = resolved_school_id
        merged["deped_school_id"] = resolved_school_id

        for logo_key in ("school_logo", "left_logo", "right_logo"):
            if meta.get(logo_key):
                merged[logo_key] = meta[logo_key]

        if meta.get("academic_year"):
            merged["academic_year"] = meta["academic_year"]

        return Response(merged)

    @transaction.atomic
    def put(self, request):
        school = SchoolSettings.objects.first()
        raw_payload = (
            {k: request.data.get(k) for k in request.data.keys()}
            if hasattr(request.data, "keys")
            else dict(request.data)
        )

        # Support deped_school_id alias cleanly if sent by frontend forms
        if not raw_payload.get("school_id") and raw_payload.get("deped_school_id"):
            raw_payload["school_id"] = str(raw_payload["deped_school_id"]).strip()[:30]

        if school:
            serializer = SchoolSettingsSerializer(
                school, data=raw_payload, partial=True, context={"request": request}
            )
        else:
            if not str(raw_payload.get("school_name") or "").strip():
                return Response(
                    {"error": "School name is required."},
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                )
            serializer = SchoolSettingsSerializer(data=raw_payload, context={"request": request})

        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        saved = migrate_inline_logos_to_files(serializer.save())
        cache.delete_many([SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY, "reports:system_status"])

        try:
            parsed_radius = int(saved.geofence_radius_meters or 150)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            parsed_radius = 150
        radius_val = min(5000, max(20, parsed_radius))

        boundary = CampusBoundary.objects.filter(is_active=True).first() or CampusBoundary.objects.first()
        if boundary:
            boundary.name = (saved.school_name or boundary.name or "Campus Boundary")[:100]
            boundary.latitude = saved.latitude
            boundary.longitude = saved.longitude
            boundary.radius_meters = radius_val
            boundary.is_active = True
            boundary.save()
        else:
            CampusBoundary.objects.create(
                name=(saved.school_name or "Campus Boundary")[:100],
                latitude=saved.latitude,
                longitude=saved.longitude,
                radius_meters=radius_val,
                is_active=True,
            )

        record_audit_log(
            request=request,
            table_name=saved._meta.db_table,
            record_id=saved.pk,
            action="UPDATE",
            changed_fields=list(serializer.validated_data.keys()),
        )

        serialized = dict(SchoolSettingsSerializer(saved, context={"request": request}).data)
        meta = get_school_metadata(request, school=saved)
        merged = {**meta, **{k: v for k, v in serialized.items() if v not in (None, "")}}
        resolved_school_id = _resolve_clean_school_id(saved, merged)
        merged["school_id"] = resolved_school_id
        merged["deped_school_id"] = resolved_school_id
        for logo_key in ("school_logo", "left_logo", "right_logo"):
            if meta.get(logo_key):
                merged[logo_key] = meta[logo_key]
        return Response(merged)

    def post(self, request):
        return self.put(request)

    def patch(self, request):
        return self.put(request)

    def delete(self, request):
        school = SchoolSettings.objects.first()
        field = str(request.query_params.get("field") or request.data.get("field") or "").strip()
        if school and field in ("school_logo", "left_logo", "right_logo"):
            setattr(school, field, None)
            school.save(update_fields=[field, "updated_at"])
            cache.delete_many([SCHOOL_META_CACHE_KEY, "reports:system_status"])
            record_audit_log(
                request=request,
                table_name=school._meta.db_table,
                record_id=school.pk,
                action="DELETE",
                changed_fields=[field],
            )
            return self.get(request)
        return Response(
            {"error": "Specify school_logo, left_logo, or right_logo."},
            status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
        )


WEEKEND_REST_CACHE_KEY = "school:calendar:weekend_rest_enabled"


class SchoolHolidayViewSet(AuditedModelViewSet):
    queryset = SchoolHoliday.objects.order_by("holiday_date")
    serializer_class = SchoolHolidaySerializer
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsLeadershipOrReadOnly]

    def list(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        response = super().list(request, *args, **kwargs)
        weekend_rest = cache.get(WEEKEND_REST_CACHE_KEY)
        if weekend_rest is None:
            weekend_rest = True
        if isinstance(response.data, dict):
            response.data["weekend_rest_enabled"] = bool(weekend_rest)
            if "results" in response.data and "exceptions" not in response.data:
                response.data["exceptions"] = response.data["results"]
        return response

    def patch(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        """Handles collection-level PATCH /api/calendar/exceptions/ for weekend rest toggle."""
        if "pk" not in kwargs:
            if not is_school_leader(request.user):
                return Response(
                    {"error": "School leadership access required."},
                    status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                )
            return self.partial_update_settings(request)
        return super().partial_update(request, *args, **kwargs)

    def partial_update_settings(self, request):
        if not is_school_leader(request.user):
            return Response(
                {"error": "School leadership access required."},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )
        val = request.data.get("weekend_rest_enabled")
        if val is not None:
            enabled = (
                bool(val)
                if isinstance(val, bool)
                else str(val).strip().lower() in ("true", "1", "yes")
            )
            cache.set(WEEKEND_REST_CACHE_KEY, enabled, timeout=None)
            record_audit_log(
                request=request,
                table_name=SchoolHoliday._meta.db_table,
                record_id=0,
                action="UPDATE",
                new_data={"weekend_rest_enabled": enabled},
            )
            return Response({"ok": True, "weekend_rest_enabled": enabled})
        current = cache.get(WEEKEND_REST_CACHE_KEY)
        return Response(
            {"ok": True, "weekend_rest_enabled": True if current is None else bool(current)}
        )

class SectionViewSet(AuditedModelViewSet):
    serializer_class = SectionSerializer
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated, IsLeadershipOrReadOnly]

    def get_queryset(self):
        include_inactive = (
            self.action in ("retrieve", "update", "partial_update", "destroy")
            or str(self.request.query_params.get("include_inactive", "")).lower() in ("1", "true", "yes")
        )
        return get_sections_for_user(self.request.user, include_inactive=include_inactive)

    def _clear_adviser_cache(self, *teacher_ids):
        keys = [f"accounts:teacher_sections:{tid}" for tid in teacher_ids if tid]
        if keys:
            cache.delete_many(keys)

    def perform_create(self, serializer):
        super().perform_create(serializer)
        self._clear_adviser_cache(serializer.instance.adviser_id)

    def perform_update(self, serializer):
        old_adviser_id = serializer.instance.adviser_id
        super().perform_update(serializer)
        self._clear_adviser_cache(old_adviser_id, serializer.instance.adviser_id)

    def perform_destroy(self, instance):
        adviser_id = instance.adviser_id
        super().perform_destroy(instance)
        self._clear_adviser_cache(adviser_id)

from datetime import datetime
import secrets
from django.conf import settings
from django.db import models
from django.db.models import UniqueConstraint
from django.utils import timezone
from common.phone import normalize_ph_phone

SEX_CHOICES = [("Male", "Male"), ("Female", "Female")]
ENROLLMENT_STATUS_CHOICES = [
    ("ENROLLED", "Enrolled"),
    ("DROPPED", "Dropped Out"),
    ("TRANSFERRED_IN", "Transferred In"),
    ("TRANSFERRED_OUT", "Transferred Out"),
]
ENROLLMENT_TYPE_CHOICES = [
    ("REGULAR", "Regular"),
    ("LATE_ENROLLEE", "Late Enrollee"),
    ("TRANSFERRED_IN", "Transferred In"),
    ("RETURNING", "Returning"),
    ("REPEATER", "Repeater"),
]


class Student(models.Model):
    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    lrn = models.CharField(max_length=20, unique=True, db_index=True)
    first_name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    middle_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    last_name = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    suffix = models.CharField(max_length=20, blank=True, default="")
    sex = models.CharField(max_length=10, choices=SEX_CHOICES)
    birthdate = models.DateField()

    mother_tongue = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    ethnic_group = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    religion = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")

    house_street_sitio = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, default="")
    barangay = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    municipality_city = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")
    province = models.CharField(max_length=100, blank=True, default="")

    father_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, default="")
    mother_maiden_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, default="")
    guardian_name = models.CharField(max_length=200, blank=True, default="")
    guardian_relationship = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, default="")
    parent_contact = models.CharField(max_length=50, db_index=True)
    parent_user = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name="children"
    )

    photo = models.ImageField(upload_to="students/", null=True, blank=True)
    photo_thumbnail = models.CharField(max_length=255, null=True, blank=True)
    photo_updated_at = models.DateTimeField(null=True, blank=True)

    qr_token = models.CharField(max_length=128, unique=True, db_index=True)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name="created_students"
    )
    updated_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True, related_name="updated_students"
    )

    class Meta:
        db_table = "students"
        ordering = ["last_name", "first_name"]

    @property
    def full_name(self) -> str:
        mid = f" {self.middle_name[:1]}." if self.middle_name else ""
        suf = f" {self.suffix}" if self.suffix else ""
        return f"{self.last_name}, {self.first_name}{mid}{suf}".strip()

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if self.parent_contact:
            self.parent_contact = normalize_ph_phone(self.parent_contact)[:50]
        if not self.qr_token:
            self.qr_token = secrets.token_urlsafe(24)
        if not self.parent_user_id and self.parent_contact:
            from apps.accounts.models import UserProfile

            matched = (
                UserProfile.objects.filter(role="PARENT", phone_number=self.parent_contact)
                .select_related("user")
                .first()
            )
            if matched:
                self.parent_user = matched.user
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.full_name} ({self.lrn})"


class Enrollment(models.Model):
    id = models.BigAutoField(primary_key=True)
    student = models.ForeignKey(Student, on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="enrollments")
    section = models.ForeignKey("school.Section", on_delete=models.CASCADE, related_name="enrollments")
    school_year = models.ForeignKey(
        "school.SchoolYear", on_delete=models.CASCADE, db_column="academic_year_id", related_name="enrollments"
    )
    # Uses timezone.localdate so DRF DateField never fails AssertionError on datetime instances
    enrollment_date = models.DateField(default=timezone.localdate)
    enrollment_type = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=ENROLLMENT_TYPE_CHOICES, default="REGULAR")
    status = models.CharField(max_length=20, choices=ENROLLMENT_STATUS_CHOICES, default="ENROLLED")
    status_date = models.DateField(null=True, blank=True)
    status_reason_code = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, default="")
    transferred_school = models.CharField(max_length=255, blank=True, default="")
    is_cct_recipient = models.BooleanField(default=False)
    cct_id_number = models.CharField(max_length=50, blank=True, default="")
    disability_detail = models.CharField(max_length=150, blank=True, default="")
    accelerated_detail = models.CharField(max_length=150, blank=True, default="")
    remarks = models.TextField(blank=True, default="")
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = "enrollments"
        constraints = [
            UniqueConstraint(fields=["student", "school_year"], name="uq_student_school_year")
        ]

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        if isinstance(self.enrollment_date, datetime):
            self.enrollment_date = (
                timezone.localtime(self.enrollment_date).date()
                if timezone.is_aware(self.enrollment_date)
                else self.enrollment_date.date()
            )
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)
