interface DashboardViewProps {
  isServerOnline?: boolean;
  userRole?: string;
  onStatusChange?: (online: boolean) => void;
  onManualRefresh?: () => void;
  onNavigateTab?: (tab: string, report?: string) => void;
}

interface HourlyBar {
  hour: string;
  count: number;
  height: number;
  is_peak: boolean;
}

interface RecentScanItem {
  person_name: string;
  grade_section: string;
  scan_time: string;
}

interface NoticeItem {
  id: number | string;
  title: string;
  details: string;
}

interface DashboardState {
  total_students: number;
  students_present: number;
  students_absent: number;
  attendance_rate: number;
  faculty_on_duty: number;
  total_faculty: number;
  classroom_scans_today: number;
  active_exit_passes: number;
  push_alerts_today: number;
  mobile_parents_connected: number;
  hourly_scans: HourlyBar[];
  recent_scans: RecentScanItem[];
  notices: NoticeItem[];
}

const EMPTY_DASHBOARD: DashboardState = {
  total_students: 0,
  students_present: 0,
  students_absent: 0,
  attendance_rate: 0,
  faculty_on_duty: 0,
  total_faculty: 0,
  classroom_scans_today: 0,
  active_exit_passes: 0,
  push_alerts_today: 0,
  mobile_parents_connected: 0,
  hourly_scans: [],
  recent_scans: [],
  notices: [],
};

const normalizeDashboardPayload = (d: Record<string, any> | undefined): DashboardState => {
  if (!d) return EMPTY_DASHBOARD;
  const total = Number(d.total_students) || 0;
  const present = Number(d.students_present) || 0;
  const rawHourly = Array.isArray(d.hourly_scans) ? d.hourly_scans : [];
  const maxCount = Math.max(...rawHourly.map((h: any) => Number(h.count) || 0), 1);

  return {
    total_students: total,
    students_present: present,
    students_absent: Number(d.students_absent) || Math.max(0, total - present),
    attendance_rate: total > 0 ? Math.round((present / total) * 100) : Number(d.attendance_rate) || 0,
    faculty_on_duty: Number(d.faculty_on_duty) || 0,
    total_faculty: Number(d.total_faculty) || 0,
    classroom_scans_today: Number(d.classroom_scans_today ?? d.gate_scans_today) || 0,
    active_exit_passes: Number(d.active_exit_passes ?? d.active_gate_passes) || 0,
    push_alerts_today: Number(d.push_alerts_today ?? d.push_sent_today) || 0,
    mobile_parents_connected: Number(d.mobile_parents_connected) || 0,
    hourly_scans: rawHourly.map((h: any) => {
      const c = Number(h.count) || 0;
      return {
        hour: String(h.hour || ''),
        count: c,
        height: c > 0 ? Math.round((c / maxCount) * 100) : 0,
        is_peak: Boolean(h.is_peak),
      };
    }),
    recent_scans: Array.isArray(d.recent_scans) ? d.recent_scans : [],
    notices: Array.isArray(d.notices) ? d.notices : [],
  };
};

export const DashboardView: React.FC<DashboardViewProps> = ({
  isServerOnline = true,
  userRole,
  onStatusChange,
  onManualRefresh,
  onNavigateTab,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = useTheme();
  const { term } = useCompliance();

  const warmPayload = useMemo(
    () => peekApiCache<Record<string, any>>(API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard),
    []
  );

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => warmPayload === undefined);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [lastSyncTime, setLastSyncTime] = useState<string>(() =>
    warmPayload ? new Date().toLocaleTimeString() : ''
  );
  const [fetchFailed, setFetchFailed] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [calendarDate, setCalendarDate] = useState<Date>(() => new Date());
  const [data, setData] = useState<DashboardState>(() =>
    normalizeDashboardPayload(warmPayload)
  );

  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const role = (userRole || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
  const isAdmin = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL'].includes(role);
  const isFaculty = role === 'FACULTY';
  const isOnline = isServerOnline && !fetchFailed;

  useEffect(() => {
    return subscribeApiCache(API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard, undefined, (freshRaw) => {
      setData(normalizeDashboardPayload(freshRaw as Record<string, any>));
      setLastSyncTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, []);

  const navigateTo = (tab: string, report?: string) => {
    if (onNavigateTab) {
      onNavigateTab(tab, report);
      return;
    }
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('attendsure:navigate', { detail: report ? { tab, report } : tab }));
  };

  const fetchDashboardData = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      try {
        if (!silent) setRefreshing(true);
        const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.reports.dashboard, {
          params: {
            silent: silent ? '1' : undefined,
            ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });

        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        if (res.data) {
          setFetchFailed(false);
          setData(normalizeDashboardPayload(res.data));
          setLastSyncTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
          onStatusChange?.(true);
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (
          controller.signal.aborted ||
          anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
          anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
          anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
        ) {
          return;
        }
        setFetchFailed(true);
        onStatusChange?.(false);
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [onStatusChange]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchDashboardData(warmPayload !== undefined, false);
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        void fetchDashboardData(true, true);
      }
    }, 20000);
    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchDashboardData, warmPayload]);

  const calendarDays = useMemo(() => {
    const y = calendarDate.getFullYear();
    const m = calendarDate.getMonth();
    const firstDay = new Date(y, m, 1).getDay();
    const totalDays = new Date(y, m + 1, 0).getDate();
    const now = new Date();
    return [
      ...Array.from({ length: firstDay }, () => ({ day: null as number | null, isToday: false })),
      ...Array.from({ length: totalDays }, (_, i) => ({
        day: i + 1,
        isToday: now.getFullYear() === y && now.getMonth() === m && now.getDate() === i + 1,
      })),
    ];
  }, [calendarDate]);

  const quickActions = [
    { label: 'UN SDG Impact & Safety', desc: 'Early-warning, Ed-Fi & Roll-Call', icon: <Globe size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo('impact') },
    { label: 'QR Scanner', desc: 'Scan signed student QR ID card', icon: <QrCode size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo('classroom-scanner') },
    { label: isFaculty ? 'Student Exit Permit' : 'Exit Passes', desc: 'Student exit & faculty travel', icon: <Ticket size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo('gate-passes') },
    {
      label: term('Daily Attendance Register', 'Daily Attendance (SF2)'),
      desc: term('Exportable attendance register', 'Official DepEd register'),
      icon: <CalendarCheck size={19} />,
      onClick: () => navigateTo('reports', 'sf2'),
    },
    {
      label: term('Staff Timesheets', 'Monthly DTR'),
      desc: term('GPS-verified faculty hours', 'CSC Form 48 work hours'),
      icon: <Clock size={19} />,
      onClick: () => navigateTo('dtr'),
    },
    { label: isFaculty ? 'My Classes' : 'Class Lists', desc: 'Enrolled students by section', icon: isFaculty ? <BookOpen size={19} /> : <Users size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo(isFaculty ? 'my-classes' : 'students') },
    ...(isAdmin ? [{ label: 'Push Alerts', desc: 'Send mobile alerts to parents', icon: <Send size={19} />, onClick: () => navigateTo('push') }] : []),
  ];

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{ padding: 48, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
        <RefreshCw size={22} className="animate-spin" style={{ margin: '0 auto 8px', display: 'block', color: brand.primary }} />
        <span>Loading dashboard...</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ height: '100%', overflowY: 'auto', backgroundColor: tokens.bgCanvas, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}>
      <div style={{ maxWidth: 1380, margin: '0 auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
        <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: '10px 16px', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <span style={ui.badge(isOnline ? tokens.successLight : tokens.dangerLight, isOnline ? brand.success : brand.danger)}>
              ● {isOnline ? 'ONLINE' : 'OFFLINE'}
            </span>
            {isAdmin && (
              <>
                <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5 }}>
                  <Database size={13} color={brand.primary} /> Database: {isOnline ? 'Connected' : 'Offline'}
                </span>
                <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5 }}>
                  <Radio size={13} color={brand.primary} /> Push Alerts Today: {data.push_alerts_today.toLocaleString()} &bull; Parents Linked: {data.mobile_parents_connected.toLocaleString()}
                </span>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
            {lastSyncTime && <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted, fontFamily: fonts.mono }}>Updated: {lastSyncTime}</span>}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                void fetchDashboardData(false, true);
                onManualRefresh?.();
              }}
              disabled={refreshing}
              style={ui.btnSecondary}
            >
              <RefreshCw size={13} className={refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''} /> {refreshing ? 'Updating...' : 'Refresh'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 210px), 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
          <StatsCard
            label="STUDENTS IN CLASS"
            value={isOnline ? data.students_present.toLocaleString() : '—'}
            helpText={`${data.attendance_rate}% of ${data.total_students.toLocaleString()} students`}
            badge={<UserCheck size={18} color={brand.success} />}
          />
          <StatsCard
            label="NOT SCANNED TODAY"
            value={isOnline ? data.students_absent.toLocaleString() : '—'}

            badge={<UserX size={18} color={brand.danger} />}

export const EnterpriseSDGWidget: React.FC = () => {

  const userRole = (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
  const isLeader = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(userRole);

  const { data: sdgData, loading: loadingSdg, reload: reloadSdg } = useApiResource<any>(
    API_ROUTES.reports.sdgImpact,
    null
  );
  const { data: sardoData, loading: loadingSardo, reload: reloadSardo } = useApiResource<any>(
    API_ROUTES.reports.dropoutRisk,
    null
  );

  const [showAtRiskList, setShowAtRiskList] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [rollCallOpen, setRollCallOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [rollCallLoading, setRollCallLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [rollCallData, setRollCallData] = useState<EmergencyRollCallData | null>(null);
  const [rollCallSearch, setRollCallSearch] = useState<string>('');
  const [safeStudentIds, setSafeStudentIds] = useState<Record<number, boolean>>({});
  const [exportingEdFi, setExportingEdFi] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [anonymizeEdFi, setAnonymizeEdFi] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [exportStatus, setExportStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const rollCallAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const exportAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const revokeTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      rollCallAbortRef.current?.abort();
      exportAbortRef.current?.abort();
      if (revokeTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(revokeTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const loading = loadingSdg || loadingSardo;
  const purpleAccent = mode === 'dark' ? '#c084fc' : '#7c3aed';
  const purpleBg = mode === 'dark' ? 'rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.16)' : 'rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.12)';
  const dangerSolidBg = mode === 'dark' ? '#dc2626' : brand.danger;

  const handleRefresh = () => {
    void reloadSdg(false, true);
    void reloadSardo(false, true);
  };

  const handleOpenEmergencyRollCall = async () => {
    rollCallAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    rollCallAbortRef.current = controller;

    setRollCallOpen(true);
    setRollCallLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.campus.rollCall, {
        params: { nocache: 1 },
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      setRollCallData(res.data);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      setRollCallData(null);
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setRollCallLoading(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleCloseEmergencyRollCall = () => {
    rollCallAbortRef.current?.abort();
    setRollCallOpen(false);
  };

  const toggleStudentSafe = (studentId: number) => {
    setSafeStudentIds((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [studentId]: !prev[studentId],
    }));
  };

  const handleExportEdFi = async () => {
    exportAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    exportAbortRef.current = controller;

    setExportingEdFi(true);
    setExportStatus(null);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.reports.edfiExport, {
        params: {
          days: 30,
          anonymize: anonymizeEdFi ? 1 : 0,
        },
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

      const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(res.data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      const modeTag = anonymizeEdFi ? 'gdpr_pseudonymized' : 'standard';
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `attendsure_edfi_${modeTag}_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.json`;
      a.click();
      if (revokeTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(revokeTimerRef.current);
      revokeTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      }, 1000);

      const eventCount = res.data?.recordCounts?.studentSchoolAttendanceEvents ?? 0;
      setExportStatus(
        `Exported Ed-Fi bundle (${eventCount} attendance events • ${
          anonymizeEdFi ? 'GDPR Pseudonymized' : 'Standard Institutional'
        }).`
      );
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      setExportStatus(
        extractApiError(err, 'Ed-Fi export requires School Leadership permissions (Admin / Principal).')
      );
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setExportingEdFi(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const filteredRollCallStudents = useMemo(() => {
    const list = rollCallData?.students || [];
    const q = rollCallSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return list;
    return list.filter(
      (s) =>
        s.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        s.lrn.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        s.section.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [rollCallData, rollCallSearch]);

  const safeCount = useMemo(() => {
    if (!rollCallData?.students) return 0;
    return rollCallData.students.filter((s) => Boolean(safeStudentIds[s.student_id])).length;
  }, [rollCallData, safeStudentIds]);

  const sdg4 = sdgData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_4_quality_education;
  const sdg5 = sdgData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_5_and_10_equality_and_inclusion;
  const sdg8 = sdgData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_8_decent_work;
  const sdg12 = sdgData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_12_and_13_climate_and_sustainability;
  const sdg16 = sdgData?.sdg_metrics?.sdg_16_accountable_institutions;
  const atRiskStudents = Array.isArray(sardoData?.at_risk_students) ? sardoData.at_risk_students : [];

  return (
    <div style={{ ...containerStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle }}>
      {/* Top Action Header */}
      <div style={headerBarStyle}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 4 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <span style={{ ...badgePillStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight, color: brand.primary }}>
              <Globe size={13} /> UN SDG IMPACT &amp; SAFETY COMMAND CENTER
            </span>
            <span style={{ ...privacyPillStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.successLight, color: brand.success }}>
              <ShieldCheck size={13} />{' '}
              {term(
                'Global Ed-Fi • GDPR Art. 25 • FERPA & COPPA Ready',
                'DepEd PH • RA 10173 & GDPR Compliant • Pure Software'
              )}
            </span>
          </div>
          <h3 style={{ margin: '4px 0 0', fontSize: '1.08rem', fontWeight: 900, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
            {term(
              'UN Sustainable Development Goals, Dropout Early-Warning & Emergency Roll-Call',
              'UN SDG Impact, SARDO Early-Warning & Emergency Campus Roll-Call'
            )}
          </h3>
          <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.78rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            Pure-Software Campus Platform &bull; Live school data from USB QR Scans, Mobile Face &amp; GPS Check-Ins, and Parent Push Alerts
          </p>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleOpenEmergencyRollCall}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 6,
              padding: '7px 13px',
              borderRadius: 8,
              border: 'none',
              backgroundColor: dangerSolidBg,
              color: '#ffffff',
              fontSize: '0.76rem',
              fontWeight: 800,
              cursor: 'pointer',
            }}
          >
            <ShieldAlert size={14} /> Emergency Campus Roll-Call
          </button>

          {isLeader && (
            <>
              <label
                title="GDPR Art. 25 Pseudonymization replaces student and staff personal identifiers with privacy-safe codes in Ed-Fi exports"
                style={{
                  display: 'inline-flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 6,
                  padding: '6px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                  fontSize: '0.72rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                }}
              >
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={anonymizeEdFi}
                  onChange={(e) => setAnonymizeEdFi(e.target.checked)}
                  style={{ accentColor: brand.success }}
                />
                <Lock size={12} color={brand.success} /> GDPR Anonymize
              </label>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleExportEdFi}
                disabled={exportingEdFi}
                style={{
                  ...secondaryBtnStyle,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
                  borderColor: brand.primary,
                  color: brand.primary,
                }}
              >
                <Download size={14} /> {exportingEdFi ? 'Exporting...' : 'Export Ed-Fi JSON'}
              </button>
            </>
          )}

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleRefresh}
            disabled={loading}
            style={{
              ...secondaryBtnStyle,
              backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
              borderColor: tokens.borderStrong,
              color: tokens.textPrimary,
            }}
          >
            <RefreshCw size={14} className={loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''} /> {loading ? 'Updating...' : 'Refresh'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {exportStatus && (
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            padding: '8px 12px',
            borderRadius: 8,
            backgroundColor: tokens.successLight,
            color: brand.success,
            fontSize: '0.76rem',
            fontWeight: 700,
          }}
        >
          <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={14} /> {exportStatus}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setExportStatus(null)}
            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.success, cursor: 'pointer' }}
          >
            <X size={14} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Emergency Campus Roll-Call Panel (SDG 11) */}
      {rollCallOpen && (
        <div
          style={{
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
            border: `2px solid ${brand.danger}`,
            borderRadius: 10,
            padding: 16,
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: 12,
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8 }}>
            <div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.95rem', fontWeight: 800, color: brand.danger, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
                <ShieldAlert size={18} /> SDG 11 &bull; EMERGENCY EVACUATION CAMPUS ROLL-CALL
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                {rollCallData
                  ? `Snapshot as of ${rollCallData.timestamp} • ${rollCallData.total_people_on_campus} People Verified on Campus`
                  : 'Loading live campus headcount...'}
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleCloseEmergencyRollCall}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 4,
                padding: '5px 10px',
                borderRadius: 6,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
                color: brand.danger,
                fontWeight: 700,
                fontSize: '0.75rem',
                cursor: 'pointer',
              }}
            >
              <X size={14} /> Close Roll-Call
            </button>
          </div>

          {rollCallLoading ? (
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, fontWeight: 700 }}>
              Fetching active student and faculty headcount...
            </div>
          ) : rollCallData ? (
            <>
              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(170px, 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
                <div style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, padding: 10, borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textMuted }}>STUDENTS ON CAMPUS</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '1.3rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{rollCallData.students_count}</div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, padding: 10, borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', fontWeight: 800, color: brand.success }}>CHECKED SAFE AT ASSEMBLY</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '1.3rem', fontWeight: 800, color: brand.success }}>{safeCount}</div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, padding: 10, borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', fontWeight: 800, color: brand.danger }}>UNACCOUNTED FOR</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '1.3rem', fontWeight: 800, color: brand.danger }}>
                    {Math.max(0, rollCallData.students_count - safeCount)}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, padding: 10, borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', fontWeight: 800, color: brand.primary }}>FACULTY ON CAMPUS</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '1.3rem', fontWeight: 800, color: brand.primary }}>{rollCallData.faculty_count}</div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <input
                type="text"
                maxLength={80}
                value={rollCallSearch}
                onChange={(e) => setRollCallSearch(e.target.value.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, ''))}
                placeholder={term(
                  'Filter student class list by name, Student ID, or class section...',
                  'Filter student class list by name, LRN, or section...'
                )}
                style={{
                  padding: '8px 12px',
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                  fontSize: '0.82rem',
                }}
              />

              <div style={{ maxHeight: 240, overflowY: 'auto', backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                {filteredRollCallStudents.length === 0 ? (
                  <div style={{ padding: 12, fontSize: '0.8rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                    No students currently checked in on campus today.
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  filteredRollCallStudents.map((st) => {
                    const isSafe = Boolean(safeStudentIds[st.student_id]);
                    return (
                      <label
                        key={st.student_id}
                        style={{
                          display: 'flex',
                          alignItems: 'center',
                          justifyContent: 'space-between',
                          padding: '8px 12px',
                          borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                          backgroundColor: isSafe ? tokens.successLight : tokens.bgSurface,
                          cursor: 'pointer',
                          fontSize: '0.8rem',
                        }}
                      >
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                          <input
                            type="checkbox"
                            checked={isSafe}
                            onChange={() => toggleStudentSafe(st.student_id)}
                            style={{ width: 16, height: 16, accentColor: brand.success }}
                          />
                          <div>
                            <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{st.full_name}</strong>
                            <span style={{ color: tokens.textSecondary, marginLeft: 8 }}>
                              {term('ID', 'LRN')}: {st.lrn} &bull; {st.section}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <span
                          style={{
                            fontSize: '0.7rem',
                            fontWeight: 800,
                            color: isSafe ? brand.success : brand.danger,
                          }}
                        >
                          {isSafe ? 'SAFE' : 'UNACCOUNTED'}
                        </span>
                      </label>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </div>
            </>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 5 UN SDG Live Impact Cards */}
      <div style={cardsGridStyle}>
        <div style={{ ...cardStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <span style={{ ...sdgTagStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight, color: brand.danger }}>
              SDG 4 &bull; QUALITY EDUCATION
            </span>
            <Award size={18} color={brand.danger} />
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metricValueStyle, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
            {loading ? '...' : (sdg4?.verified_classroom_qr_scans ?? 0).toLocaleString()}
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metricSubStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            Verified Signed Classroom QR Scans ({sdg4?.attendance_rate_today ?? 0}% Present Today)
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...dividerStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.borderSubtle }} />
          <div style={{ ...metaRowStyle, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            <span>{term('Critical Dropout Risk:', 'Critical SARDO Risk:')}</span>
            <strong style={{ color: brand.danger }}>{sardoData?.critical_sardo_count ?? 0} Learners</strong>
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metaRowStyle, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            <span>Early-Warning Watch:</span>
            <strong style={{ color: brand.warning }}>{sardoData?.early_warning_count ?? 0} Learners</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ ...cardStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <span style={{ ...sdgTagStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.infoLight, color: brand.secondary }}>
              SDG 5 &amp; 10 &bull; EQUALITY &amp; INCLUSION
            </span>
            <Users size={18} color={brand.secondary} />
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metricValueStyle, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
            {loading
              ? '...'
              : `${sdg5?.male_attendance_rate_today ?? 0}% M / ${sdg5?.female_attendance_rate_today ?? 0}% F`}
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metricSubStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            Live Gender Parity Index: {sdg5?.gender_parity_index ?? '1.00'}
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...dividerStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.borderSubtle }} />
          <div style={{ ...metaRowStyle, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            <span>Enrolled Male / Female:</span>
            <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
              {sdg5?.male_learners ?? 0} M &bull; {sdg5?.female_learners ?? 0} F
            </strong>
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metaRowStyle, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            <span>{term('Social Aid / CCT Monitored:', '4Ps / CCT Beneficiaries:')}</span>
            <strong style={{ color: brand.secondary }}>{sdg5?.cct_4ps_beneficiaries_monitored ?? 0} Learners</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ ...cardStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <span style={{ ...sdgTagStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.warningLight, color: brand.warning }}>
              SDG 8 &bull; DECENT WORK &amp; SAVINGS
            </span>
            <Briefcase size={18} color={brand.warning} />
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metricValueStyle, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
            {loading ? '...' : `${sdg8?.faculty_hours_saved_monthly ?? 0} hrs/mo`}
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metricSubStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            Faculty Clerical Workload Saved Automatically
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...dividerStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.borderSubtle }} />
          <div style={{ ...metaRowStyle, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            <span>Pure-Software Savings:</span>
            <strong style={{ color: brand.success }}>
              {isGlobalMode
                ? `$${(sdg8?.zero_hardware_capex_saved_usd ?? 0).toLocaleString()} USD`
                : `PHP ${((sdg8?.zero_hardware_capex_saved_usd ?? 0) * 56).toLocaleString()}`}
            </strong>
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metaRowStyle, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            <span>Active Class Schedules:</span>
            <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{sdg8?.active_schedules ?? 0} Periods</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ ...cardStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <span style={{ ...sdgTagStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.successLight, color: brand.success }}>
              SDG 12 &amp; 13 &bull; CLIMATE ACTION
            </span>
            <Leaf size={18} color={brand.success} />
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metricValueStyle, color: brand.success }}>
            {loading ? '...' : `${sdg12?.estimated_co2_reduced_kg ?? 0} kg CO2e`}
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metricSubStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            Carbon Reduced &amp; {sdg12?.hardware_ewaste_avoided_kg ?? 0} kg Hardware Waste Avoided
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...dividerStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.borderSubtle }} />
          <div style={{ ...metaRowStyle, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            <span>Paper Sheets Saved:</span>
            <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{(sdg12?.paper_sheets_saved ?? 0).toLocaleString()} Sheets</strong>
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metaRowStyle, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            <span>Est. Annual Savings:</span>
            <strong style={{ color: brand.success }}>
              {isGlobalMode
                ? `$${(sdg12?.estimated_annual_savings_usd ?? 0).toLocaleString()} USD`
                : `PHP ${(sdg12?.estimated_annual_savings_php ?? 0).toLocaleString()}`}
            </strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ ...cardStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center' }}>
            <span style={{ ...sdgTagStyle, backgroundColor: purpleBg, color: purpleAccent }}>
              SDG 16 &bull; ACCOUNTABLE SCHOOLS
            </span>
            <Smartphone size={18} color={purpleAccent} />
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metricValueStyle, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
            {loading
              ? '...'
              : `${sdg16?.faculty_face_gps_verified_today ?? 0} / ${sdg16?.total_active_faculty ?? 0}`}
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metricSubStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            Faculty Verified via On-Device Face &amp; Campus GPS Today
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...dividerStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.borderSubtle }} />
          <div style={{ ...metaRowStyle, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            <span>Parent Push Alerts:</span>
            <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
              {(sdg12?.mobile_push_alerts_delivered ?? 0).toLocaleString()} Delivered
            </strong>
          </div>
          <div style={{ ...metaRowStyle, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
            <span>Audit Logs (Month):</span>
            <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
              {(sdg16?.tamper_evident_audit_logs_this_month ?? 0).toLocaleString()} Records
            </strong>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Dropout Early-Warning Section */}
      <div style={{ ...sardoBoxStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 8 }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            <AlertTriangle size={17} color={atRiskStudents.length > 0 ? brand.danger : brand.success} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
              {term(
                `At-Risk Dropout Early-Warning Class List (Last 30 Days: ${atRiskStudents.length} Flagged)`,
                `SARDO Dropout Early-Warning Class List (Last 30 Days: ${atRiskStudents.length} Flagged)`
              )}
            </span>
          </div>
          {atRiskStudents.length > 0 && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setShowAtRiskList(!showAtRiskList)}
              style={{
                ...toggleBtnStyle,
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
                borderColor: tokens.borderStrong,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
              }}
            >
              {showAtRiskList ? 'Hide Class List' : 'Show Class List'}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {atRiskStudents.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ ...healthyBannerStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.successLight, color: brand.success }}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={16} color={brand.success} />
            <span>
              Zero students are currently at risk of dropping out over the last 30 days. All class lists have healthy attendance.
            </span>
          </div>
        ) : (
          showAtRiskList && (
            <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto', marginTop: 10 }}>
              <table style={{ ...tableStyle, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface }}>
                <thead>
                  <tr style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, textAlign: 'left' }}>
                    <th style={{ ...thStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                      {term('Student Name & ID', "Learner Name & LRN")}
                    </th>
                    <th style={{ ...thStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>Grade &amp; Section</th>
                    <th style={{ ...thStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>30-Day Attendance</th>
                    <th style={{ ...thStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>Risk Score</th>
                    <th style={{ ...thStyle, color: tokens.textMuted }}>Recommended Intervention</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {atRiskStudents.slice(0, 12).map((st: any) => {
                    const isCritical = st.risk_level === 'CRITICAL_SARDO';
                    return (
                      <tr key={st.student_id} style={{ borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                        <td style={tdStyle}>
                          <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{st.full_name}</div>
                          <div style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                            {term('ID', 'LRN')}: {st.lrn}{' '}
                            {st.is_4ps_beneficiary ? term('• Social Aid Recipient', '• 4Ps Beneficiary') : ''}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ ...tdStyle, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{st.section}</td>
                        <td style={tdStyle}>
                          <span style={{ color: brand.danger, fontWeight: 700 }}>{st.absent_days_30d} Absent</span>
                          {' • '}
                          <span style={{ color: brand.warning, fontWeight: 700 }}>{st.cutting_days_30d} Cutting</span>
                          {' • '}
                          <span style={{ color: tokens.textMuted }}>{st.late_days_30d} Late</span>
                        </td>
                        <td style={tdStyle}>
                          <span
                            style={{
                              padding: '3px 8px',
                              borderRadius: 10,
                              fontSize: '0.68rem',
                              fontWeight: 800,
                              backgroundColor: isCritical ? tokens.dangerLight : tokens.warningLight,
                              color: isCritical ? brand.danger : brand.warning,
                              border: `1px solid ${isCritical ? brand.danger : brand.warning}`,
                            }}
                          >
                            {isCritical ? term('CRITICAL RISK', 'CRITICAL SARDO') : 'EARLY WARNING'} ({st.risk_score}%)
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ ...tdStyle, fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                          {st.recommended_intervention}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

interface CurrentUserAccountData {
  id?: number;
  username?: string;
  employee_id?: string | null;
  lrn?: string | null;
  position?: string | null;
  department?: string | null;
  qr_payload?: string | null;
}

const sanitizePlainText = (raw: unknown, maxLen = 100): string =>
  String(raw ?? '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLen);

export const Header: React.FC<HeaderProps> = ({
  title,
  isSystemOnline,
  session,
  userPhoto,
  schoolName,
  schoolId,
  onLogout,
  onNavigateTab,
  onOpenProfile,
}) => {
  const themeCtx = useTheme();
  const { mode, tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = themeCtx;
  const complianceCtx = useCompliance() as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;

  const activeComplianceMode = useMemo(() => {
    const raw =
      complianceCtx.standard ??
      complianceCtx.complianceMode ??
      complianceCtx.regionMode ??
      complianceCtx.mode ??
      'DEPED_PH';
    return String(raw).toUpperCase().includes('GLOBAL') ? 'GLOBAL' : 'DEPED_PH';
  }, [complianceCtx]);

  const handleToggleTheme = useCallback(() => {
    const rawTheme = themeCtx as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (typeof rawTheme.toggleTheme === 'function') {
      (rawTheme.toggleTheme as () => void)();
    } else if (typeof rawTheme.toggleMode === 'function') {
      (rawTheme.toggleMode as () => void)();
    } else if (typeof rawTheme.setMode === 'function') {
      (rawTheme.setMode as (next: 'light' | 'dark') => void)(mode === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark');
    }
  }, [themeCtx, mode]);

  const handleToggleCompliance = useCallback(() => {
    const next = activeComplianceMode === 'DEPED_PH' ? 'GLOBAL' : 'DEPED_PH';
    if (typeof complianceCtx.toggleStandard === 'function') {
      (complianceCtx.toggleStandard as () => void)();
    } else if (typeof complianceCtx.toggleMode === 'function') {
      (complianceCtx.toggleMode as () => void)();
    } else if (typeof complianceCtx.setStandard === 'function') {
      (complianceCtx.setStandard as (val: string) => void)(next);
    } else if (typeof complianceCtx.setComplianceMode === 'function') {
      (complianceCtx.setComplianceMode as (val: string) => void)(next);
    } else if (typeof complianceCtx.setMode === 'function') {
      (complianceCtx.setMode as (val: string) => void)(next);
    }
  }, [complianceCtx, activeComplianceMode]);

  const [isPassModalOpen, setIsPassModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isUserMenuOpen, setIsUserMenuOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [unreadCount, setUnreadCount] = useState<number>(0);

  const cachedMe = peekApiCache<CurrentUserAccountData>(API_ROUTES.accounts.me);
  const [accountMeta, setAccountMeta] = useState<CurrentUserAccountData | null>(cachedMe || null);

  const userMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const copyTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const roleUpper = useMemo(
    () =>
      sanitizePlainText(
        session?.role || localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY',
        30
      ).toUpperCase(),
    [session?.role]
  );

  const isStudentAccount = roleUpper === 'STUDENT';
  const canOpenSettings = ['SUPERADMIN', 'ADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL'].includes(roleUpper);

  const fetchAccountAndAlerts = useCallback(
    async (signal?: AbortSignal) => {
      if (!session?.token) return;

      const [meRes, notifRes] = await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient.get<CurrentUserAccountData>(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, { signal }),
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.messaging.notifications, {
          params: { page_size: 20 },
          signal,
        }),
      ]);

      if (signal?.aborted) return;

      if (meRes.status === 'fulfilled' && meRes.value?.data) {
        setAccountMeta(meRes.value.data);
      }

      if (notifRes.status === 'fulfilled' && notifRes.value?.data) {
        const payload = notifRes.value.data;
        const items: Array<{ is_read?: boolean }> = Array.isArray(payload)
          ? payload
          : Array.isArray(payload?.results)
            ? payload.results
            : [];
        const unread =
          typeof payload?.unread_count === 'number'
            ? payload.unread_count
            : items.filter((item) => item && item.is_read === false).length;
        setUnreadCount(unread);
      }
    },

  );

    const controller = new AbortController();
    void fetchAccountAndAlerts(controller.signal);

    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        void fetchAccountAndAlerts();
      }
    }, 30000);

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
      clearInterval(interval);
      if (copyTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [fetchAccountAndAlerts]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isUserMenuOpen) return;

    const handleOutsideClick = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (userMenuRef.current && !userMenuRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {

    };
    const handleEsc = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {

      }

    return isStudentAccount

      : `ATTENDSURE:FACULTY:${badgeIdValue}`;
  }, [accountMeta?.qr_payload, isStudentAccount, badgeIdValue]);

  const handleCopyIdentifier = async () => {
    if (!badgeIdValue) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(badgeIdValue);
      setCopiedId(true);
      if (copyTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
      copyTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setCopiedId(false);
        copyTimerRef.current = null;

      // Ignore clipboard permission denial
    }

        }}
      >

          <h1
            style={{

            ) : (

            )}
          </button>

                borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,

                  <strong style={{ color: brand.success }}>Active</strong>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, marginTop: 16 }}>
            <Button variant="secondary" type="button" onClick={() => setIsPassModalOpen(false)}>
              Close
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              type="button"
              onClick={() => window.print()}
              icon={<Printer size={14} />}
            >
              Print Pass
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Modal>
    </>
  );
};

export default Header;

interface SidebarProps {
  activeTab: NavItemKey;
  onSelectTab: (tab: NavItemKey) => void;
  onPrefetchTab?: (tab: NavItemKey) => void;
  session?: UserSession | null;

  schoolName?: string;
  schoolId?: string;
  schoolLogo?: string | null;
  canTeach?: boolean;
  allowedTabs?: NavItemKey[];
  badgeCounts?: TabBadgeCounts;

interface NavItem {
  key: NavItemKey;
  label: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
}

interface NavGroup {
  groupTitle: string;
  items: NavItem[];

const getSchoolAbbreviation = (name?: string): string => {
  if (!name || !name.trim()) return 'AS';
  const ignore = new Set(['of', 'the', 'and', 'in', 'at', 'for', 'to', 'ng', 'sa']);
  const words = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter((w) => !ignore.has(w.toLowerCase()));
  return words.length === 1
    ? words[0].slice(0, 4).toUpperCase()
    : words.map((w) => w[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 6);
};

const formatBadge = (count?: number): string => {
  if (!count || count <= 0) return '';
  return count > 99 ? '99+' : String(count);
};

export const Sidebar: React.FC<SidebarProps> = ({

  const [liveBadges, setLiveBadges] = useState<TabBadgeCounts>({});
  const [internalCollapsed, setInternalCollapsed] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('attendsure_sidebar_collapsed') === 'true';
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  });

  const isCollapsed = controlledCollapsed !== undefined ? controlledCollapsed : internalCollapsed;

      const detail = (e as CustomEvent<TabBadgeCounts>).detail;
      if (detail) setLiveBadges(detail);

    window.addEventListener('attendsure:notifications-sync', onSync);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('attendsure:notifications-sync', onSync);
  }, []);

  const handleToggle = () => {

          { key: 'push', label: t('nav_push', 'Push Alerts'), icon: <Bell size={17} /> },
          { key: 'gate-passes', label: t('nav_gate_passes', 'Exit Passes'), icon: <Ticket size={17} /> },
          {
            key: 'dtr',
            label: isGlobalMode ? t('nav_dtr_global', 'Staff Timesheets') : t('nav_dtr_deped', 'Monthly DTR'),

        <div style={{ width: 30, height: 30, borderRadius: '50%', overflow: 'hidden', backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', flexShrink: 0 }}>
          {safeUserPhoto ? (
            <img src={safeUserPhoto} alt="User" style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />
          ) : (
            <span style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: '0.78rem', color: brand.primary }}>
              {(session?.faculty_name || session?.username || 'U').charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        {!isCollapsed && (
          <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
              {session?.faculty_name || session?.username || 'User'}
            </div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: '0.60rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textMuted }}>{role}</div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
};

export default Sidebar;

 * Manages Sections, Advisers, Schedules, Subject Faculty, Rooms, Subjects, and Grade Levels.

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';

export type TabType =
  | 'SECTIONS'
  | 'SCHEDULE'
  | 'SECTION'
  | 'ROOM'
  | 'ROOMS'
  | 'SUBJECT'
  | 'SUBJECTS'
  | 'GRADES'
  | 'YEARS'
  | 'HOLIDAYS';

export interface AcademicSetupModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUpdated?: () => void;
  onSuccess?: () => void;
  initialTab?: TabType;
  editItem?: any;
}

type ActiveSubTab = 'SECTIONS' | 'SCHEDULE' | 'ROOMS' | 'SUBJECTS' | 'GRADES' | 'YEARS' | 'HOLIDAYS';

const normalizeTab = (tab: TabType): ActiveSubTab => {
  if (tab === 'SECTION' || tab === 'SECTIONS') return 'SECTIONS';
  if (tab === 'SCHEDULE') return 'SCHEDULE';
  if (tab === 'ROOM' || tab === 'ROOMS') return 'ROOMS';
  if (tab === 'SUBJECT' || tab === 'SUBJECTS') return 'SUBJECTS';
  if (tab === 'GRADES') return 'GRADES';
  if (tab === 'HOLIDAYS') return 'HOLIDAYS';
  return 'YEARS';
};

const sanitizeField = (raw: string, maxLength = 100): string =>
  String(raw || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '').slice(0, maxLength);

const extractFacultyId = (item: any): string => {
  if (!item) return '';
  const candidate =
    item.faculty_id ??
    (typeof item.faculty === 'object' && item.faculty ? item.faculty.id : item.faculty) ??
    '';
  return candidate !== null && candidate !== undefined ? String(candidate) : '';
};

const extractFacultyName = (item: any, facultyList: any[]): string => {
  if (!item) return 'Unassigned';
  const directName =
    item.faculty_name ||
    (typeof item.faculty === 'object' && item.faculty ? item.faculty.full_name || item.faculty.name : null);
  if (directName && String(directName).trim()) return String(directName).trim();

  const fid = extractFacultyId(item);
  if (fid) {
    const match = facultyList.find((f) => String(f.id) === fid);
    if (match) return match.full_name || match.name || 'Unassigned';
  }
  return 'Unassigned';
};

export const AcademicSetupModal: React.FC<AcademicSetupModalProps> = ({

  const { showConfirm } = useAlert();

  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const [holidays, setHolidays] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const [sectionForm, setSectionForm] = useState({

  const [scheduleForm, setScheduleForm] = useState({

    faculty_id: '',
    room_id: '',
    start_time: '07:30',
    end_time: '08:30',
    days_of_week: 'MON-FRI',

  const [simpleForm, setSimpleForm] = useState({

    name: '',
    building: '',

    title: '',
    units: 1,
    stage: 'JHS',
    level_order: 1,

    baseline_cutoff_date: '',
    end_date: '',
    is_active: true,
    holiday_date: '',
    holiday_type: 'HOLIDAY',
    holiday_reason: '',

  const resetSimpleForm = () =>
    setSimpleForm({
      id: null,
      code: '',
      name: '',
      building: '',
      capacity: 45,
      title: '',
      units: 1,
      stage: 'JHS',
      level_order: 1,
      start_date: '',
      baseline_cutoff_date: '',
      end_date: '',
      is_active: true,
      holiday_date: '',
      holiday_type: 'HOLIDAY',
      holiday_reason: '',

  useEffect(() => {

    if (editItem) {
      if (target === 'SECTIONS') {

        const gradeId =
          editItem.grade_level_id ??

            ? editItem.grade_level.id
            : editItem.grade_level) ??
          '';

        setSectionForm({
          id: editItem.id || null,
          name: editItem.name || editItem.section_name || '',
          grade_level: String(gradeId || ''),
          adviser_id: String(advId || ''),

        });
      } else if (target === 'SCHEDULE') {
        const secId =

          end_time: editItem.end_time ? String(editItem.end_time).slice(0, 5) : '08:30',

    try {

      const getData = (res: PromiseSettledResult<any>) =>

      setYears(getData(results[0]));

      setSchedules(getData(results[6]));
      setHolidays(getData(results[7]));
    } catch (err: unknown) {

    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {

      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [isOpen, loadData]);

  const handleSaveSection = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cleanName = sanitizeField(sectionForm.name, 80).trim();
    const cleanRoomNumber = sanitizeField(sectionForm.room_number, 50).trim();
    if (!cleanName) {
      setError('Section name is required.');
      return;
    }
    if (!sectionForm.grade_level) {
      setError('Please select a grade level.');
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    const adviserPk = sectionForm.adviser_id ? Number(sectionForm.adviser_id) : null;
    const payload = {
      name: cleanName,
      grade_level: Number(sectionForm.grade_level),
      adviser: adviserPk,
      adviser_id: adviserPk,
      room_number: cleanRoomNumber,
      capacity: Number(sectionForm.capacity) || 45,
    };

    try {
      if (sectionForm.id) {
        await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.sections}${sectionForm.id}/`, payload);
        setSuccessMessage('Section and Class Adviser updated.');
      } else {
        await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.sections, payload);
        setSuccessMessage('New section and Class Adviser saved.');
      }

      setSectionForm({ id: null, name: '', grade_level: '', adviser_id: '', room_number: '', capacity: 45 });
      await loadData();
      if (onUpdated) onUpdated();
      if (onSuccess) onSuccess();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(extractApiError(err, 'Failed to save section.'));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveSchedule = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!scheduleForm.section_id) {
      setError('Please select a class section.');
      return;
    }
    if (!scheduleForm.subject_id) {
      setError('Please select a subject.');
      return;
    }
    if (scheduleForm.start_time >= scheduleForm.end_time) {
      setError('End time must be later than start time.');
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    const facultyPk = scheduleForm.faculty_id ? Number(scheduleForm.faculty_id) : null;
    const roomPk = scheduleForm.room_id ? Number(scheduleForm.room_id) : null;

    const payload = {
      section: Number(scheduleForm.section_id),
      section_id: Number(scheduleForm.section_id),
      subject: Number(scheduleForm.subject_id),
      subject_id: Number(scheduleForm.subject_id),
      faculty: facultyPk,
      faculty_id: facultyPk,
      room: roomPk,
      room_id: roomPk,
      start_time: scheduleForm.start_time,
      end_time: scheduleForm.end_time,
      days_of_week: sanitizeField(scheduleForm.days_of_week || 'MON-FRI', 30).trim() || 'MON-FRI',

    try {

      setScheduleForm({
        id: null,

        subject_id: '',

        end_time: '08:30',
        days_of_week: 'MON-FRI',
      });

      if (onUpdated) onUpdated();
      if (onSuccess) onSuccess();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(extractApiError(err, 'Failed to save class schedule.'));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveSimpleItem = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    try {
      const isEdit = Boolean(simpleForm.id);
      if (activeSubTab === 'ROOMS') {
        const cleanRoomName = sanitizeField(simpleForm.name, 60).trim();
        const cleanBuilding = sanitizeField(simpleForm.building, 80).trim();
        if (!cleanRoomName) {
          setError('Room name is required.');
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        const payload = {
          name: cleanRoomName,
          building: cleanBuilding,
          capacity: Math.max(1, Number(simpleForm.capacity) || 45),

          await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.rooms}${simpleForm.id}/`, payload);
        } else {
          await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.rooms, payload);
        }
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS') {
        const cleanCode = sanitizeField(simpleForm.code, 30).trim().toUpperCase();
        const cleanTitle = sanitizeField(simpleForm.title, 100).trim();
        if (!cleanCode || !cleanTitle) {
          setError('Subject code and title are required.');
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        const payload = {
          code: cleanCode,
          title: cleanTitle,
          units: Math.max(1, Number(simpleForm.units) || 1),
        };
        if (isEdit) {
          await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.subjects}${simpleForm.id}/`, payload);
        } else {
          await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.subjects, payload);
        }
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'GRADES') {
        const cleanCode = sanitizeField(simpleForm.code, 20).trim().toUpperCase();
        const cleanName = sanitizeField(simpleForm.name, 60).trim();
        if (!cleanCode || !cleanName) {
          setError('Grade code and name are required.');
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        const payload = {
          code: cleanCode,
          name: cleanName,
          stage: sanitizeField(simpleForm.stage || 'JHS', 20).trim() || 'JHS',
          level_order: Number(simpleForm.level_order) || 1,
        };
        if (isEdit) {
          await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.school.gradeLevels}${simpleForm.id}/`, payload);
        } else {
          await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.school.gradeLevels, payload);
        }
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'YEARS') {
        const cleanCode = sanitizeField(simpleForm.code, 20).trim();
        if (!cleanCode || !simpleForm.start_date || !simpleForm.end_date) {
          setError('School year code, start date, and end date are required.');
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        const payload = {
          code: cleanCode,
          start_date: simpleForm.start_date,
          baseline_cutoff_date: simpleForm.baseline_cutoff_date || simpleForm.start_date,
          end_date: simpleForm.end_date,
          is_active: Boolean(simpleForm.is_active),
        };
        if (isEdit) {

        } else {

        }
      } else if (activeSubTab === 'HOLIDAYS') {
        const cleanReason = sanitizeField(simpleForm.holiday_reason, 140).trim();
        if (!simpleForm.holiday_date || !cleanReason) {

    } catch (err: unknown) {
      setError(extractApiError(err, 'Failed to save record.'));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteItem = (baseRoute: string, id: number, label = 'Record') => {
    showConfirm({
      title: `Delete ${label}`,

        setError(null);
        setSuccessMessage(null);

          await apiClient.delete(`${baseRoute}${id}/`);
          setSuccessMessage(`${label} deleted.`);

          if (onSuccess) onSuccess();
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, `Could not delete ${label.toLowerCase()}.`));
        }
      },
    });
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} title="Academic Structure & Faculty Assignments">
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
        {/* Navigation Tabs */}
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            gap: 8,
            borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
            paddingBottom: 8,
            overflowX: 'auto',
          }}
        >
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('SECTIONS'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'SECTIONS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Users size={14} /> Sections &amp; Advisers
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('SCHEDULE'); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'SCHEDULE', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Clock size={14} /> Schedules &amp; Subject Faculty
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('SUBJECTS'); resetSimpleForm(); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <BookOpen size={14} /> Subjects
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('ROOMS'); resetSimpleForm(); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'ROOMS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <DoorOpen size={14} /> Classrooms
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('GRADES'); resetSimpleForm(); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'GRADES', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Layers size={14} /> Grade Levels
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('YEARS'); resetSimpleForm(); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'YEARS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Calendar size={14} /> School Years
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setActiveSubTab('HOLIDAYS'); resetSimpleForm(); setError(null); setSuccessMessage(null); }}
            style={tabBtnStyle(activeSubTab === 'HOLIDAYS', brand.primary, tokens)}
          >
            <Calendar size={14} /> Holidays
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Status Alerts */}
        {loading && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" color={brand.primary} />
            <span>Loading academic records...</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {error && (
          <div style={alertBoxStyle(tokens.dangerLight, brand.danger)}>
            <AlertCircle size={15} />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {successMessage && (
          <div style={alertBoxStyle(tokens.successLight, brand.success)}>
            <CheckCircle2 size={15} />
            <span>{successMessage}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 1. SECTIONS & CLASS ADVISER FORM */}
        {activeSubTab === 'SECTIONS' && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveSection} style={formCardStyle(tokens)}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, marginBottom: 8 }}>
                {sectionForm.id ? 'Edit Section & Adviser' : 'Add Section & Assign Class Adviser'}
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Section Name *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    maxLength={80}
                    placeholder="e.g. Diamond"
                    value={sectionForm.name}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, name: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 80) })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Grade Level *</label>
                  <select
                    required
                    value={sectionForm.grade_level}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, grade_level: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">Select Grade Level</option>
                    {grades.map((g) => (
                      <option key={g.id} value={g.id}>
                        {g.name || g.code}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Class Adviser (Faculty)</label>
                  <select
                    value={sectionForm.adviser_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, adviser_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">(None / Unassigned)</option>
                    {facultyList.map((f) => (
                      <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                        {f.full_name || f.name} {f.employee_id ? `(${f.employee_id})` : ''}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Default Room Number</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    maxLength={50}
                    placeholder="e.g. Room 204"
                    value={sectionForm.room_number}
                    onChange={(e) => setSectionForm({ ...sectionForm, room_number: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 50) })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 12 }}>
                {sectionForm.id && (
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    size="sm"
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setSectionForm({ id: null, name: '', grade_level: '', adviser_id: '', room_number: '', capacity: 45 })
                    }
                  >
                    Cancel Edit
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button variant="primary" size="sm" type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
                  {submitting ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} /> : sectionForm.id ? 'Save Changes' : 'Create Section'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>

            <div style={tableContainer(tokens)}>
              <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>
                <thead>
                  <tr style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Section</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Grade</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Class Adviser</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {sections.map((sec) => {
                    const adviserName =
                      sec.adviser_name ||
                      sec.adviser_full_name ||
                      (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser ? sec.adviser.full_name || sec.adviser.name : null) ||
                      facultyList.find((f) => f.id === sec.adviser_id || f.id === sec.adviser)?.full_name ||

                    return (
                      <tr key={sec.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{sec.name}</td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                          {sec.grade_level_name || sec.grade_level?.name || '—'}
                        </td>
                        <td
                          style={{
                            padding: '8px 10px',
                            color: adviserName === 'Unassigned' ? brand.warning : brand.primary,
                            fontWeight: 600,
                          }}
                        >
                          {adviserName}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              const advId =
                                sec.adviser_id ??
                                (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser ? sec.adviser.id : sec.adviser) ??
                                '';
                              setSectionForm({
                                id: sec.id,
                                name: sec.name,
                                grade_level: String(sec.grade_level?.id || sec.grade_level || ''),
                                adviser_id: String(advId || ''),
                                room_number: sec.room_number || '',
                                capacity: sec.capacity || 45,
                              });
                            }}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.primary, cursor: 'pointer', marginRight: 8 }}
                            title="Edit Section & Adviser"
                            aria-label={`Edit section ${sec.name}`}
                          >
                            <Edit2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteItem(API_ROUTES.school.sections, sec.id, 'Section')}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                            title="Delete Section"
                            aria-label={`Delete section ${sec.name}`}
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 2. SCHEDULES & SUBJECT FACULTY FORM */}
        {activeSubTab === 'SCHEDULE' && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveSchedule} style={formCardStyle(tokens)}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.82rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary, marginBottom: 8 }}>

                  <select

                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject *</label>
                  <select
                    required
                    value={scheduleForm.subject_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, subject_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
