                    <option value="">Select Subject</option>
                    {subjects.map((sub) => (
                      <option key={sub.id} value={sub.id}>
                        {sub.code} - {sub.title}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject Faculty</label>
                  <select
                    value={scheduleForm.faculty_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, faculty_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">(None / Unassigned)</option>
                    {facultyList.map((f) => (
                      <option key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                        {f.full_name || f.name} {f.employee_id ? `(${f.employee_id})` : ''}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Classroom</label>
                  <select
                    value={scheduleForm.room_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, room_id: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  >
                    <option value="">(Select Room)</option>
                    {rooms.map((r) => (
                      <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                        {r.name} {r.building ? `(${r.building})` : ''}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Start Time</label>
                  <input
                    type="time"
                    required
                    value={scheduleForm.start_time}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, start_time: e.target.value })}
                    style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>End Time</label>
                  <input
                    type="time"
                    required
                    value={scheduleForm.end_time}
                    onChange={(e) => setScheduleForm({ ...scheduleForm, end_time: e.target.value })}

                    size="sm"

                        section_id: '',
                        subject_id: '',
                        faculty_id: '',
                        room_id: '',
                        start_time: '07:30',
                        end_time: '08:30',
                        days_of_week: 'MON-FRI',
                      })
                    }
                  >
                    Cancel Edit
                  </Button>
                )}
                <Button variant="primary" size="sm" type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
                  {submitting
                    ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin" size={14} />
                    : scheduleForm.id
                      ? 'Save Changes'
                      : 'Create Class Period'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>

            <div style={tableContainer(tokens)}>
              <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>

                  <tr style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Section</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Subject</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Subject Faculty</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Time</th>
                    <th style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {schedules.map((sc) => {
                    const secName = sc.section_name || sc.section?.name || 'Section';
                    const subCode = sc.subject_code || sc.subject?.code || 'SUB';
                    const facultyName = extractFacultyName(sc, facultyList);

                    return (
                      <tr key={sc.id} style={{ borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>

                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 700 }}>{subCode}</td>
                        <td
                          style={{
                            padding: '8px 10px',
                            color: facultyName === 'Unassigned' ? brand.warning : tokens.textSecondary,
                            fontWeight: 600,
                          }}
                        >
                          {facultyName}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                          {String(sc.start_time).slice(0, 5)} - {String(sc.end_time).slice(0, 5)}
                        </td>
                        <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              const secId =
                                sc.section_id ??
                                (typeof sc.section === 'object' && sc.section ? sc.section.id : sc.section) ??
                                '';
                              const subId =
                                sc.subject_id ??
                                (typeof sc.subject === 'object' && sc.subject ? sc.subject.id : sc.subject) ??
                                '';
                              const facId = extractFacultyId(sc);
                              const roomId =
                                sc.room_id ??
                                (typeof sc.room === 'object' && sc.room ? sc.room.id : sc.room) ??
                                '';

                              setScheduleForm({
                                id: sc.id,
                                section_id: String(secId || ''),
                                subject_id: String(subId || ''),
                                faculty_id: facId,
                                room_id:
                                  typeof roomId === 'number' || /^\d+$/.test(String(roomId))
                                    ? String(roomId)
                                    : '',
                                start_time: sc.start_time ? String(sc.start_time).slice(0, 5) : '07:30',
                                end_time: sc.end_time ? String(sc.end_time).slice(0, 5) : '08:30',
                                days_of_week: sc.days_of_week || 'MON-FRI',
                              });
                            }}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.primary, cursor: 'pointer', marginRight: 8 }}
                            title="Edit Schedule & Faculty"
                            aria-label={`Edit schedule ${subCode}`}
                          >
                            <Edit2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteItem(API_ROUTES.school.periods, sc.id, 'Class Schedule')}
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                            title="Delete Schedule"
                            aria-label={`Delete schedule ${subCode}`}
                          >
                            <Trash2 size={13} />
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 3. FULL CRUD MODES: ROOMS, SUBJECTS, GRADES, YEARS, HOLIDAYS */}
        {!['SECTIONS', 'SCHEDULE'].includes(activeSubTab) && (
          <form onSubmit={handleSaveSimpleItem} style={{ ...formCardStyle(tokens), display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 10 }}>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'flex-end', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              {activeSubTab === 'ROOMS' && (
                <>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Room Name *</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      maxLength={60}
                      placeholder="e.g. Room 101"
                      value={simpleForm.name}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, name: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 60) })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 120 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Building</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      maxLength={80}
                      placeholder="e.g. Science Wing"
                      value={simpleForm.building}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, building: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 80) })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ width: 90 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Capacity</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min={1}
                      max={500}
                      value={simpleForm.capacity}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, capacity: Number(e.target.value) || 45 })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                </>
              )}

              {activeSubTab === 'GRADES' && (
                <>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 90 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Grade Code *</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      maxLength={20}
                      placeholder="e.g. G7"
                      value={simpleForm.code}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, code: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 20) })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ flex: 2, minWidth: 140 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Grade Name *</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      maxLength={60}
                      placeholder="e.g. Grade 7"
                      value={simpleForm.name}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, name: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 60) })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ width: 95 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Stage</label>
                    <select
                      value={simpleForm.stage}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, stage: e.target.value })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    >
                      <option value="ELEM">ELEM</option>
                      <option value="JHS">JHS</option>
                      <option value="SHS">SHS</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ width: 76 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Order</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min={1}
                      max={20}
                      value={simpleForm.level_order}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, level_order: Number(e.target.value) || 1 })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                </>
              )}

              {activeSubTab === 'SUBJECTS' && (
                <>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 100 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject Code *</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      maxLength={30}
                      placeholder="e.g. MATH7"
                      value={simpleForm.code}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, code: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 30) })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ flex: 2, minWidth: 140 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Subject Title *</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required

                      value={simpleForm.title}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, title: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 100) })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />

                  <div style={{ width: 76 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Units</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min={1}
                      max={10}
                      value={simpleForm.units}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, units: Number(e.target.value) || 1 })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>

              {activeSubTab === 'YEARS' && (
                <>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 110 }}>

                    <input

                      required
                      maxLength={20}
                      placeholder="e.g. 2026-2027"

                    <input
                      type="date"
                      required

                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, start_date: e.target.value })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}

                  <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 125 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Cutoff Date</label>
                    <input
                      type="date"
                      value={simpleForm.baseline_cutoff_date}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, baseline_cutoff_date: e.target.value })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}

                  </div>
                  <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 125 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>End Date *</label>
                    <input
                      type="date"
                      required

                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, end_date: e.target.value })}

                  </label>

                <>
                  <div style={{ width: 135 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Date *</label>
                    <input
                      type="date"
                      required
                      value={simpleForm.holiday_date}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, holiday_date: e.target.value })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ width: 130 }}>
                    <label style={labelStyle(tokens)}>Category</label>
                    <select
                      value={simpleForm.holiday_type}

                      type="text"

                      onChange={(e) => setSimpleForm({ ...simpleForm, holiday_reason: sanitizeField(e.target.value, 140) })}
                      style={inputStyle(tokens)}
                    />
                  </div>
                </>

              <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', gap: 6 }}>

                      </td>
                      <td style={{ padding: '8px 10px', textAlign: 'right' }}>
                        <button
                          type="button"

                              ...simpleForm,
                              id: h.id,
                              holiday_date: h.date || '',
                              holiday_type: h.type || 'HOLIDAY',

                          title="Edit Holiday"
                          style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.primary, cursor: 'pointer', marginRight: 8 }}
                        >
                          <Edit2 size={13} />
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteItem(API_ROUTES.school.holidays, h.id, 'Calendar Override')}
                          aria-label={`Delete holiday ${h.date}`}
                          title="Delete Holiday"
                          style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: brand.danger, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                        >
                          <Trash2 size={13} />
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: 8 }}>
          <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={onClose}>
            Close
          </Button>

/**
 * AttendSure - First-Time Profile Completion Modal
 * File: web/src/components/modals/CompleteProfileModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { UserCheck, ShieldCheck, Loader2, Camera, X } from 'lucide-react';

export interface CompletedProfileUser {
  full_name?: string;
  username?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

interface CompleteProfileModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onCompleted: (updatedUser: CompletedProfileUser) => void;
}

const sanitizeField = (raw: string, maxLen = 100): string =>
  String(raw || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '').slice(0, maxLen);

const sanitizePassword = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '').slice(0, 128);

export const CompleteProfileModal: React.FC<CompleteProfileModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onCompleted }) => {
  const { tokens, brand, fonts, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    first_name: '',
    middle_name: '',
    last_name: '',
    suffix: '',
    contact_number: '',
    department: 'Junior High School',
    password: '',
    photo: null as string | null,
  });

  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const submitAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const fileReaderRef = useRef<FileReader | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      submitAbortRef.current?.abort();
      fileReaderRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    setLoading(true);
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, { params: { nocache: 1 }, signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current || !res.data) return;
        const u = res.data;
        const pic = u.photo_url || u.photo || null;
        setFormData((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          first_name: sanitizeField(u.first_name || '', 100),
          middle_name: sanitizeField(u.middle_name || '', 100),
          last_name: sanitizeField(u.last_name || '', 100),
          suffix: sanitizeField(u.suffix || '', 12),
          contact_number: sanitizeField(u.contact_number || '', 13),
          department: sanitizeField(u.department || 'Junior High School', 100) || 'Junior High School',
          password: '',
          photo: null,
        }));
        setPhotoPreview(isSafeImageUrl(pic) ? pic : null);
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (
          controller.signal.aborted ||
          !mountedRef.current ||
          anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
          anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
          anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
        ) {
          return;
        }
        showAlert({ title: 'Notice', message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not pre-load profile details.'), type: 'warning' });
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted && mountedRef.current) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [isOpen, showAlert]);

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type) || file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Image', message: 'Use JPG, PNG, or WebP under 2.5 MB.', type: 'error' });
      e.target.value = '';
      return;
    }
    fileReaderRef.current?.abort();
    const reader = new FileReader();
    fileReaderRef.current = reader;
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      if (!mountedRef.current || reader.readyState !== FileReader.DONE) return;
      const b64 = typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : '';
      if (!isSafeImageUrl(b64)) {
        showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Image', message: 'Could not verify the selected image file.', type: 'error' });
        return;
      }
      setPhotoPreview(b64);
      setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, photo: b64 }));
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const cleanPhone = formData.contact_number.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
  const isPhoneValid = /^(09|\+639)\d{9}$/.test(cleanPhone);
  const isPasswordValid =
    !formData.password ||
    (formData.password.length >= 8 && /[A-Za-z]/.test(formData.password) && /[0-9]/.test(formData.password));
  const isFormValid =
    formData.first_name.trim().length >= 2 &&
    formData.last_name.trim().length >= 2 &&
    isPhoneValid &&
    isPasswordValid;

  const setField = (key: Exclude<keyof typeof formData, 'photo'>, val: string) => {
    const clean = key === 'password' ? sanitizePassword(val) : sanitizeField(val, key === 'contact_number' ? 13 : 100);
    setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, [key]: clean }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isFormValid || saving) return;

    submitAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    submitAbortRef.current = controller;

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, string | null> = {
        first_name: sanitizeField(formData.first_name, 100).trim(),
        middle_name: sanitizeField(formData.middle_name, 100).trim(),
        last_name: sanitizeField(formData.last_name, 100).trim(),
        suffix: sanitizeField(formData.suffix, 12).trim(),
        contact_number: cleanPhone,
        department: sanitizeField(formData.department, 100).trim(),
      };
      const cleanPw = sanitizePassword(formData.password).trim();
      if (cleanPw.length >= 8) payload.password = cleanPw;
      if (formData.photo !== null) {
        payload.photo = formData.photo === '' ? null : isSafeImageUrl(formData.photo) ? formData.photo : null;
      }

      const res = await apiClient.put(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, payload, { signal: controller.signal });
      if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;
      showAlert({ title: 'Profile Completed', message: 'Your faculty record is now active.', type: 'success' });
      onCompleted(res.data);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        !mountedRef.current ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to update profile.'), type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted && mountedRef.current) {
        setSaving(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const responsiveGrid: React.CSSProperties = {
    display: 'grid',
    gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 190px), 1fr))',
    gap: 10,
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={() => {}} title="Complete Your Profile Information">
      {loading ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 24, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
          <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" style={{ margin: '0 auto 6px', display: 'block', color: brand.primary }} />
          Loading profile...
        </div>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
          <div
            style={{
              ...ui.subtleBox,
              backgroundColor: tokens.infoLight,
              borderColor: brand.secondary,
              display: 'flex',
              gap: 10,
              alignItems: 'center',
            }}
          >
            <ShieldCheck size={20} color={brand.secondary} style={{ flexShrink: 0 }} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
              Please complete your personal details to activate your DTR and class list access.
            </span>
          </div>

          <div style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <div
              style={{
                width: 48,
                height: 48,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                flexShrink: 0,
              }}
            >
              {photoPreview && isSafeImageUrl(photoPreview) ? (
                <img src={photoPreview} alt="Profile preview" style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>No Pic</span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              <label style={ui.btnPrimary}>
                <Camera size={12} /> Upload Photo (Optional)
                <input type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" onChange={handlePhotoSelect} style={{ display: 'none' }} />
              </label>
              {photoPreview && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setPhotoPreview(null);
                    setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, photo: '' }));
                  }}
                  style={{
                    color: brand.danger,
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    fontSize: '0.74rem',
                    display: 'inline-flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 3,
                  }}
                >
                  <X size={12} /> Remove
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>First Name *</label>
              <input
                required
                maxLength={100}
                style={ui.input}
                value={formData.first_name}
                onChange={(e) => setField('first_name', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Last Name *</label>
              <input
                required
                maxLength={100}
                style={ui.input}
                value={formData.last_name}
                onChange={(e) => setField('last_name', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Middle Name</label>
              <input
                maxLength={100}
                style={ui.input}
                value={formData.middle_name}
                onChange={(e) => setField('middle_name', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Suffix</label>
              <select style={ui.input} value={formData.suffix} onChange={(e) => setField('suffix', e.target.value)}>
                <option value="">None</option>
                <option value="Jr.">Jr.</option>
                <option value="Sr.">Sr.</option>
                <option value="II">II</option>
                <option value="III">III</option>
                <option value="IV">IV</option>
                <option value="V">V</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Contact Number (11 Digits) *</label>
              <input
                required
                maxLength={13}
                placeholder="09171234567"
                style={ui.input}
                value={formData.contact_number}
                onChange={(e) => setField('contact_number', e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Department *</label>
              <select required style={ui.input} value={formData.department} onChange={(e) => setField('department', e.target.value)}>
                <option value="Junior High School">Junior High School</option>
                <option value="Senior High School">Senior High School</option>
                <option value="Office of the Principal / Administration">Administration</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>New Password (Optional, min 8 chars with letters &amp; numbers)</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              maxLength={128}
              autoComplete="new-password"
              style={ui.input}
              value={formData.password}
              onChange={(e) => setField('password', e.target.value)}
            />
            {!isPasswordValid && (
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: brand.danger, marginTop: 4, display: 'block' }}>
                Password must be at least 8 characters and contain both letters and numbers.
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginTop: 8 }}>
            <Button variant="primary" size="md" type="submit" disabled={saving || !isFormValid}>
              {saving ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <UserCheck size={16} />}
              <span>{saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Complete & Activate Profile'}</span>
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      )}
    </Modal>
  );
};

export default CompleteProfileModal;

/**
 * AttendSure - User Profile View & Edit Modal
 * File: web/src/components/modals/ProfileModal.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import apiClient from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { Modal } from '../ui/Modal';
import { Button } from '../ui/Button';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { Camera, X, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

export interface ProfileUpdatePayload {
  full_name?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  token?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

interface ProfileModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onProfileUpdated?: (updated: ProfileUpdatePayload) => void;
}

const SUFFIX_OPTIONS = ['', 'Jr.', 'Sr.', 'II', 'III', 'IV', 'V'];

const sanitizeField = (raw: string, maxLen = 100): string =>
  String(raw || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '').slice(0, maxLen);

const sanitizePassword = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g, '').slice(0, 128);

export const ProfileModal: React.FC<ProfileModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose, onProfileUpdated }) => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    first_name: '',
    middle_name: '',
    last_name: '',
    suffix: '',
    email: '',
    contact_number: '',
    position: '',
    department: '',
    current_password: '',
    password: '',
    photo: null as string | null,
  });

  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const submitAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const fileReaderRef = useRef<FileReader | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      submitAbortRef.current?.abort();
      fileReaderRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    setLoading(true);
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, { params: { nocache: 1 }, signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current || !res.data) return;
        const u = res.data;
        const pic = u.photo_url || u.photo || null;
        setFormData({
          first_name: sanitizeField(u.first_name || '', 100),
          middle_name: sanitizeField(u.middle_name || '', 100),
          last_name: sanitizeField(u.last_name || '', 100),
          suffix: sanitizeField(u.suffix || '', 12),
          email: sanitizeField(u.email || '', 150),
          contact_number: sanitizeField(u.contact_number || '', 30),
          position: sanitizeField(u.position || '', 100),
          department: sanitizeField(u.department || '', 100),
          current_password: '',
          password: '',
          photo: null,
        });
        setPhotoPreview(isSafeImageUrl(pic) ? pic : null);
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (
          controller.signal.aborted ||
          !mountedRef.current ||
          anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
          anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
          anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
        ) {
          return;
        }
        showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not load profile details.'), type: 'error' });
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted && mountedRef.current) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      });

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [isOpen, showAlert]);

  const handlePhotoSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type) || file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Image', message: 'Use JPG, PNG, or WebP under 2.5 MB.', type: 'error' });
      e.target.value = '';
      return;
    }
    fileReaderRef.current?.abort();
    const reader = new FileReader();
    fileReaderRef.current = reader;
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      if (!mountedRef.current || reader.readyState !== FileReader.DONE) return;
      const b64 = typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : '';
      if (!isSafeImageUrl(b64)) {
        showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Image', message: 'Could not verify the selected image file.', type: 'error' });
        return;
      }
      setPhotoPreview(b64);
      setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, photo: b64 }));
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (saving) return;

    const cleanFirst = sanitizeField(formData.first_name, 100).trim();
    const cleanLast = sanitizeField(formData.last_name, 100).trim();
    const cleanEmail = sanitizeField(formData.email, 150).trim().toLowerCase();
    const cleanPw = sanitizePassword(formData.password).trim();
    const cleanCurrentPw = sanitizePassword(formData.current_password).trim();

    if (!cleanFirst || !cleanLast) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Missing Information', message: 'First name and last name are required.', type: 'warning' });
      return;
    }
    if (cleanEmail && !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(cleanEmail)) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Email', message: 'Please enter a valid email address.', type: 'warning' });
      return;
    }
    if (cleanPw && cleanPw.length < 8) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Weak Password',
        message: 'New password must be at least 8 characters long.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    submitAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    submitAbortRef.current = controller;

    setSaving(true);
    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
      first_name: cleanFirst,
      middle_name: sanitizeField(formData.middle_name, 100).trim(),
      last_name: cleanLast,
      suffix: SUFFIX_OPTIONS.includes(formData.suffix) ? formData.suffix : '',
      email: cleanEmail,
      contact_number: sanitizeField(formData.contact_number, 30).trim(),
    };
    if (cleanPw) {
      payload.password = cleanPw;
      if (cleanCurrentPw) {
        payload.current_password = cleanCurrentPw;
      }
    }
    if (formData.photo !== null) {
      payload.photo = formData.photo === '' ? null : isSafeImageUrl(formData.photo) ? formData.photo : null;
    }

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.put(API_ROUTES.accounts.me, payload, { signal: controller.signal });
      if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;
      if (res.data?.token) {
        localStorage.setItem('attendsure_token', res.data.token);
      }
      showAlert({ title: 'Saved', message: 'Profile updated.', type: 'success' });
      onProfileUpdated?.(res.data);
      onClose();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (
        controller.signal.aborted ||
        !mountedRef.current ||
        anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
        anyErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
        anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
      ) {
        return;
      }
      showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: extractApiError(err, 'Update failed.'), type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted && mountedRef.current) {
        setSaving(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const setField = (k: Exclude<keyof typeof formData, 'photo'>, v: string) => {
    let clean = v;
    if (k === 'password' || k === 'current_password') {
      clean = sanitizePassword(v);
    } else if (k === 'email') {
      clean = sanitizeField(v, 150);
    } else if (k === 'contact_number') {
      clean = sanitizeField(v, 30);
    } else {
      clean = sanitizeField(v, 100);
    }
    setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, [k]: clean }));
  };

  const responsiveGrid: React.CSSProperties = {
    display: 'grid',
    gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 190px), 1fr))',
    gap: 10,
  };

  return (
    <Modal isOpen={isOpen} onClose={onClose} title="My User Profile">
      {loading ? (
        <div style={{ padding: 24, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
          <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" style={{ margin: '0 auto 6px', display: 'block', color: brand.primary }} />
          Loading profile...
        </div>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
          <div style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <div
              style={{
                width: 52,
                height: 52,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                flexShrink: 0,
              }}
            >
              {photoPreview && isSafeImageUrl(photoPreview) ? (
                <img src={photoPreview} alt="Profile" style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', objectFit: 'cover' }} />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>No Pic</span>
              )}
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              <label style={ui.btnPrimary}>
                <Camera size={12} /> Change Photo
                <input type="file" accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" onChange={handlePhotoSelect} style={{ display: 'none' }} />
              </label>
              {photoPreview && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setPhotoPreview(null);
                    setFormData((p) => ({ ...p, photo: '' }));
                  }}
                  style={{
                    color: brand.danger,
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    fontSize: '0.74rem',
                    display: 'inline-flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 3,
                  }}
                >
                  <X size={12} /> Remove
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>First Name</label>
              <input required maxLength={100} style={ui.input} value={formData.first_name} onChange={(e) => setField('first_name', e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Last Name</label>
              <input required maxLength={100} style={ui.input} value={formData.last_name} onChange={(e) => setField('last_name', e.target.value)} />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Middle Name</label>
              <input maxLength={100} style={ui.input} value={formData.middle_name} onChange={(e) => setField('middle_name', e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Suffix</label>
              <select style={ui.input} value={formData.suffix} onChange={(e) => setField('suffix', e.target.value)}>
                {SUFFIX_OPTIONS.map((s) => (
                  <option key={s} value={s}>
                    {s || 'None'}
                  </option>

              </select>

          <div style={responsiveGrid}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Email</label>
              <input type="email" maxLength={150} style={ui.input} value={formData.email} onChange={(e) => setField('email', e.target.value)} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Contact Number</label>
              <input maxLength={30} style={ui.input} value={formData.contact_number} onChange={(e) => setField('contact_number', e.target.value)} />

              />

export const StudentIdPassModal: React.FC<StudentIdPassModalProps> = ({

  const { school } = useSchool();

    };
  }, []);

  if (!student) return null;
  const safePhoto = isSafeImageUrl(student.photo_url) ? student.photo_url : null;
  const identifier = student.lrn || 'ID-00000';
  // Prefer digitally signed qr_payload so passes verify cleanly on classroom USB QR scanners
  const qrData = student.qr_payload || identifier;
  const schoolName = school.school_name || 'Authorized School Campus';
  const subtitle = selectedClass?.section_name || 'Authorized Student';
  const signatureLabel = student.qr_payload ? 'Digitally Verified' : 'Active';

  const handleCopyIdentifier = () => {
    onCopyLrn(identifier);
    setCopied(true);
    if (copyTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
    copyTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);

      window.print();
      return;

        : `<span style="font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:#004b87;">${escapeHtml(student.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'S')}</span>`;

          <div style={{ padding: 16 }}>

              style={{
                width: 54,
                height: 54,
                borderRadius: '50%',

const getCurrentMonthName = (): string => {
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { month: 'long' }).format(new Date());
  } catch {
    return 'January';
  }

const extractSectionGradeName = (sec?: SectionOption | null): string => {
  if (!sec) return '';
  if (sec.grade_level_name && String(sec.grade_level_name).trim()) {
    return String(sec.grade_level_name).trim();
  }
  const val = sec.grade_level;
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  if (typeof val === 'string') return /^\d+$/.test(val.trim()) ? '' : val.trim();
  if (typeof val === 'object') {
    const name = val.name || val.grade_name || val.level || val.code;
    return name ? String(name).trim() : '';
  }
  return '';
};

export const ReportNavBar: React.FC<ReportNavBarProps> = ({
  reports = DEFAULT_REPORTS,
  activeReportId,
  onSelectReport,
  academicYears = [],
  selectedAcademicYear = '',
  onAcademicYearChange,
  showAcademicYearFilter = false,
  gradeLevels = [],
  selectedGradeLevel = 'ALL',
  onGradeLevelChange,
  showGradeLevelFilter = true,
  sections = [],
  selectedSectionId,
  onSectionChange,
  showSectionFilter = true,
  showDateFilter = false,
  selectedDate = '',
  onDateChange,
  showMonthFilter = false,
  selectedMonth = getCurrentMonthName(),
  onMonthChange,
  monthsList = DEFAULT_MONTHS,
  showCalendarYearFilter = false,
  selectedCalendarYear = new Date().getFullYear(),
  onCalendarYearChange,
  searchQuery = '',
  onSearchChange,
  showSearch = true,
  layoutMode = 'pages',
  onToggleLayoutMode,
  showLayoutModeToggle = true,
  onRefresh,
  isRefreshing = false,
  onOpenPageSetup,
  exportHandlers,
  onPrint,
  isExporting = false,
  exportingText = 'Exporting...',
  disableActions = false,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [isExportDropdownOpen, setIsExportDropdownOpen] = useState(false);
  const dropdownRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const userRole = (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || '').toUpperCase();
  const isSchoolLeader = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(userRole);

  const filteredReports = useMemo(() => {
    return reports.filter((rep) => {
      if (rep.id === 'sf4' && !isSchoolLeader) return false;
      return true;
    });
  }, [reports, isSchoolLeader]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isExportDropdownOpen) return;

    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
      }
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [isExportDropdownOpen]);

  const filteredSections = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedGradeLevel || selectedGradeLevel === 'ALL') {
      return sections;
    }
    const target = selectedGradeLevel.toLowerCase().trim();
    return sections.filter((sec) => {
      const g = extractSectionGradeName(sec).toLowerCase();
      return g === target || g.includes(target);
    });
  }, [sections, selectedGradeLevel]);

  const availableGradeLevels = useMemo(() => {
    if (gradeLevels && gradeLevels.length > 0) {
      return gradeLevels
        .map((g) => String(g || '').trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }));
    }
    const extracted = Array.from(new Set(sections.map(extractSectionGradeName).filter(Boolean)));
    return extracted.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' }));
  }, [gradeLevels, sections]);

  const handleExportAction = (action?: () => void | Promise<void>) => {
    setIsExportDropdownOpen(false);
    if (action) void action();
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="no-print"
      style={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        width: '100%',
        flexShrink: 0,
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
        boxSizing: 'border-box',
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: 12,
          padding: '10px 24px',
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        }}
      >
        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textMuted, letterSpacing: '0.4px', textTransform: 'uppercase' }}>
          REPORT FORM:
        </span>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, padding: '4px', borderRadius: 10, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
          {filteredReports.map((rep) => {
            const Icon = rep.icon;
            const isActive = rep.id === activeReportId;
            return (
              <button
                key={rep.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onSelectReport(rep.id)}
                style={{
                  padding: '6px 14px',
                  borderRadius: 8,
                  border: 'none',
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 6,

          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          padding: '10px 24px',
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 12,
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {showAcademicYearFilter && onAcademicYearChange && academicYears.length > 0 && (

              <select

          {showGradeLevelFilter && onGradeLevelChange && (

  paperSize: 'legal',

  marginPreset: 'compact',
  margins: { top: 0.25, right: 0.25, bottom: 0.25, left: 0.25 },
  headerRepeat: 'first_page_only',
};

export const resolvePaperDimensionsInches = (
  config: PageSetupConfig
): { widthIn: number; heightIn: number } => {
  const paper = PAPER_SIZES[config.paperSize] || PAPER_SIZES.legal;
  const isLandscape = config.orientation === 'landscape';
  return isLandscape
    ? { widthIn: paper.height, heightIn: paper.width }
    : { widthIn: paper.width, heightIn: paper.height };
};

const sanitizeCssToken = (raw: string, fallback: string): string => {
  const cleaned = String(raw || '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '');
  return cleaned || fallback;
};

const sanitizePageColor = (raw?: string): string => {
  if (raw && /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(raw.trim())) {
    return raw.trim();
  }
  return '#ffffff';
};

export const ReportViewerShell: React.FC<ReportViewerShellProps> = ({
  loading,
  loadingMessage,
  error,
  hasData,
  isPrinting,
  isExportingPdf,
  pageWidthInches,
  pageHeightInches,
  pageConfig,
  sheetClassName,
  documentId,
  reportRef,
  leftToolbarContent,
  children,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const [zoomScale, setZoomScale] = useState<number>(1);
  const [fitToWidth, setFitToWidth] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const viewportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const safeDocId = sanitizeCssToken(documentId, 'report-print-document');
  const safeSheetClass = sanitizeCssToken(sheetClassName, 'report-sheet-page');
  const safePageColor = sanitizePageColor(pageConfig.pageColor);

  const updateFitScale = useCallback(() => {
    if (!viewportRef.current) return;
    const containerWidth = viewportRef.current.clientWidth - 48;
    const targetWidth = pageWidthInches * 96;
    if (containerWidth > 0 && targetWidth > 0) {
      const scale = containerWidth / targetWidth;
      setZoomScale(Number(Math.min(1.15, Math.max(0.35, scale)).toFixed(3)));
    }
  }, [pageWidthInches]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (fitToWidth && !isPrinting && !isExportingPdf) {
      const timer = setTimeout(updateFitScale, 50);
      window.addEventListener('resize', updateFitScale);
      return () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        window.removeEventListener('resize', updateFitScale);
      };
    }
  }, [fitToWidth, isPrinting, isExportingPdf, updateFitScale, hasData, pageConfig]);

  return (
    <>
      <div
        className="no-print"
        style={{
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          padding: '8px 24px',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 10,
          backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {leftToolbarContent}
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setFitToWidth(true);
              updateFitScale();
            }}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',

              gap: 5,

              borderRadius: 6,
              cursor: 'pointer',

              fontWeight: 700,
              backgroundColor: fitToWidth ? tokens.primaryLight : tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
              border: `1px solid ${fitToWidth ? brand.primary : tokens.borderStrong}`,
              color: fitToWidth ? brand.primary : tokens.textSecondary,
            }}
          >
            <Maximize2 size={13} /> Fit Screen ({Math.round(zoomScale * 100)}%)
          </button>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Zoom out"
              onClick={() => {
                setFitToWidth(false);
                setZoomScale((prev) => Math.max(0.35, Number((prev - 0.05).toFixed(2))));
              }}
              style={{
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: 6,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
              }}
            >
              <ZoomOut size={13} />
            </button>
            <span
              style={{
                minWidth: 42,
                textAlign: 'center',
                fontWeight: 700,
                fontSize: '0.76rem',
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
              }}
            >
              {Math.round(zoomScale * 100)}%
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-label="Zoom in"
              onClick={() => {
                setFitToWidth(false);
                setZoomScale((prev) => Math.min(1.4, Number((prev + 0.05).toFixed(2))));
              }}
              style={{
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: 6,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
              }}
            >
              <ZoomIn size={13} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div
        ref={viewportRef}
        className="report-viewer-viewport"
        style={{

          flexDirection: 'column',
          alignItems: 'center',
          width: '100%',
          boxSizing: 'border-box',
        }}
      >
        {loading ? (
          <div
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 12,
              marginTop: 80,

              color: tokens.textSecondary,
            }}

const OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY = 'attendsure_offline_qr_queue';

const loadOfflineQueue = (): OfflineScanEntry[] => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY);
    return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as OfflineScanEntry[]) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
};

const playFeedbackChime = (type: 'SUCCESS' | 'WARNING' | 'ERROR') => {
  try {
    const AudioCtx =
      window.AudioContext || (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioCtx) return;
    const ctx = new AudioCtx();
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = type === 'SUCCESS' ? 'sine' : 'triangle';
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(type === 'SUCCESS' ? 1046 : 250, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, ctx.currentTime);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, ctx.currentTime + 0.22);
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.onended = () => {
      void ctx.close().catch(() => {});
    };
    osc.start();
    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.22);
  } catch {
    // Browser autoplay policy blocked audio
  }
};

const MAX_QR_INPUT_LENGTH = 256;
const sanitizeQrInput = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '').replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '').slice(0, MAX_QR_INPUT_LENGTH);

export const ClassroomScanner: React.FC<ClassroomScannerProps> = ({ onClose, isModal = false }) => {
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const warmPeriods = useMemo(() => {
    const cached = peekApiCache<ClassPeriodOption[]>(API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, { summary: 1 });
    return Array.isArray(cached) ? cached.filter((p) => p.id > 0) : [];
  }, []);

  const [scannerMode, setScannerMode] = useState<'USB_GUN' | 'CAMERA'>('USB_GUN');
  const [soundEnabled, setSoundEnabled] = useState(true);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [syncingOffline, setSyncingOffline] = useState(false);
  const [inputCode, setInputCode] = useState('');

  const [periods, setPeriods] = useState<ClassPeriodOption[]>(() => warmPeriods);
  const [selectedPeriodId, setSelectedPeriodId] = useState<number | null>(() =>
    warmPeriods.length > 0 ? warmPeriods[0].id : null
  );
  const [activeStudent, setActiveStudent] = useState<ScannedStudent | null>(null);
  const [sessionList, setSessionList] = useState<ScannedStudent[]>([]);
  const [offlineQueue, setOfflineQueue] = useState<OfflineScanEntry[]>(loadOfflineQueue);
  const [cameraMessage, setCameraMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const mountedRef = useRef(true);
  const loadingRef = useRef(false);
  const processScanRef = useRef<(rawCode: string) => Promise<void>>(async () => {});
  const keyBuffer = useRef('');
  const lastKeyTime = useRef(0);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const frameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const focusTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const cameraCooldownTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const scanAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  loadingRef.current = loading;

  useEffect(() => {
    mountedRef.current = true;
    return () => {
      mountedRef.current = false;
      scanAbortRef.current?.abort();
      if (focusTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusTimerRef.current);
      if (cameraCooldownTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(cameraCooldownTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.attendance.classes, { params: { summary: 1 }, signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const rawList: ClassPeriodOption[] = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : [];
        const validList = rawList.filter((p) => p.id > 0);
        setPeriods(validList);
        if (validList.length > 0) setSelectedPeriodId((prev) => prev ?? validList[0].id);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, []);

  const syncOfflineScans = useCallback(async () => {
    const queued = loadOfflineQueue();
    if (queued.length === 0) return;
    setSyncingOffline(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.attendance.offlineSync, { scans: queued });
      if (!mountedRef.current) return;
      try {
        localStorage.removeItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY);
      } catch {
        // Ignore storage error
      }
      setOfflineQueue([]);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Offline Scans Synced',
        message: `Synced ${res.data?.synced_count ?? 0} scan(s) (${res.data?.duplicate_count ?? 0} duplicate).`,
        type: 'success',
      });
    } catch (err) {
      if (!mountedRef.current) return;
      showAlert({ title: 'Sync Notice', message: extractApiError(err, 'Still offline.'), type: 'warning' });
    } finally {
      if (mountedRef.current) setSyncingOffline(false);
    }
  }, [showAlert]);

  const handleProcessScan = useCallback(
    async (rawCode: string) => {
      const clean = sanitizeQrInput(rawCode).trim();
      if (!clean || loadingRef.current) return;

      scanAbortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      scanAbortRef.current = controller;

      loadingRef.current = true;
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await apiClient.post(
          API_ROUTES.attendance.scan,
          {
            qr_text: clean,
            period_id: selectedPeriodId && selectedPeriodId > 0 ? selectedPeriodId : undefined,
          },
          { signal: controller.signal }
        );
        if (controller.signal.aborted || !mountedRef.current) return;

        const d = res.data || {};
        const item: ScannedStudent = {
          student_id: d.student_id,
          student_name: d.student_name,
          lrn: d.lrn,
          section: d.section,
          status: d.status || 'PRESENT',
          scanned_at: d.scanned_at,
          photo_url: isSafeImageUrl(d.photo_url) ? d.photo_url : null,
          attendance_note: d.attendance_note,
          is_duplicate: Boolean(d.is_duplicate),
        };

        setActiveStudent(item);
        if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime(item.is_duplicate ? 'WARNING' : 'SUCCESS');
        if (!item.is_duplicate) {
          setSessionList((prev) => [item, ...prev.filter((p) => p.lrn !== item.lrn)]);
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const netErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string; response?: unknown };
        if (
          controller.signal.aborted ||
          !mountedRef.current ||
          netErr?.name === 'CanceledError' ||
          netErr?.name === 'AbortError' ||
          netErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED'
        ) {
          return;
        }
        if (!netErr?.response) {
          const nextQueue: OfflineScanEntry[] = [
            ...loadOfflineQueue(),
            {
              qr_token: clean,
              period_id: selectedPeriodId && selectedPeriodId > 0 ? selectedPeriodId : null,
              scanned_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            },
          ];
          try {
            localStorage.setItem(OFFLINE_QUEUE_KEY, JSON.stringify(nextQueue));
          } catch {
            // Ignore storage quota error
          }
          setOfflineQueue(nextQueue);
          if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime('WARNING');
          showAlert({
            title: 'Saved to Offline Queue',
            message: `Internet unavailable. Queued "${clean.slice(0, 20)}" for automatic sync.`,
            type: 'info',
          });
        } else {
          if (soundEnabled) playFeedbackChime('ERROR');
          showAlert({ title: 'Scan Rejected', message: extractApiError(err), type: 'warning' });
        }
      } finally {
        loadingRef.current = false;
        if (mountedRef.current && !controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setInputCode('');
          if (focusTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(focusTimerRef.current);
          focusTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
            inputRef.current?.focus();
          }, 40);
        }
      }
    },
    [selectedPeriodId, soundEnabled, showAlert]
  );

  processScanRef.current = handleProcessScan;

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const tag = (document.activeElement as HTMLElement)?.tagName;
      if (tag === 'INPUT' && document.activeElement !== inputRef.current) return;
      const now = Date.now();
      if (now - lastKeyTime.current > 120) keyBuffer.current = '';
      lastKeyTime.current = now;
      if (e.key === 'Enter' && keyBuffer.current.length >= 4) {
        e.preventDefault();
        void processScanRef.current(keyBuffer.current);
        keyBuffer.current = '';
      } else if (e.key.length === 1 && keyBuffer.current.length < MAX_QR_INPUT_LENGTH) {
        const ch = e.key.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '');
        if (ch) keyBuffer.current += ch;
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, []);

  // Stable camera lifecycle: depends ONLY on scannerMode so scans never restart the webcam
  useEffect(() => {
    if (scannerMode !== 'CAMERA') {
      streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
      if (frameRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
      if (cameraCooldownTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(cameraCooldownTimerRef.current);
      return;
    }

    setCameraMessage(null);
    let active = true;
    navigator.mediaDevices
      ?.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: 'environment', width: { ideal: 640 }, height: { ideal: 480 } } })
      .then((stream) => {
        if (!active) {
          stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
          return;
        }
        streamRef.current = stream;
        if (videoRef.current) {
          videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
          videoRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
        }
        if ('BarcodeDetector' in window) {
          const Detector = (
            window as unknown as {
              BarcodeDetector: new (opts: { formats: string[] }) => {
                detect: (el: HTMLVideoElement) => Promise<Array<{ rawValue?: string }>>;
              };
            }
          ).BarcodeDetector;
          const detector = new Detector({ formats: ['qr_code', 'code_128'] });
          const tick = async () => {
            if (!active) return;
            if (videoRef.current && videoRef.current.readyState >= 2 && !loadingRef.current) {
              const codes = await detector.detect(videoRef.current).catch(() => []);
              if (codes[0]?.rawValue) {
                await processScanRef.current(codes[0].rawValue);
                await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
                  if (cameraCooldownTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(cameraCooldownTimerRef.current);
                  cameraCooldownTimerRef.current = setTimeout(resolve, 1300);
                });
              }
            }
            if (active) frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
          };
          frameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (active) {
          setCameraMessage('Camera permission denied. Allow camera access in your browser bar or use USB Scanner mode.');
        }
      });

    return () => {
      active = false;
      streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
      if (frameRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(frameRef.current);
      if (cameraCooldownTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(cameraCooldownTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, [scannerMode]);

  return (
    <div
      style={
        isModal
          ? {
              position: 'fixed',
              inset: 0,
              zIndex: 9999,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(15,23,42,0.65)',
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: 16,
            }
          : { width: '100%' }
      }
    >
      <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden', width: '100%', maxWidth: isModal ? 900 : '100%' }}>
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            gap: 12,
            padding: '12px 18px',
            borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <ControlSwitch
              options={[
                { value: 'USB_GUN', label: 'USB QR Scanner', icon: <HardDrive size={14} /> },
                { value: 'CAMERA', label: 'Device Camera', icon: <Camera size={14} /> },
              ]}
              value={scannerMode}
              onChange={setScannerMode}
            />

            {periods.length > 0 && (
              <select
                aria-label="Select class period"
                value={selectedPeriodId || ''}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedPeriodId(e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : null)}
                style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', minWidth: 220, padding: '6px 10px' }}
              >
                {periods.map((p) => (
                  <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                    {p.grade_level} - {p.name} • {p.subject_code || p.subject_title} ({p.time_display || 'Active'})
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            )}
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
            {offlineQueue.length > 0 && (
              <button type="button" onClick={syncOfflineScans} disabled={syncingOffline} style={ui.btnPrimary}>
                <CloudUpload size={14} /> Sync Offline ({offlineQueue.length})
              </button>
            )}

            <button type="button" onClick={() => setSoundEnabled(!soundEnabled)} style={ui.btnSecondary}>
              {soundEnabled ? <Volume2 size={14} color={brand.primary} /> : <VolumeX size={14} />}
              {soundEnabled ? 'Sound On' : 'Muted'}
            </button>

            {onClose && (
              <button
                type="button"
                aria-label="Close scanner"
                onClick={onClose}
                style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', color: tokens.textMuted }}
              >
                <X size={18} />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div
          style={{
            display: 'grid',
            gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr))',
            gap: 16,
            padding: 18,
            backgroundColor: tokens.bgCanvas,
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            {scannerMode === 'USB_GUN' ? (
              <div onClick={() => inputRef.current?.focus()} style={{ ...ui.card, textAlign: 'center', padding: 24, cursor: 'text' }}>
                <div
                  style={{
                    width: 54,
                    height: 54,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
                    color: brand.primary,
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    margin: '0 auto 10px',
                  }}
                >
                  <Scan size={26} />
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>USB QR Scanner Ready</div>
                <p style={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, margin: '6px auto 14px', maxWidth: 400 }}>
                  Scan an official signed student QR ID card below.
                </p>
                <form
                  onSubmit={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    void handleProcessScan(inputCode);
                  }}
                  style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}
                >
                  <input
                    ref={inputRef}
                    type="text"
                    autoFocus
                    maxLength={MAX_QR_INPUT_LENGTH}
                    value={inputCode}
                    onChange={(e) => setInputCode(sanitizeQrInput(e.target.value))}
                    placeholder="Scan signed QR card..."
                    style={{ ...ui.input, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}
                  />
                  <button type="submit" disabled={loading || !inputCode.trim()} style={ui.btnPrimary}>
                    {loading ? '...' : 'Verify'}
                  </button>
                </form>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div style={ui.card}>
                {cameraMessage ? (
                  <div style={{ ...ui.subtleBox, color: brand.warning }}>{cameraMessage}</div>
