import { CheckCircle2, Printer, QrCode, FileText, Plus, FileCheck, FileX, ExternalLink, Edit2, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';

interface GatePass {
  id: number;
  pass_number: string;
  bearer_type: 'STUDENT' | 'FACULTY';
  student?: number | null;
  student_name?: string;
  student_lrn?: string;
  faculty?: number | null;
  faculty_name?: string;
  faculty_emp_id?: string;
  pass_type: string;
  reason: string;
  valid_from: string;
  valid_to: string;
  valid_until?: string;
  status: 'PENDING' | 'ACTIVE' | 'USED' | 'DECLINED' | 'EXPIRED' | 'REVOKED';
  attachment_url?: string | null;
  adviser_name?: string;
  approved_by?: string;
}

interface StudentOption {
  id: number;
  lrn: string;
  full_name: string;
}

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 250): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const isSafeProofUrl = (url?: string | null): boolean => {
  if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;
  const trimmed = url.trim().toLowerCase();
  return trimmed.startsWith('http://') || trimmed.startsWith('https://') || trimmed.startsWith('/media/');
};

export const GatePassesTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { school } = useSchool();
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { mode, tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const successBtnBg = mode === 'dark' ? '#059669' : brand.success;

  const userRole = (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || 'FACULTY').toUpperCase();
  const isPrincipalOrAdmin = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL'].includes(userRole);
  const isRestrictedRole = userRole === 'PARENT';

  const [passes, setPasses] = useState<GatePass[]>(() => {
    const cached = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses);
    return cached?.results ?? (Array.isArray(cached) ? cached : []);
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => !peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses));
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [debouncedSearch, setDebouncedSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');

  const [selectedPass, setSelectedPass] = useState<GatePass | null>(null);
  const [reviewingPass, setReviewingPass] = useState<GatePass | null>(null);
  const [editingPass, setEditingPass] = useState<GatePass | null>(null);
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const [students, setStudents] = useState<StudentOption[]>([]);
  const [loadingStudents, setLoadingStudents] = useState(false);
  const [passFormType, setPassFormType] = useState<'STUDENT' | 'FACULTY'>('STUDENT');

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    student_id: '',
    pass_type: 'Medical / Health Emergency',
    reason: '',
    valid_from: '',
    valid_to: '',
  });

  const [attachedFile, setAttachedFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [declineReason, setDeclineReason] = useState('');
  const [showDeclineModal, setShowDeclineModal] = useState(false);

  const passesAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const studentsAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedSearch(sanitizeInput(search, 80));
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [search]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      passesAbortRef.current?.abort();
      studentsAbortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const fetchPasses = useCallback(
    async (bypassCache = false) => {
      passesAbortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      passesAbortRef.current = controller;

      const baseParams = {
        search: debouncedSearch || undefined,
        status: statusFilter !== 'ALL' ? statusFilter : undefined,
      };
      const cached = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses, baseParams) : undefined;
      if (cached) {
        const cachedList = cached?.results ?? (Array.isArray(cached) ? cached : []);
        setPasses(cachedList);
        setLoading(false);
      } else {
        setLoading(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<any>(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses, {
          params: {
            ...baseParams,
            ...(bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {}),
          },
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const list = res.data?.results ?? (Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : []);
        setPasses(list);
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Failed to fetch exit passes.'));
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [debouncedSearch, statusFilter]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchPasses(false);
  }, [fetchPasses]);

  const fetchStudents = async () => {
    studentsAbortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    studentsAbortRef.current = controller;

    const cached = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.students.dropdown);
    if (cached) {
      const list = cached?.results ?? (Array.isArray(cached) ? cached : []);
      setStudents(list);
      setLoadingStudents(false);
    } else {
      setLoadingStudents(true);
    }

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.get<any>(API_ROUTES.students.dropdown, {
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
      const list = res.data?.results ?? (Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : []);
      setStudents(list);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
        return;
      }
      setStudents([]);
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
        setLoadingStudents(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const toInputDate = (d: Date) => {
    const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}T${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;
  };

  const handleOpenCreateModal = (type: 'STUDENT' | 'FACULTY') => {
    setEditingPass(null);
    setPassFormType(type);
    const now = new Date();

    setFormData({
      student_id: '',
      pass_type: type === 'STUDENT' ? 'Clinic / Medical Clearance' : 'Official DepEd Travel Order',
      reason: '',
      valid_from: toInputDate(now),
      valid_to: toInputDate(new Date(now.getTime() + 4 * 3600000)),
    });
    setAttachedFile(null);

    if (type === 'STUDENT') {
      void fetchStudents();
    }
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEditModal = (pass: GatePass) => {
    setEditingPass(pass);
    setPassFormType(pass.bearer_type || (pass.student ? 'STUDENT' : 'FACULTY'));
    const fromDt = pass.valid_from ? new Date(pass.valid_from) : new Date();
    const toDt = (pass.valid_until || pass.valid_to) ? new Date(pass.valid_until || pass.valid_to) : new Date(Date.now() + 4 * 3600000);

    setFormData({
      student_id: pass.student ? String(pass.student) : '',
      pass_type: pass.pass_type || '',
      reason: pass.reason || '',
      valid_from: isNaN(fromDt.getTime()) ? toInputDate(new Date()) : toInputDate(fromDt),
      valid_to: isNaN(toDt.getTime()) ? toInputDate(new Date(Date.now() + 4 * 3600000)) : toInputDate(toDt),
    });
    setAttachedFile(null);

    if (pass.bearer_type === 'STUDENT' || pass.student) {
      void fetchStudents();
    }
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmitPass = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (attachedFile && attachedFile.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'File Too Large',
        message: 'Proof attachment must be 5 MB or smaller.',
        type: 'warning',
      });
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const cleanPassType = sanitizeInput(formData.pass_type, 100);
      const cleanReason = sanitizeInput(formData.reason, 500);
      if (!cleanPassType || !cleanReason) {
        showAlert({ title: 'Details Required', message: 'Please enter a valid clearance category and reason.', type: 'warning' });
        setSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }

      const payload = new FormData();
      payload.append('bearer_type', passFormType);
      payload.append('pass_type', cleanPassType);
      payload.append('reason', cleanReason);
      payload.append('valid_from', new Date(formData.valid_from).toISOString());
      payload.append('valid_until', new Date(formData.valid_to).toISOString());
      payload.append('valid_to', new Date(formData.valid_to).toISOString());
      if (attachedFile) {
        payload.append('attachment', attachedFile);
      }

      if (passFormType === 'STUDENT') {
        if (!formData.student_id) {
          showAlert({ title: 'Student Required', message: 'Please select a student.', type: 'warning' });
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        payload.append('student', formData.student_id);
      }

      if (editingPass) {
        await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses}${editingPass.id}/`, payload, {
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
        });
        showAlert({
          title: 'Exit Pass Updated',
          message: `Exit pass #${editingPass.pass_number} has been updated.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      } else {
        await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses, payload, {
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
        });

        showAlert({
          title: passFormType === 'FACULTY' ? 'Travel Pass Submitted' : 'Student Exit Permit Issued',
          message:
            passFormType === 'FACULTY'
              ? 'Travel pass submitted to Principal/Admin for approval.'
              : 'Student exit permit generated and parent notified via mobile push.',
          type: 'success',
        });
      }

      setIsModalOpen(false);
      setEditingPass(null);
      await fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Submission Error',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Unable to submit exit pass.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeletePass = (pass: GatePass) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete Exit Pass',
      message: `Are you sure you want to permanently remove pass #${pass.pass_number}?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`${API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses}${pass.id}/`);
          setPasses((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== pass.id));
          showAlert({ title: 'Pass Deleted', message: `Pass #${pass.pass_number} has been removed.`, type: 'success' });
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({ title: 'Delete Failed', message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not delete exit pass.'), type: 'error' });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleApprove = async (passId: number) => {
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses}${passId}/approve/`);
      showAlert({ title: 'Pass Approved', message: 'Travel pass approved and active for campus departure.', type: 'success' });
      setReviewingPass(null);
      await fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to approve pass.'), type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleDecline = async () => {
    if (!reviewingPass) return;
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses}${reviewingPass.id}/decline/`, {
        reason: sanitizeInput(declineReason, 300) || 'Declined upon document authenticity review.',
      });
      showAlert({ title: 'Pass Declined', message: 'Exit pass has been declined.', type: 'info' });
      setShowDeclineModal(false);
      setDeclineReason('');
      setReviewingPass(null);
      await fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Error', message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to decline pass.'), type: 'error' });
    }
  };

  const handleMarkUsed = async (passId: number) => {
    try {
      await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.attendance.exitPasses}${passId}/mark-used/`);
      showAlert({ title: 'Exit Confirmed', message: 'Bearer departure confirmed.', type: 'success' });
      await fetchPasses(true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Notice', message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to confirm exit.'), type: 'warning' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16, padding: 'clamp(14px, 2.5vw, 24px)', boxSizing: 'border-box', width: '100%' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 12, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, padding: 14, borderRadius: 12, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          {['ALL', 'PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'USED', 'DECLINED'].map((st) => (
            <button
              key={st}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatusFilter(st)}
              style={{
                padding: '6px 14px',
                borderRadius: 20,
                fontSize: '0.74rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                border: `1px solid ${statusFilter === st ? brand.buttonBg : tokens.borderStrong}`,
                backgroundColor: statusFilter === st ? brand.buttonBg : tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                color: statusFilter === st ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textSecondary,
              }}
            >
              {st === 'PENDING' ? 'Pending Review' : st}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {!isRestrictedRole && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={() => handleOpenCreateModal('FACULTY')}>
              <FileText size={15} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} /> Request Official Travel Pass
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="md"
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleOpenCreateModal('STUDENT')}
            >
              <Plus size={15} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} /> Issue Student Exit Pass
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <ModuleTableLayout
        title="Campus Exit Passes & Exit Clearances"
        subtitle="Adviser student permits and official faculty travel authorizations."
        searchPlaceholder="Search pass #, student, faculty, reason..."
        searchValue={search}
        onSearchChange={setSearch}
        loading={loading}
        error={error}
        data={passes}
        keyExtractor={(p) => p.id}
        columns={[
          {
            header: 'Pass Reference #',
            render: (p) => (
              <div>
                <strong style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace', color: brand.primary }}>{p.pass_number}</strong>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>{p.bearer_type} CLEARANCE</div>
              </div>
            ),
          },
          {
            header: 'Authorized Bearer',
            render: (p) => (
              <div>
                <strong style={{ color: tokens.textPrimary, fontSize: '0.86rem' }}>
                  {p.bearer_type === 'STUDENT' ? p.student_name : p.faculty_name}
                </strong>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                  {p.bearer_type === 'STUDENT' ? `LRN: ${p.student_lrn || '—'}` : `Emp ID: ${p.faculty_emp_id || '—'}`}
                </div>
              </div>
            ),
          },
          {
            header: 'Class Adviser / Issuer',
            render: (p) => (
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                <strong>{p.adviser_name || 'Staff User'}</strong>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.66rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>Issuing Authority</div>
              </div>
            ),
          },
          {
            header: 'Reason & Proof File',
            render: (p) => (
              <div style={{ maxWidth: 220 }}>
                <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{p.pass_type}</span>
                <p style={{ margin: '2px 0 0 0', fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>{p.reason}</p>
                {isSafeProofUrl(p.attachment_url) ? (
                  <a
                    href={p.attachment_url!}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 700, display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, marginTop: 4 }}
                  >
                    <ExternalLink size={11} /> View Attached Proof
                  </a>
                ) : (
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>No file attached</span>
                )}
              </div>
            ),
          },
          {
            header: 'Status',
            render: (p) => {
              const colorMap: Record<string, string> = {
                PENDING: '#f59e0b',
                ACTIVE: '#10b981',
                USED: '#0284c7',
                DECLINED: '#ef4444',
                EXPIRED: '#64748b',
              };
              return (
                <span
                  style={{
                    padding: '3px 8px',
                    borderRadius: 10,
                    fontSize: '0.68rem',
                    fontWeight: 800,
                    backgroundColor: `${colorMap[p.status] || '#64748b'}20`,
                    color: colorMap[p.status] || '#64748b',
                  }}
                >
                  {p.status}
                </span>
              );
            },
          },
          {
            header: 'Actions',
            align: 'right',
            render: (p) => (
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSelectedPass(p)}
                  title="View Slip"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`, borderRadius: 6, padding: '6px 8px', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                >
                  <QrCode size={14} color={brand.primary} />
                </button>

                {isPrincipalOrAdmin && p.status === 'PENDING' && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setReviewingPass(p)}
                    style={{ backgroundColor: brand.buttonBg, color: '#ffffff', border: 'none', borderRadius: 6, padding: '6px 10px', fontSize: '0.72rem', fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer' }}
                  >
                    Review Authenticity
                  </button>
                )}

                {!isRestrictedRole && p.status === 'ACTIVE' && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleMarkUsed(p.id)}
                    title="Confirm Exit"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.successLight, border: `1px solid ${brand.success}`, borderRadius: 6, padding: '6px 8px', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                  >
                    <CheckCircle2 size={14} color={brand.success} />
                  </button>
                )}

                {!isRestrictedRole && (isPrincipalOrAdmin || p.status !== 'USED') && (
                  <>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleOpenEditModal(p)}
                      title="Edit Exit Pass"
                      aria-label={`Edit pass ${p.pass_number}`}
                      style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`, borderRadius: 6, padding: '6px 8px', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                    >
                      <Edit2 size={14} color={brand.primary} />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleDeletePass(p)}
                      title="Delete Exit Pass"
                      aria-label={`Delete pass ${p.pass_number}`}
                      style={{ backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight, border: `1px solid ${brand.danger}`, borderRadius: 6, padding: '6px 8px', cursor: 'pointer' }}
                    >
                      <Trash2 size={14} color={brand.danger} />
                    </button>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            ),
          },
        ]}
      />

      <Modal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        onClose={() => {
          setIsModalOpen(false);
          setEditingPass(null);
        }}
        title={
          editingPass
            ? `Edit Exit Pass #${editingPass.pass_number}`
            : passFormType === 'FACULTY'
              ? 'Request Official Travel Pass'
              : 'Issue Student Exit Permit'
        }
      >
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmitPass} style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
          {passFormType === 'STUDENT' ? (
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Select Student Learner *</label>
              {loadingStudents ? (
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textMuted, padding: '8px 0' }}>Loading student list...</div>
              ) : (
                <select
                  required
                  value={formData.student_id}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, student_id: e.target.value })}
                  style={ui.input}
                >
                  <option value="">-- Choose Student --</option>
                  {students.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                      {s.full_name} (LRN: {s.lrn})
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div style={{ padding: 10, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, borderRadius: 8, fontSize: '0.74rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
              <strong>Notice:</strong> Your official travel pass will be submitted to the School Principal or Administrator for file review.
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>Clearance Category *</label>
            <input
              type="text"
              required
              maxLength={100}
              value={formData.pass_type}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, pass_type: e.target.value })}
              style={ui.input}
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>Valid Reason &amp; Destination Details *</label>
            <textarea
              required
              rows={3}
              maxLength={500}
              value={formData.reason}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, reason: e.target.value })}
              placeholder="State purpose of travel or valid exit reason..."
              style={ui.input}
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label style={ui.label}>
              Upload Supporting Document (PDF, JPG, PNG, or WEBP up to 5 MB) {editingPass ? '(Optional to replace)' : ''}
            </label>
            <input
              type="file"
              accept=".pdf,image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp"
              onChange={(e) => setAttachedFile(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
              style={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textPrimary }}
            />
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 190px), 1fr))', gap: 10 }}>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Departure Time</label>
              <input
                type="datetime-local"
                required
                value={formData.valid_from}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, valid_from: e.target.value })}
                style={ui.input}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label style={ui.label}>Expected Return</label>
              <input
                type="datetime-local"
                required
                value={formData.valid_to}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, valid_to: e.target.value })}
                style={ui.input}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, marginTop: 10 }}>
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              size="md"
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setIsModalOpen(false);
                setEditingPass(null);
              }}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button variant="primary" size="md" type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
              {submitting ? 'Saving...' : editingPass ? 'Save Changes' : 'Submit Exit Pass'}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </Modal>

      {reviewingPass && (
        <Modal isOpen={Boolean(reviewingPass)} onClose={() => setReviewingPass(null)} title="Inspect Proof Document Authenticity">
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <div>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>APPLICANT</span>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '1rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                {reviewingPass.bearer_type === 'STUDENT' ? reviewingPass.student_name : reviewingPass.faculty_name}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textMuted }}>PURPOSE OF TRAVEL</span>
              <p style={{ margin: '3px 0 0 0', fontSize: '0.84rem', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{reviewingPass.reason}</p>
            </div>

            <div style={{ padding: 12, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, borderRadius: 8, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textMuted }}>ATTACHED PROOF FILE</span>
              {isSafeProofUrl(reviewingPass.attachment_url) ? (
                <div style={{ marginTop: 6, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Uploaded file on record</span>
                  <a
                    href={reviewingPass.attachment_url!}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    style={{ backgroundColor: brand.buttonBg, color: '#ffffff', padding: '6px 12px', borderRadius: 6, fontSize: '0.74rem', fontWeight: 700, textDecoration: 'none', display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4 }}
                  >
                    <ExternalLink size={12} /> Inspect File
                  </a>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div style={{ color: brand.danger, fontSize: '0.76rem', marginTop: 4 }}>No document attached!</div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 10, marginTop: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={() => setShowDeclineModal(true)} style={{ color: brand.danger }}>
                <FileX size={15} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} /> Decline (Invalid Proof)
              </Button>
              <Button variant="primary" size="md" type="button" onClick={() => handleApprove(reviewingPass.id)} style={{ backgroundColor: successBtnBg, borderColor: successBtnBg }}>
                <FileCheck size={15} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} /> Approve Authentic Travel Pass
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {showDeclineModal && reviewingPass && (
        <Modal isOpen={showDeclineModal} onClose={() => setShowDeclineModal(false)} title="Decline Exit Pass">
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
            <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '0.80rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
              Provide the reason for declining this request (e.g. unverified travel order, missing school seal).
            </p>
            <textarea
              rows={3}
              maxLength={300}
              value={declineReason}
              onChange={(e) => setDeclineReason(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="State reason for declining..."
              style={ui.input}
            />
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8 }}>
              <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={() => setShowDeclineModal(false)}>
                Cancel
              </Button>
              <Button variant="danger" size="md" type="button" onClick={handleDecline}>
                Confirm Decline
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}

      {selectedPass && (
        <Modal isOpen={Boolean(selectedPass)} onClose={() => setSelectedPass(null)} title="Official Campus Exit Slip">
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', textAlign: 'center' }}>
            <div style={{ width: 300, backgroundColor: '#ffffff', border: '2px solid #0f172a', borderRadius: 8, padding: 14 }}>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.64rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#64748b' }}>DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION</div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.90rem', fontWeight: 900, color: '#0f172a', marginTop: 2 }}>
                {school.school_name || 'ATTENDSURE CAMPUS'}
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.74rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#004b87', marginTop: 2 }}>
                OFFICIAL EXIT CLEARANCE SLIP
              </div>
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.66rem', color: '#64748b', fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>Pass #: {selectedPass.pass_number}</div>

              <div style={{ borderTop: '1px dashed #cbd5e1', borderBottom: '1px dashed #cbd5e1', padding: '8px 0', margin: '8px 0' }}>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: '#64748b' }}>Bearer Name</div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.98rem', fontWeight: 800, color: '#0f172a' }}>
                  {selectedPass.bearer_type === 'STUDENT' ? selectedPass.student_name : selectedPass.faculty_name}
                </div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '0.72rem', color: '#475569', marginTop: 2 }}>
                  <strong>Reason:</strong> {selectedPass.reason}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div style={{ margin: '8px auto', width: 130, height: 130, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
                <QrCodeSvg
                  value={`ATTENDSURE-EXITPASS:${selectedPass.pass_number}`}
                  size={130}
                  label={`Exit Pass QR code for ${selectedPass.pass_number}`}
                />
              </div>

              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.66rem', color: '#334155', textAlign: 'left', borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0', paddingTop: 6 }}>
                <div>
                  <strong>Class Adviser / Issuer:</strong> {selectedPass.adviser_name || 'Adviser'}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <strong>Valid Until:</strong>{' '}
                  {new Date(selectedPass.valid_until || selectedPass.valid_to).toLocaleTimeString([], {
                    hour: '2-digit',
                    minute: '2-digit',
                  })}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <strong>Status:</strong>{' '}
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: selectedPass.status === 'ACTIVE' ? '#059669' : '#d97706' }}>
                    {selectedPass.status}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, marginTop: 14 }}>
              <Button variant="secondary" size="md" type="button" onClick={() => setSelectedPass(null)}>
                Close
              </Button>
              <Button variant="primary" size="md" type="button" onClick={() => window.print()}>
                <Printer size={15} style={{ marginRight: 6 }} /> Print Slip
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default GatePassesTab;

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 80): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const formatMeters = (val: unknown): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined || val === '') return '—';
  if (typeof val === 'number') {
    return Number.isFinite(val) ? `${Math.round(val)}m` : '—';
  }
  const str = String(val).trim();
  if (!str || str === 'null' || str === 'undefined') return '—';
  return str.endsWith('m') ? str : `${str}m`;
};

const formatBattery = (val: unknown): string => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined || val === '') return '—';
  const str = String(val).trim();
  if (!str || str === 'null' || str === 'undefined') return '—';
  return str.endsWith('%') ? str : `${str}%`;
};

export const GeofenceTab: React.FC = () => {

  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { mode, tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();
  const successBtnBg = mode === 'dark' ? '#059669' : brand.success;

  const [activeScreen, setActiveScreen] = useState<'LIVE_MAP' | 'AUDIT_SCREEN'>('LIVE_MAP');

  const circleInstanceRef = useRef<L.Circle | null>(null);
  const markerInstanceRef = useRef<L.Marker | null>(null);
  const userMarkersLayerRef = useRef<L.LayerGroup | null>(null);
  const tileLayerRef = useRef<(L.TileLayer & { _layerType?: string }) | null>(null);
  const resizeTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const geoAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const auditAbortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const cachedGeo = peekApiCache<GeofenceData>(API_ROUTES.campus.boundary);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(!cachedGeo);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [resettingId, setResettingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [mapLayer, setMapLayer] = useState<'streets' | 'satellite'>('streets');
  const [geoData, setGeoData] = useState<GeofenceData | null>(cachedGeo ?? null);

  const [auditRecords, setAuditRecords] = useState<AuditRecord[]>([]);
  const [auditLoading, setAuditLoading] = useState(false);
  const [totalDatabaseRecords, setTotalDatabaseRecords] = useState<number>(0);
  const [auditSearchQuery, setAuditSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [auditFacultyFilter, setAuditFacultyFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');
  const [auditVerdictFilter, setAuditVerdictFilter] = useState<'ALL' | 'INSIDE' | 'OUTSIDE'>('ALL');
  const [dateFilterMode, setDateFilterMode] = useState<'ALL_LOGS' | 'SPECIFIC_DATE'>('ALL_LOGS');
  const [auditDate, setAuditDate] = useState<string>(() => new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);

  const [lat, setLat] = useState<number | null>(() => {
    const sLat = parseFloat(String(cachedGeo?.latitude ?? (school as any)?.latitude));
    return !isNaN(sLat) && sLat !== 0 ? sLat : null;
  });

  const [lng, setLng] = useState<number | null>(() => {
    const sLng = parseFloat(String(cachedGeo?.longitude ?? (school as any)?.longitude));
    return !isNaN(sLng) && sLng !== 0 ? sLng : null;
  });

  const [radius, setRadius] = useState<number | null>(() => {
    const sRad = parseInt(
      String(
        cachedGeo?.radius_meters ??
          (school as any)?.geofence_radius ??
          (school as any)?.geofence_radius_meters ??
          (school as any)?.radius_meters
      ),
      10
    );
    return !isNaN(sRad) && sRad > 0 ? sRad : null;
  });

  const isDirtyRef = useRef(false);
  const isInteracting = useRef(false);
  isInteracting.current = saving || resettingId !== null;

  const userRole = (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || '').toUpperCase();
  const isAdmin = ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL'].includes(userRole);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      geoAbortRef.current?.abort();
      auditAbortRef.current?.abort();
      if (resizeTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(resizeTimerRef.current);
        resizeTimerRef.current = null;
      }
      if (mapInstanceRef.current) {
        try {
          mapInstanceRef.current.remove();
        } catch {
          // Ignore teardown error
        }
        mapInstanceRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const fetchGeofenceData = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      geoAbortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      geoAbortRef.current = controller;

      const warmHit = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<GeofenceData>(API_ROUTES.campus.boundary) : undefined;
      if (warmHit) {
        setGeoData(warmHit);
        setLoading(false);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      }

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<GeofenceData>(API_ROUTES.campus.boundary, {
          timeout: 8000,
          params: bypassCache || silent ? { nocache: 1 } : undefined,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        if (res.data) {
          setGeoData(res.data);
          if (!isDirtyRef.current) {
            const recLat = res.data.latitude !== null ? parseFloat(String(res.data.latitude)) : null;
            const recLng = res.data.longitude !== null ? parseFloat(String(res.data.longitude)) : null;
            const recRad =
              res.data.radius_meters !== null ? parseInt(String(res.data.radius_meters), 10) : null;

            if (recLat !== null && !isNaN(recLat)) setLat(recLat);
            if (recLng !== null && !isNaN(recLng)) setLng(recLng);
            if (recRad !== null && !isNaN(recRad)) setRadius(recRad);
          }
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Connection Notice',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Unable to reach the school server for location updates.'),
            type: 'warning',
          });
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted && !silent) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [showAlert]
  );

  const fetchAuditHistory = useCallback(
    async (silent = false) => {
      auditAbortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      auditAbortRef.current = controller;

      if (!silent) setAuditLoading(true);
      try {
        const params: Record<string, string | number> = { nocache: 1 };
        if (dateFilterMode === 'SPECIFIC_DATE' && auditDate) {
          params.date_from = auditDate;
          params.date_to = auditDate;
        }
        if (auditFacultyFilter !== 'ALL') {
          params.faculty_id = auditFacultyFilter;
        }
        if (auditVerdictFilter !== 'ALL') {
          params.status = auditVerdictFilter;
        }
        const cleanQuery = sanitizeInput(auditSearchQuery, 80);
        if (cleanQuery) {
          params.search = cleanQuery;
        }

        const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.campus.audit, {
          params,
          timeout: 8000,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        if (res.data?.records) {
          setAuditRecords(res.data.records);
          setTotalDatabaseRecords(res.data.count ?? res.data.total_heartbeats ?? res.data.records.length);
        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Audit Log Error',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not load campus location logs from the server.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted && !silent) {
          setAuditLoading(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [dateFilterMode, auditDate, auditFacultyFilter, auditVerdictFilter, auditSearchQuery, showAlert]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchGeofenceData(false, false);
  }, [fetchGeofenceData]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const liveInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current && !isDirtyRef.current && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        if (activeScreen === 'LIVE_MAP') {
          void fetchGeofenceData(true, true);
        } else if (activeScreen === 'AUDIT_SCREEN') {
          void fetchAuditHistory(true);
        }
      }
    }, 6000);
    return () => clearInterval(liveInterval);
  }, [fetchGeofenceData, fetchAuditHistory, activeScreen]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeScreen === 'AUDIT_SCREEN') {
      void fetchAuditHistory(false);
    }
  }, [activeScreen, fetchAuditHistory]);

  // Local Bundled Leaflet Initialization (works offline even when tile servers are unreachable)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeScreen !== 'LIVE_MAP' || !mapContainerRef.current) return;
    if (lat === null || lng === null) return;

    const getTileUrl = (layer: 'streets' | 'satellite') => {
      if (layer === 'satellite') {
        return 'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}';
      }
      return 'https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png';
    };

    if (mapInstanceRef.current && mapInstanceRef.current.getContainer() !== mapContainerRef.current) {
      try {
        mapInstanceRef.current.remove();
      } catch {
        // Ignore stale container cleanup
      }
      mapInstanceRef.current = null;
      markerInstanceRef.current = null;
      circleInstanceRef.current = null;
      userMarkersLayerRef.current = null;
      tileLayerRef.current = null;
    }

    if (resizeTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimerRef.current);
      resizeTimerRef.current = null;
    }

    if (!mapInstanceRef.current) {
      const map = L.map(mapContainerRef.current, {
        center: [lat, lng],
        zoom: 17,
        zoomControl: true,
      });

      const tileLayer = L.tileLayer(getTileUrl(mapLayer), {
        maxZoom: 19,
        attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap contributors',
      }).addTo(map) as L.TileLayer & { _layerType?: string };
      tileLayer._layerType = mapLayer;
      tileLayerRef.current = tileLayer;

      userMarkersLayerRef.current = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
      mapInstanceRef.current = map;

      resizeTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        map.invalidateSize();
      }, 250);

      map.on('click', (e: L.LeafletMouseEvent) => {
        if (!isAdmin) return;
        isDirtyRef.current = true;
        setLat(parseFloat(e.latlng.lat.toFixed(6)));
        setLng(parseFloat(e.latlng.lng.toFixed(6)));
      });
    } else {
      resizeTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        mapInstanceRef.current?.invalidateSize();
      }, 150);
    }

    const currentMap = mapInstanceRef.current;

    if (tileLayerRef.current && tileLayerRef.current._layerType !== mapLayer) {
      currentMap.removeLayer(tileLayerRef.current);
      const nextTile = L.tileLayer(getTileUrl(mapLayer), { maxZoom: 19 }).addTo(currentMap) as L.TileLayer & {
        _layerType?: string;
      };
      nextTile._layerType = mapLayer;
      tileLayerRef.current = nextTile;
    }

    const campusCenterIcon = L.divIcon({
      className: 'campus-center-beacon',
      html: `
        <div style="width: 36px; height: 36px; background-color: #004b87; border: 3px solid #ffffff; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,75,135,0.5); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #ffffff;">
          <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
            <path d="M20 10c0 6-8 12-8 12s-8-6-8-12a8 8 0 0 1 16 0Z"/>
            <circle cx="12" cy="10" r="3"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
      `,
      iconSize: [36, 36],
      iconAnchor: [18, 36],
    });

    if (markerInstanceRef.current) {
      markerInstanceRef.current.setLatLng([lat, lng]);
    } else {
      markerInstanceRef.current = L.marker([lat, lng], {
        icon: campusCenterIcon,
        draggable: isAdmin,
      }).addTo(currentMap);

      markerInstanceRef.current.on('dragend', (e: L.DragEndEvent) => {
        isDirtyRef.current = true;
        const pos = (e.target as L.Marker).getLatLng();
        setLat(parseFloat(pos.lat.toFixed(6)));
        setLng(parseFloat(pos.lng.toFixed(6)));
      });
    }

    if (radius !== null) {
      if (circleInstanceRef.current) {
        circleInstanceRef.current.setLatLng([lat, lng]);
        circleInstanceRef.current.setRadius(radius);
      } else {
        circleInstanceRef.current = L.circle([lat, lng], {
          radius,
          color: '#0284c7',
          weight: 2.5,
          fillColor: '#38bdf8',
          fillOpacity: 0.14,
          dashArray: '6, 6',
        }).addTo(currentMap);
      }
    }
  }, [activeScreen, lat, lng, radius, mapLayer, isAdmin]);

  const renderSignalBars = (percentage: number | null | undefined) => {
    if (percentage === null || percentage === undefined) {
      return <span style={{ color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: '0.68rem' }}>—</span>;
    }

    const bars = [25, 50, 75, 100];
    const color = percentage >= 75 ? brand.success : percentage >= 45 ? brand.warning : brand.danger;

    return (
      <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 2, height: 14 }}>
        {bars.map((thresh, idx) => {
          const isActive = percentage >= thresh;
          const height = 4 + idx * 3;
          return (
            <span
              key={idx}
              style={{
                width: 3,
                height,
                backgroundColor: isActive ? color : tokens.borderStrong,
                borderRadius: 1,
              }}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>
    );
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeScreen !== 'LIVE_MAP' || !mapInstanceRef.current || !userMarkersLayerRef.current) return;
    const layer = userMarkersLayerRef.current;
    layer.clearLayers();

    const faculty = geoData?.faculty_list || [];

    faculty.forEach((user: FacultyListItem) => {
      const userLat = parseFloat(String(user.latitude));
      const userLng = parseFloat(String(user.longitude));

      if (isNaN(userLat) || isNaN(userLng) || userLat === 0 || userLng === 0) return;

      const isOnline = Boolean(user.is_online);
      const insideFlag = user.is_inside ?? user.is_inside_geofence ?? user.status === 'VERIFIED_INSIDE';
      const isBreach =
        user.status === 'PERIMETER_BREACH' || user.status === 'OFF_CAMPUS' || insideFlag === false;
      const isSpoof = Boolean(user.is_mock_location || user.status === 'SPOOF_ATTEMPT');

      const safeName = escapeHtml(user.faculty_name);
      const safeEmpId = escapeHtml(user.employee_id);
      const safePos = escapeHtml(user.position || '—');

      const safeSignal = escapeHtml(user.signal_strength || '—');
      const safeDist = escapeHtml(formatMeters(user.distance));
      const safeBat = escapeHtml(formatBattery(user.battery ?? user.battery_level));
      const safeIp = escapeHtml(user.ip_address || '—');
      const safeDev = escapeHtml(user.mac_address || user.bound_device_id || '—');

      const rawAvatar = user.photo_url || user.photo;
      const safeAvatar = isSafeImageUrl(rawAvatar) ? escapeHtml(rawAvatar!.trim()) : '';
      const safeInitials = escapeHtml(
        (user.faculty_name || '')
          .split(' ')
          .map((n) => n[0] || '')
          .slice(0, 2)
          .join('')
          .toUpperCase()
      );

      if ((isBreach || isSpoof) && lat !== null && lng !== null) {
        const connectingLine = L.polyline(
          [
            [lat, lng],
            [userLat, userLng],
          ],
          {
            color: isSpoof ? '#dc2626' : isOnline ? '#e11d48' : '#94a3b8',
            weight: 2.5,
            opacity: isOnline ? 0.85 : 0.45,
            dashArray: '6, 8',
            lineCap: 'round',
          }
        ).addTo(layer);

        connectingLine.bindTooltip(
          `
            <div style="font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; padding: 2px;">
              <strong style="color: #991b1b;">${safeName}</strong><br/>
              <span>Distance to School: <strong>${safeDist}</strong></span>
            </div>
          `,
          { sticky: true, opacity: 0.95 }
        );
      }

      const pinColor = isOnline ? (isBreach ? '#dc2626' : '#16a34a') : '#64748b';
      const ringBg = isOnline ? 'rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.35)' : 'rgba(100, 116, 139, 0.15)';
      const statusLabel = isSpoof
        ? 'Fake GPS Blocked'
        : isBreach
          ? 'Outside School Grounds'
          : 'Inside School Grounds';
      const onlineTag = isOnline ? '● Online' : '○ Offline';

      const avatarInnerHtml = safeAvatar
        ? `<img src="${safeAvatar}" alt="${safeName}" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;" onerror="this.style.display='none'; this.nextElementSibling.style.display='flex';" /><div style="display: none; width: 100%; height: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #f1f5f9; color: ${pinColor}; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px;">${safeInitials}</div>`
        : `<div style="display: flex; width: 100%; height: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background-color: #f1f5f9; color: ${pinColor}; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px;">${safeInitials}</div>`;

      const userLocationPinIcon = L.divIcon({
        className: 'user-location-pin-marker',
        html: `
          <div style="position: relative; width: 50px; height: 60px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.30));">
            ${
              isOnline
                ? `<div style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 1px; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: ${ringBg}; z-index: 0;"></div>`
                : ''
            }
            <svg width="50" height="60" viewBox="0 0 50 60" fill="none" style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; z-index: 1;">
              <path d="M25 0C11.193 0 0 11.193 0 25C0 41.5 25 60 25 60C25 60 50 41.5 50 25C50 11.193 38.807 0 25 0Z" fill="${pinColor}"/>
              <circle cx="25" cy="25" r="21" fill="#ffffff"/>
            </svg>
            <div style="position: absolute; top: 4px; left: 4px; width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; background-color: #ffffff; z-index: 2;">
              ${avatarInnerHtml}
            </div>
            <div style="position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 4px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: ${pinColor}; border: 2px solid #ffffff; z-index: 4;"></div>
            <div style="position: absolute; top: 64px; z-index: 3; background-color: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.94); color: #ffffff; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; white-space: nowrap; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.30); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); pointer-events: none;">
              ${safeName} &bull; <span style="color: ${isOnline ? '#4ade80' : '#cbd5e1'}; font-weight: 800;">${onlineTag}</span> (${safeDist})
            </div>
          </div>
        `,
        iconSize: [50, 60],
        iconAnchor: [25, 60],
      });

      const marker = L.marker([userLat, userLng], { icon: userLocationPinIcon }).addTo(layer);

      const tooltipContent = `
        <div style="font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; min-width: 210px; padding: 4px;">
          <div style="font-weight: 800; font-size: 12px; color: #0f172a; margin-bottom: 2px;">${safeName}</div>
          <div style="color: #64748b; font-size: 10px; margin-bottom: 6px;">ID: ${safeEmpId} &bull; ${safePos}</div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 3px;">
            <span>Connection:</span>
            <strong style="color: ${isOnline ? '#16a34a' : '#64748b'};">${safeConn}</strong>
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 3px;">
            <span>Signal Strength:</span>
            <strong style="color: #004b87;">${safeSignal}</strong>
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 3px;">
            <span>Campus Boundary:</span>
            <strong style="color: ${isBreach ? '#dc2626' : '#16a34a'};">${escapeHtml(statusLabel)}</strong>
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 3px;">
            <span>Distance from School:</span>
            <strong>${safeDist}</strong>
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 3px;">
            <span>Device Battery:</span>
            <strong>${safeBat}</strong>
          </div>
          <div style="color: #004b87; font-size: 9px; font-family: monospace; margin-top: 4px; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding-top: 3px;">
            IP: ${safeIp} &bull; Device ID: ${safeDev}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;

      marker.bindTooltip(tooltipContent, {
        direction: 'top',
        offset: [0, -60],
        opacity: 0.98,
      });
    });
  }, [activeScreen, geoData, lat, lng, radius]);

  const handleFitAllOnMap = () => {
    if (!mapInstanceRef.current || lat === null || lng === null) return;
    const bounds = L.latLngBounds([[lat, lng]]);

    (geoData?.faculty_list || []).forEach((u) => {
      const uLat = parseFloat(String(u.latitude));
      const uLng = parseFloat(String(u.longitude));
      if (!isNaN(uLat) && !isNaN(uLng) && uLat !== 0) {
        bounds.extend([uLat, uLng]);
      }
    });

    mapInstanceRef.current.fitBounds(bounds, { padding: [70, 70], maxZoom: 17 });
  };

  const handleDetectGPS = () => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Hardware Error', message: 'GPS location is not supported by this browser.', type: 'error' });
      return;
    }

    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      (pos) => {
        isDirtyRef.current = true;
        const detectedLat = parseFloat(pos.coords.latitude.toFixed(6));
        const detectedLng = parseFloat(pos.coords.longitude.toFixed(6));
        setLat(detectedLat);
        setLng(detectedLng);
        if (mapInstanceRef.current) {
          mapInstanceRef.current.flyTo([detectedLat, detectedLng], 17);
        }
        showAlert({
          title: 'Location Centered',
          message: `Coordinates centered: ${detectedLat}°N, ${detectedLng}°E.`,
          type: 'success',
        });
      },
      (err) => {
        showAlert({ title: 'Location Error', message: err.message, type: 'warning' });
      },
      { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 10000 }
    );
  };

  const handleSavePerimeter = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isAdmin || lat === null || lng === null || radius === null) return;

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await apiClient.put(
        API_ROUTES.campus.boundary,
        {
          latitude: lat,
          longitude: lng,
          radius_meters: radius,
        },
        { timeout: 8000 }
      );

      isDirtyRef.current = false;
      showAlert({
        title: 'Boundary Saved',
        message: res.data?.message || 'School boundary updated successfully.',
        type: 'success',
      });
      await refreshSchool();
      await fetchGeofenceData(true, true);
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Save Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not update boundary settings.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResetDevice = (facultyId: number, facultyName: string) => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Reset Phone Device Lock',
      message: `Unbind the registered phone for ${facultyName}? This clears their 1-to-1 device lock so they can register a replacement phone on their next check-in.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Reset Device Lock',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setResettingId(facultyId);
        try {
          const res = await apiClient.post(`${API_ROUTES.accounts.faculty}${facultyId}/reset-device/`);
          showAlert({
            title: 'Device Lock Cleared',
            message: res.data?.message || `Phone binding for ${facultyName} has been cleared.`,
            type: 'success',
          });
          await fetchGeofenceData(true, true);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Reset Failed',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not clear device binding.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        } finally {
          setResettingId(null);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const exportAuditCSV = () => {
    if (auditRecords.length === 0) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Empty Export', message: 'No location records available to export.', type: 'warning' });
      return;
    }

    const headers = [
      'Timestamp',
      'Faculty Member',
      'Employee ID',
      'Presence Status',
      'Distance from School',
      'Signal Strength',
      'IP Address',
      'Device ID',
      'Battery',
      'Device Model',
    ];
    const rows = auditRecords.map((r) => {
      const inside = Boolean(r.is_inside ?? r.is_inside_geofence);
      return [
        r.timestamp,
        r.faculty_name,
        r.employee_id || '—',
        inside ? 'Inside School Grounds' : 'Outside School Grounds',
        formatMeters(r.distance),
        r.signal_strength || '—',
        r.ip_address || '—',
        r.mac_address || r.bound_device_id || '—',
        formatBattery(r.battery ?? r.battery_level),
        r.device_model || '—',
      ];
    });

    exportToCsv(
      `AttendSure_Campus_GPS_Logs_${dateFilterMode === 'ALL_LOGS' ? 'All_Logs' : auditDate}.csv`,
      headers,
      rows
    );
  };

  const badgePill = (bg: string, color: string, border: string): React.CSSProperties => ({
    display: 'inline-flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    padding: '2px 8px',
    borderRadius: 4,
    backgroundColor: bg,
    color,
    border: `1px solid ${border}`,
    fontSize: '0.64rem',
    fontWeight: 800,
    letterSpacing: '0.3px',
  });

  const getStatusBadge = (s: FacultyListItem) => {
    if (s.is_mock_location || s.status === 'SPOOF_ATTEMPT') {
      return (
        <span style={badgePill(tokens.dangerLight, brand.danger, brand.danger)}>
          <ShieldAlert size={11} style={{ marginRight: 3 }} /> Fake GPS Blocked
        </span>
      );
    }

    const inside = s.is_inside ?? s.is_inside_geofence;
    const hasCoords = s.latitude !== null && s.latitude !== undefined;

    if (s.status === 'VERIFIED_INSIDE' || (hasCoords && inside === true)) {
      return (
        <span style={badgePill(tokens.successLight, brand.success, brand.success)}>
          <Check size={11} style={{ marginRight: 3 }} /> Inside School Grounds
        </span>
      );
    }
    if (s.status === 'AUTHORIZED_LEAVE') {
      return <span style={badgePill(tokens.primaryLight, brand.primary, brand.primary)}>Official Exit Pass</span>;
    }
    if (s.status === 'PERIMETER_BREACH' || s.status === 'OFF_CAMPUS' || (hasCoords && inside === false)) {
      return <span style={badgePill(tokens.dangerLight, brand.danger, brand.danger)}>Outside School Grounds</span>;
    }
    if (s.status === 'HEARTBEAT_LOST') {
      return <span style={badgePill(tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, tokens.textSecondary, tokens.borderStrong)}>Signal Lost</span>;
    }
    return <span style={badgePill(tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, tokens.textMuted, tokens.borderSubtle)}>No Signal Today</span>;
  };

  const screenSwitchBtn = (active: boolean): React.CSSProperties => ({
    display: 'inline-flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 5,
    padding: '5px 10px',
    borderRadius: 5,
    border: 'none',
    backgroundColor: active ? brand.buttonBg : 'transparent',
    color: active ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textSecondary,
    fontWeight: active ? 800 : 600,
    fontSize: '0.72rem',
    cursor: 'pointer',
  });

  const layerToggleBtn = (active: boolean): React.CSSProperties => ({
    display: 'inline-flex',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 4,
    padding: '3px 8px',
    borderRadius: 4,
    border: 'none',
    backgroundColor: active ? tokens.bgSurface : 'transparent',
    color: active ? brand.primary : tokens.textSecondary,
    fontWeight: active ? 800 : 600,
    fontSize: '0.66rem',
    cursor: 'pointer',
  });

  const panelCard: React.CSSProperties = {
    backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
    borderRadius: 12,
    border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
    boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
    overflow: 'hidden',
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ padding: 'clamp(12px, 2.5vw, 20px)', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 10 }}>
        <div>
          <h2
            style={{
              fontSize: '1.20rem',
              fontWeight: 800,
              color: tokens.textPrimary,
              margin: 0,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 8,
            }}
          >
            <Building2 size={20} color={brand.primary} />
            <span>Campus GPS Boundary &amp; Location Audit</span>
          </h2>
          <p style={{ fontSize: '0.76rem', color: tokens.textSecondary, margin: '3px 0 0 0' }}>
            Live faculty mobile GPS check-ins, 1-to-1 device locks, and campus boundary tracking.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, borderRadius: 8, padding: 3, border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}` }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveScreen('LIVE_MAP')}
              style={screenSwitchBtn(activeScreen === 'LIVE_MAP')}
            >
              <MapPin size={12} />
              <span>Live Boundary Map</span>
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setActiveScreen('AUDIT_SCREEN')}
              style={screenSwitchBtn(activeScreen === 'AUDIT_SCREEN')}
            >
              <History size={12} />
              <span>Location Logs</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => (activeScreen === 'LIVE_MAP' ? void fetchGeofenceData(false, true) : void fetchAuditHistory(false))}
            disabled={loading || auditLoading}
            style={ui.btnSecondary}
          >
            <RefreshCw size={13} className={loading || auditLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
            <span>{activeScreen === 'LIVE_MAP' ? 'Refresh Map' : 'Refresh Logs'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* VIEW 1: LIVE MAP */}
      <div style={{ display: activeScreen === 'LIVE_MAP' ? 'flex' : 'none', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16 }}>
        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 200px), 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
          <StatsCard
            label="ONLINE FACULTY"
            value={geoData?.online_users_count ?? 0}
            valueColor={brand.success}
            helpText="Active GPS signal"
            badge={<Wifi size={18} color={brand.success} />}
          />
          <StatsCard
            label="OFFLINE FACULTY"
            value={geoData?.offline_users_count ?? 0}
            valueColor={tokens.textSecondary}
            helpText="No recent GPS check-in"
            badge={<WifiOff size={18} color={tokens.textMuted} />}
          />
          <StatsCard
            label="INSIDE SCHOOL GROUNDS"
            value={geoData?.verified_inside ?? 0}
            valueColor={brand.success}
            helpText={radius !== null ? `Within ${radius}m boundary` : 'Boundary not set'}
            badge={<ShieldCheck size={18} color={brand.success} />}
          />
          <StatsCard
            label="BOUNDARY ALERTS TODAY"
            value={geoData?.incidents_today ?? 0}
            valueColor={geoData?.incidents_today ? brand.danger : tokens.textPrimary}
            helpText="Beyond allowed campus area"
            badge={<AlertTriangle size={18} color={geoData?.incidents_today ? brand.danger : tokens.textMuted} />}
          />
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 360px), 1fr))', gap: 16, alignItems: 'start' }}>
          <div style={panelCard}>
            <div
              style={{
                padding: '10px 16px',
                borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                flexWrap: 'wrap',
                gap: 8,
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                <Compass size={15} color={brand.primary} />
                <span>Campus Boundary Map</span>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleFitAllOnMap}
                  style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, padding: '4px 8px', fontSize: '0.70rem', color: brand.primary }}
                  title="Zoom out to show school boundary and all faculty pins"
                >
                  <Maximize2 size={11} />
                  <span>Show All</span>
                </button>

                <div style={{ display: 'flex', backgroundColor: tokens.borderSubtle, borderRadius: 6, padding: 2 }}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setMapLayer('streets')}
                    style={layerToggleBtn(mapLayer === 'streets')}
                  >
                    <Layers size={11} />
                    <span>Roads</span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setMapLayer('satellite')}
                    style={layerToggleBtn(mapLayer === 'satellite')}
                  >
                    <Layers size={11} />
                    <span>Satellite</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {isAdmin && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleDetectGPS}
                    style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, padding: '4px 8px', fontSize: '0.70rem', color: brand.primary }}
                    title="Center map to your computer's GPS"
                  >
                    <Navigation size={11} />
                    <span>Center</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: 420, backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle }}>
              <div ref={mapContainerRef} style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', zIndex: 1 }} />
              <div
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  bottom: 10,
                  right: 10,
                  zIndex: 10,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  padding: '4px 8px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  fontSize: '0.68rem',
                  fontFamily: 'monospace',
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                  boxShadow: tokens.cardShadow,
                }}
              >
                {lat !== null && lng !== null
                  ? `Center: ${lat.toFixed(6)}°N, ${lng.toFixed(6)}°E • Radius: ${radius ?? 0}m`
                  : 'Boundary Not Configured in Database'}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div style={{ padding: '8px 16px', backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface, borderTop: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`, fontSize: '0.72rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
              <strong>Map Legend:</strong>
              <span style={{ color: brand.success, marginLeft: 8, fontWeight: 700 }}>&bull; Green Pin = Online</span>
              <span style={{ color: tokens.textMuted, marginLeft: 10, fontWeight: 700 }}>&bull; Gray Pin = Offline</span>
              <span style={{ marginLeft: 10, color: brand.danger, fontWeight: 600 }}>&bull; Dashed line = Outside school grounds</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14 }}>
            <div style={{ ...panelCard, padding: 18 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'space-between',
                  marginBottom: 12,
                  borderBottom: `1px solid ${tokens.borderSubtle}`,
                  paddingBottom: 8,
                }}
              >
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>Boundary Settings</div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '0.70rem', color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                    Official school boundary coordinates saved in database.
                  </div>
                </div>
                {!isAdmin && (
                  <span style={badgePill(tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle, tokens.textSecondary, tokens.borderSubtle)}>

                    <input
                      type="number"
                      step="any"
                      disabled={!isAdmin}
                      required
                      value={lat ?? ''}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        isDirtyRef.current = true;
                        const parsed = parseFloat(e.target.value);
                        setLat(isNaN(parsed) ? null : parsed);
                      }}
                      style={ui.input}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label style={ui.label}>Center Longitude (°E)</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      step="any"
                      disabled={!isAdmin}
                      required
                      value={lng ?? ''}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        isDirtyRef.current = true;
                        const parsed = parseFloat(e.target.value);
                        setLng(isNaN(parsed) ? null : parsed);
                      }}
                      style={ui.input}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 4 }}>
                    <label style={ui.label}>Boundary Radius</label>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '0.80rem', fontWeight: 800, color: brand.primary, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>
                      {radius !== null ? `${radius} meters` : 'Not set'}
                    </span>
