/**
 * AttendSure - Academic Timetables, Sections & Schedules
 * File: web/src/components/tabs/SchedulesTab.tsx
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import apiClient, { peekApiCache } from '../../api/client';
import { API_ROUTES, extractApiError } from '../../api/routes';
import { isSafeImageUrl } from '../../theme/tokens';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import { StatsCard } from '../common/StatsCard';
import { ProfileAvatar } from '../common/ProfileAvatar';
import {
  Calendar,
  DoorOpen,
  Users,
  Search,
  Filter,
  Edit2,
  Trash2,
  Clock,
  MapPin,
  BookOpen,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  RefreshCw,
  Plus,
  UserCheck,
  GraduationCap,
  Sparkles,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { AcademicSetupModal, type TabType as AcademicTabType } from '../modals/AcademicSetupModal';

interface ScheduleItem {
  id: number;
  schedule_code?: string;
  code?: string;
  section?: number | { id: number; name?: string; section_name?: string } | null;
  section_id?: number;
  section_name?: string;
  grade_level_name?: string;
  subject?: number | { id: number; code?: string; title?: string; name?: string } | null;
  subject_id?: number;
  subject_code?: string;
  subject_name?: string;
  subject_title?: string;
  faculty_id?: number;
  faculty?:
    | number
    | string
    | { id?: number; full_name?: string; name?: string; photo_url?: string; photo?: string; employee_id?: string }
    | null;
  faculty_name?: string;
  faculty_title?: string;
  room?: number | string | { id?: number; name?: string; room_number?: string } | null;
  room_name?: string;
  room_number?: string;
  start_time: string;
  end_time: string;
  days_of_week?: string;
}

interface SectionOption {
  id: number;
  name?: string;
  section_name?: string;
  code?: string;
  grade_level?: number | string | { id?: number; name?: string; code?: string };
  grade_level_name?: string;
  grade_level_code?: string;
  adviser?:
    | number
    | string
    | { id?: number; full_name?: string; name?: string; photo_url?: string; photo?: string; employee_id?: string }
    | null;
  adviser_id?: number | null;
  adviser_name?: string;
  adviser_full_name?: string;
  adviser_employee_id?: string;
  adviser_photo_url?: string | null;
  room_number?: string;
  capacity?: number;
  is_adviser?: boolean;
}

interface FacultyOption {
  id: number;
  full_name: string;
  name?: string;
  employee_id?: string;
  photo?: string | null;
  photo_url?: string | null;
  position?: string;
  department?: string;
  can_teach?: boolean;
}

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 60): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const getUserRole = (): string => {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem('attendsure_user') || localStorage.getItem('user');
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      return String(parsed.role || parsed.system_role || '').toUpperCase();
    }
    return String(localStorage.getItem('attendsure_role') || '').toUpperCase();
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
};

const getSectionDisplayName = (sec: SectionOption): string => {
  return sec.name || sec.section_name || `Section #${sec.id}`;
};

const extractList = <T,>(payload: unknown): T[] => {
  if (Array.isArray(payload)) return payload as T[];
  if (payload && typeof payload === 'object' && Array.isArray((payload as { results?: T[] }).results)) {
    return (payload as { results: T[] }).results;
  }
  return [];
};

export const SchedulesTab: React.FC = () => {
  const { showAlert, showConfirm } = useAlert();
  const { tokens, brand, ui } = useTheme();

  const cachedPeriods = peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.school.periods, { page_size: 500 });
  const cachedSections = peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.school.sections, { page_size: 500 });
  const cachedFaculty = peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.accounts.facultyDropdown);

  const [schedules, setSchedules] = useState<ScheduleItem[]>(() => extractList<ScheduleItem>(cachedPeriods));
  const [sections, setSections] = useState<SectionOption[]>(() => extractList<SectionOption>(cachedSections));
  const [facultyList, setFacultyList] = useState<FacultyOption[]>(() => extractList<FacultyOption>(cachedFaculty));
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(() => !cachedPeriods);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string>('');

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedSectionFilter, setSelectedSectionFilter] = useState<string>('ALL');

  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [modalTab, setModalTab] = useState<AcademicTabType>('SCHEDULE');
  const [editItem, setEditItem] = useState<any>(null);

  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const isInteracting = useRef(false);
  isInteracting.current = isModalOpen;

  const userRole = useMemo(() => getUserRole(), []);
  // Strict RBAC check: never fail open on empty/unknown role
  const canManageSchedule = useMemo(() => {
    return ['ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'FACULTY_ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'].includes(userRole);
  }, [userRole]);

  const loggedInFacultyName = useMemo(() => {
    return (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_faculty_name') || localStorage.getItem('faculty_name') || '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();
  }, []);

  const loggedInUsername = useMemo(() => {
    return (localStorage.getItem('attendsure_username') || localStorage.getItem('username') || '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase();
  }, []);

  const isSectionAdvisoryForUser = useCallback(
    (sec: SectionOption): boolean => {
      if (sec.is_adviser) return true;

      if (loggedInUsername && sec.adviser_employee_id && sec.adviser_employee_id.toLowerCase() === loggedInUsername) {
        return true;
      }

      if (loggedInFacultyName) {
        if (sec.adviser_name && sec.adviser_name.toLowerCase().includes(loggedInFacultyName)) return true;
        if (sec.adviser_full_name && sec.adviser_full_name.toLowerCase().includes(loggedInFacultyName)) return true;
        if (typeof sec.adviser === 'string' && sec.adviser.toLowerCase().includes(loggedInFacultyName)) return true;
        if (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser) {
          const advName = (sec.adviser.full_name || sec.adviser.name || '').toLowerCase();
          if (advName && (advName.includes(loggedInFacultyName) || loggedInFacultyName.includes(advName))) {
            return true;
          }
        }
      }

      return false;
    },
    [loggedInFacultyName, loggedInUsername]
  );

  const myAdvisorySection = useMemo(() => {
    return sections.find((sec) => isSectionAdvisoryForUser(sec)) || null;
  }, [sections, isSectionAdvisoryForUser]);

  const loadData = useCallback(async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
    abortRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    abortRef.current = controller;

    if (!bypassCache && !silent) {
      const warmPeriods = peekApiCache(API_ROUTES.school.periods, { page_size: 500 });
      if (warmPeriods) {
        setSchedules(extractList<ScheduleItem>(warmPeriods));
        setLoading(false);
      } else {
        setLoading(true);
      }
    } else if (!silent) {
      setLoading(true);
    }
    setError('');

    try {
      const cacheParam = bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : {};
      const results = await Promise.allSettled([
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.periods, {
          params: { page_size: 500, ...cacheParam },
          signal: controller.signal,
        }),
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.school.sections, {
          params: { page_size: 500, ...cacheParam },
          signal: controller.signal,
        }),
        apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.accounts.facultyDropdown, {
          params: cacheParam,
          signal: controller.signal,
        }),
      ]);

      if (controller.signal.aborted) return;

      const schedRes = results[0].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[0].value : null;
      const secRes = results[1].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[1].value : null;
      const facRes = results[2].status === 'fulfilled' ? results[2].value : null;

      if (schedRes?.data) setSchedules(extractList<ScheduleItem>(schedRes.data));
      if (secRes?.data) setSections(extractList<SectionOption>(secRes.data));
      if (facRes?.data) setFacultyList(extractList<FacultyOption>(facRes.data));

      if (results[0].status === 'rejected' && results[1].status === 'rejected') {
        const reason = results[0].reason as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (reason?.name !== 'CanceledError' && reason?.code !== 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          setError(extractApiError(results[0].reason, 'Could not load class schedule records.'));
        }
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
      if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
        return;
      }
      if (!silent) {
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load class schedule records. Please check server connection.'));
      }
    } finally {
      if (!controller.signal.aborted && !silent) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadData(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [loadData]);

  const hasAutoSelectedRef = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hasAutoSelectedRef.current && myAdvisorySection && userRole === 'FACULTY') {
      setSelectedSectionFilter(String(myAdvisorySection.id));
      hasAutoSelectedRef.current = true;
    }
  }, [myAdvisorySection, userRole]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const liveInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        void loadData(true, true);
      }
    }, 12000);
    return () => clearInterval(liveInterval);
  }, [loadData]);

  const handleDelete = (id: number, code: string) => {
    if (!canManageSchedule) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Access Denied',
        message: 'Only school administrators can delete class schedules.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete Class Schedule',
      message: `Are you sure you want to delete class period "${code}"? The assigned subject faculty will be unassigned.`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete Schedule',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`${API_ROUTES.school.periods}${id}/`);
          setSchedules((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
          showAlert({
            title: 'Schedule Removed',
            message: `Schedule ${code} was deleted successfully.`,
            type: 'info',
          });
          void loadData(true, true);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Delete Error',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Failed to delete schedule period.'),
            type: 'error',
          });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const handleOpenModal = (tab: AcademicTabType, item: any = null) => {
    setModalTab(tab);
    setEditItem(item);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCloseModal = () => {
    setIsModalOpen(false);
    setEditItem(null);
  };

  const formatTime = (timeStr?: string) => {
    if (!timeStr) return '--:--';
    const parts = timeStr.split(':');
    if (parts.length < 2) return timeStr;
    let hours = parseInt(parts[0], 10);
    const minutes = parts[1];
    const ampm = hours >= 12 ? 'PM' : 'AM';
    hours = hours % 12 || 12;
    const strHours = hours < 10 ? `0${hours}` : `${hours}`;
    return `${strHours}:${minutes} ${ampm}`;
  };

  const getScheduleCode = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    return item.schedule_code || item.code || `SCH-${String(item.id).padStart(4, '0')}`;
  };

  const getFacultyInfo = useCallback(
    (item: ScheduleItem) => {
      let name = 'Unassigned';
      let photo: string | null = null;
      let employeeId = '';

      if (item.faculty_name && item.faculty_name.trim() !== '' && item.faculty_name.trim().toLowerCase() !== 'unassigned') {
        name = item.faculty_name.trim();
      } else if (item.faculty_title && item.faculty_title.trim() !== '') {
        name = item.faculty_title.trim();
      } else if (typeof item.faculty === 'object' && item.faculty) {
        name = item.faculty.full_name || item.faculty.name || name;
        photo = item.faculty.photo_url || item.faculty.photo || null;
        employeeId = item.faculty.employee_id || '';
      }

      let targetFacultyId: number | undefined;
      if (typeof item.faculty_id === 'number') {
        targetFacultyId = item.faculty_id;
      } else if (typeof item.faculty === 'number') {
        targetFacultyId = item.faculty;
      } else if (typeof item.faculty === 'string' && !isNaN(Number(item.faculty))) {
        targetFacultyId = Number(item.faculty);
      } else if (typeof item.faculty === 'object' && item.faculty && typeof item.faculty.id === 'number') {
        targetFacultyId = item.faculty.id;
      }

      if (targetFacultyId !== undefined) {
        const matched = facultyList.find((f) => f.id === targetFacultyId);
        if (matched) {
          name = matched.full_name || matched.name || name;
          photo = matched.photo_url || matched.photo || photo;
          employeeId = matched.employee_id || employeeId;
        }
      }

      return { name, photo: isSafeImageUrl(photo) ? photo : null, employeeId };
    },
    [facultyList]
  );

  const getSubjectCode = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.subject_code) return item.subject_code;
    if (typeof item.subject === 'object' && item.subject) {
      return item.subject.code || item.subject.title || item.subject.name || '—';
    }
    if (typeof item.subject === 'string') return item.subject;
    return item.subject ? `SUB-${item.subject}` : '—';
  };

  const getSubjectName = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.subject_title) return item.subject_title;
    if (item.subject_name) return item.subject_name;
    if (typeof item.subject === 'object' && item.subject) {
      return item.subject.title || item.subject.name || '';
    }
    return '';
  };

  const getSectionName = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.section_name) return item.section_name;
    if (typeof item.section === 'object' && item.section) {
      return item.section.name || item.section.section_name || `Section #${item.section.id}`;
    }
    return item.section ? `Section #${item.section}` : 'Unassigned';
  };

  const getRoomDisplay = (item: ScheduleItem) => {
    if (item.room_number) return item.room_number;
    if (item.room_name) return item.room_name;
    if (typeof item.room === 'object' && item.room) {
      return item.room.room_number || item.room.name || '—';
    }
    if (typeof item.room === 'string') return item.room;
    if (item.room) return `Rm ${item.room}`;
    return '—';
  };

  const cleanSearchQuery = useMemo(() => sanitizeInput(searchQuery, 60).toLowerCase(), [searchQuery]);

  const filteredSchedules = useMemo(() => {
    return schedules.filter((s) => {
      if (selectedSectionFilter !== 'ALL') {
        const secId = typeof s.section === 'object' && s.section ? s.section.id : s.section;
        const matchesId = String(secId) === selectedSectionFilter;
        const matchesName = String(s.section_name) === selectedSectionFilter;
        if (!matchesId && !matchesName) return false;
      }

      if (cleanSearchQuery !== '') {
        const code = getScheduleCode(s).toLowerCase();
        const sec = getSectionName(s).toLowerCase();
        const sub = `${getSubjectCode(s)} ${getSubjectName(s)}`.toLowerCase();
        const fac = getFacultyInfo(s).name.toLowerCase();
        const rm = getRoomDisplay(s).toLowerCase();

        return (
          code.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          sec.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          sub.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          fac.includes(cleanSearchQuery) ||
          rm.includes(cleanSearchQuery)
        );
      }

      return true;
    });
  }, [schedules, selectedSectionFilter, cleanSearchQuery, getFacultyInfo]);

  const currentSelectedSectionObj = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedSectionFilter === 'ALL') return null;
    return sections.find((sec) => String(sec.id) === selectedSectionFilter) || null;
  }, [selectedSectionFilter, sections]);

  const getAdviserDetails = useCallback(
    (sec: SectionOption | null) => {
      if (!sec) return null;

      let name = '';
      let photo: string | null = null;
      let employeeId = '';

      if (sec.adviser_name) name = sec.adviser_name;
      if (sec.adviser_full_name) name = sec.adviser_full_name;
      if (sec.adviser_photo_url) photo = sec.adviser_photo_url;
      if (sec.adviser_employee_id) employeeId = sec.adviser_employee_id;

      if (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser) {
        if (!name) name = sec.adviser.full_name || sec.adviser.name || '';
        if (!photo) photo = sec.adviser.photo_url || sec.adviser.photo || null;
        if (!employeeId) employeeId = sec.adviser.employee_id || '';
      } else if (typeof sec.adviser === 'string' && !name) {
        name = sec.adviser;
      }

      let adviserId: number | undefined;
      if (typeof sec.adviser_id === 'number') {
        adviserId = sec.adviser_id;
      } else if (typeof sec.adviser === 'number') {
        adviserId = sec.adviser;
      } else if (typeof sec.adviser === 'object' && sec.adviser && typeof sec.adviser.id === 'number') {
        adviserId = sec.adviser.id;
      }

      if (adviserId !== undefined) {
        const match = facultyList.find((f) => f.id === adviserId);
        if (match) {
          if (!name) name = match.full_name || match.name || '';
          if (!photo) photo = match.photo_url || match.photo || null;
          if (!employeeId) employeeId = match.employee_id || '';
        }
      }

      return {
        name: name || null,
        photo: isSafeImageUrl(photo) ? photo : null,
        employeeId: employeeId || '',
      };
    },
    [facultyList]
  );

  const resolvedAdviser = useMemo(() => getAdviserDetails(currentSelectedSectionObj), [currentSelectedSectionObj, getAdviserDetails]);
  const resolvedMyAdviser = useMemo(() => getAdviserDetails(myAdvisorySection), [myAdvisorySection, getAdviserDetails]);

  const uniqueSectionsCount = useMemo(
    () => new Set(schedules.map((s) => getSectionName(s)).filter((n) => n !== 'Unassigned')).size,
    [schedules]
  );

  const uniqueFacultyCount = useMemo(
    () => new Set(schedules.map((s) => getFacultyInfo(s).name).filter((n) => n !== 'Unassigned')).size,
    [schedules, getFacultyInfo]
  );

  const uniqueRoomsCount = useMemo(
    () => new Set(schedules.map((s) => getRoomDisplay(s)).filter((r) => r !== '—')).size,
    [schedules]
  );

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 14, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2.5vw, 20px)' }}>
      {/* 1. Summary Cards */}
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 210px), 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
        <StatsCard
          label="SCHEDULE PERIODS"
          value={schedules.length}
          helpText="Active timetable slots"
          badge={<Calendar size={18} color={brand.primary} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="SCHEDULED SECTIONS"
          value={uniqueSectionsCount}
          valueColor={brand.success}
          helpText="Sections with class schedules"
          badge={<Users size={18} color={brand.success} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="SUBJECT FACULTY"
          value={uniqueFacultyCount}
          valueColor={brand.primary}
          helpText="Faculty with class loads"
          badge={<GraduationCap size={18} color={brand.primary} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="OCCUPIED ROOMS"
          value={uniqueRoomsCount}
          valueColor={brand.warning}
          helpText="Rooms currently scheduled"
          badge={<DoorOpen size={18} color={brand.warning} />}
        />
      </div>

      {/* 2. Top Filter and Setup Navigation Bar */}
      <div
        style={{
          ...ui.card,
          padding: '10px 14px',
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 10,
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, color: brand.primary, fontWeight: 800, fontSize: '0.80rem' }}>
            <Filter size={15} /> Class Section:
          </div>
          <select
            aria-label="Filter by class section"
            value={selectedSectionFilter}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedSectionFilter(e.target.value)}
            style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', minWidth: 210, fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer' }}
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Sections ({schedules.length} periods)</option>
            {sections.map((sec) => {
              const displayName = getSectionDisplayName(sec);
              const isMine = isSectionAdvisoryForUser(sec);
              return (
                <option key={sec.id} value={sec.id}>
                  {displayName} {isMine ? '★ (Your Advisory Class)' : sec.code ? `(${sec.code})` : ''}
                </option>
              );
            })}
          </select>

          {myAdvisorySection && selectedSectionFilter !== String(myAdvisorySection.id) && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setSelectedSectionFilter(String(myAdvisorySection.id))}
              style={{
                ...ui.btnSecondary,
                backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
                borderColor: brand.primary,
                color: brand.primary,
              }}
              title="Jump directly to your advisory class section"
            >
              <Sparkles size={13} color={brand.primary} />
              <span>View My Advisory Class</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {canManageSchedule && (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleOpenModal('SECTION')}
              style={ui.btnSecondary}
              title="Add a Section and Assign an Adviser"
            >
              <Users size={13} color={brand.primary} /> + Section &amp; Adviser
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleOpenModal('ROOM')}
              style={ui.btnSecondary}
              title="Add a Classroom or Laboratory"
            >
              <DoorOpen size={13} color={brand.primary} /> + Room
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleOpenModal('SUBJECT')}
              style={ui.btnSecondary}
              title="Add an Academic Subject"
            >
              <BookOpen size={13} color={brand.primary} /> + Subject
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => handleOpenModal('SCHEDULE')}
              style={ui.btnPrimary}
              title="Assign a Subject Faculty to this Section"
            >
              <Plus size={15} /> Add Subject Faculty Slot
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 3A. Dedicated Advisory Class Banner */}
      {selectedSectionFilter === 'ALL' && myAdvisorySection && (
        <div
          style={{
            ...ui.subtleBox,
            backgroundColor: tokens.primaryLight,
            borderColor: brand.primary,
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            flexWrap: 'wrap',
            gap: 12,
            padding: '12px 18px',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
            {resolvedMyAdviser?.photo && isSafeImageUrl(resolvedMyAdviser.photo) ? (
              <ProfileAvatar
                photoUrl={resolvedMyAdviser.photo}
                name={resolvedMyAdviser.name || 'Adviser'}
                size={44}
                iconSize={20}
              />
            ) : (
              <div
                style={{
                  width: 44,
                  height: 44,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurface,
                  border: `1.5px solid ${brand.primary}`,
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  flexShrink: 0,
                }}
              >
                <UserCheck size={20} color={brand.primary} />
              </div>
            )}

            <div>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.96rem', fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                  Your Advisory Class: {getSectionDisplayName(myAdvisorySection)}
                </span>
                <span style={ui.badge(tokens.successLight, brand.success)}>Official Class Adviser</span>
              </div>

              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginTop: 3, fontSize: '0.76rem', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>

        initialTab={modalTab}
        editItem={editItem}
        onClose={handleCloseModal}
        onSuccess={() => {
          void loadData(true, true);
          handleCloseModal();
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

const MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 200): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const compressImageToDataUrl = (file: File, maxDim = 360, quality = 0.78): Promise<string> => {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    reader.onload = (e) => {
      if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
        resolve('');
        return;
      }
      const rawDataUrl = typeof e.target?.result === 'string' ? e.target.result : '';
      if (!isSafeImageUrl(rawDataUrl)) {
        resolve('');
        return;
      }
      const img = new window.Image();
      img.src = rawDataUrl;
      img.onload = () => {
        let { width, height } = img;
        if (width > height) {
          if (width > maxDim) {
            height = Math.round((height * maxDim) / width);
            width = maxDim;
          }
        } else {
          if (height > maxDim) {
            width = Math.round((width * maxDim) / height);
            height = maxDim;
          }
        }
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width = width;
        canvas.height = height;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        if (!ctx) {
          resolve(rawDataUrl);
          return;
        }
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
        const compressed = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', quality);
        resolve(isSafeImageUrl(compressed) ? compressed : '');
      };
      img.onerror = () => resolve('');
    };
    reader.onerror = () => resolve('');
  });
};

        }

        if (facultyRes.status === 'fulfilled' && facultyRes.value.data) {
          const fList = Array.isArray(facultyRes.value.data)
            ? facultyRes.value.data
            : facultyRes.value.data?.results || [];
          setFacultyList(fList);
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    void loadInitialData();
    void fetchDiagnostics();

    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, [applySchoolPayload, fetchDiagnostics]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeSubTab === 'LOGS' || activeSubTab === 'ALL') {
      void fetchUserActivities();
    }
  }, [activeSubTab, fetchUserActivities]);

  const handleFacultyChange = (facultyIdStr: string) => {
    if (!facultyIdStr) {
      setFormData((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        principal_faculty: '',
        principal_name: '',
        principal_title: '',
        principal_photo_url: null,
        principal_employee_id: '',
        principal_department: '',
        principal_contact_number: '',
        principal_email: '',
      }));
      return;
    }

    const fid = Number(facultyIdStr);
    const chosen = facultyList.find((f) => f.id === fid);

    if (chosen) {
      setFormData((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        principal_faculty: fid,
        principal_name: chosen.full_name || `${chosen.first_name} ${chosen.last_name}`.trim(),
        principal_title: chosen.position || 'School Principal',
        principal_photo_url: isSafeImageUrl(chosen.photo_url) ? chosen.photo_url ?? null : null,
        principal_employee_id: chosen.employee_id || '',
        principal_department: chosen.department || 'Administration',
        principal_contact_number: chosen.contact_number || '',
        principal_email: chosen.email || '',
      }));
    }
  };

  const selectedFacultyObj = facultyList.find(
    (f) => String(f.id) === String(formData.principal_faculty)
  );

  const rawPrincipalPhoto = selectedFacultyObj?.photo_url || formData.principal_photo_url || null;
  const activePrincipalPhoto = isSafeImageUrl(rawPrincipalPhoto) ? rawPrincipalPhoto : null;
  const activePrincipalEmpId = selectedFacultyObj?.employee_id || formData.principal_employee_id || '';
  const activePrincipalDept = selectedFacultyObj?.department || formData.principal_department || 'Administration';
  const activePrincipalContact = selectedFacultyObj?.contact_number || formData.principal_contact_number || '';
  const activePrincipalEmail = selectedFacultyObj?.email || formData.principal_email || '';

  const handleLogoUpload = async (
    field: 'school_logo' | 'left_logo' | 'right_logo',
    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (!['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Invalid Image Format',
        message: 'Only PNG, JPG, and WebP images are allowed.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_BYTES) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Image File Too Large',
        message: 'Please choose an image under 5 MB.',
        type: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    const compressed = await compressImageToDataUrl(file, 360, 0.78);
    if (compressed && isSafeImageUrl(compressed)) {
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: compressed }));
      setFreshLogos((prev) => ({ ...prev, [field]: true }));
    }
  };

  const runMaintenanceAction = (
    actionKey: string,
    title: string,
    description: string,
    apiCall: () => Promise<any>
  ) => {
    showConfirm({
      title,
      message: `${description} Do you want to proceed?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Run Fix Now',
      isDestructive: false,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        setActionLoading(actionKey);
        try {
          const res = await apiCall();
          showAlert({
            title: 'Task Finished Successfully',
            message: res?.data?.message || `${title} completed with zero errors.`,
            type: 'success',
          });
          void fetchDiagnostics();
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          showAlert({
            title: 'Action Notice',
            message: extractApiError(err, 'Action could not be completed. Please try again.'),
            type: 'warning',
          });
        } finally {
          setActionLoading(null);
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const exportActivityCSV = () => {

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);
    setSaveSuccess(false);

    const hasLat = String(formData.latitude).trim() !== '';
    const hasLng = String(formData.longitude).trim() !== '';
    const lat = hasLat ? Number(formData.latitude) : null;
    const lng = hasLng ? Number(formData.longitude) : null;
    const radius = Number(formData.geofence_radius_meters);

    if (lat !== null && (isNaN(lat) || lat < -90 || lat > 90)) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Latitude', message: 'Latitude must be between -90 and 90 degrees.', type: 'error' });
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    if (lng !== null && (isNaN(lng) || lng < -180 || lng > 180)) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Longitude', message: 'Longitude must be between -180 and 180 degrees.', type: 'error' });
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    if (isNaN(radius) || radius < 20 || radius > 5000) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Invalid Boundary Radius', message: 'Radius must be between 20 and 5000 meters.', type: 'error' });
      setSaving(false);
      return;
    }

    const validFacultyId =
      formData.principal_faculty && !isNaN(Number(formData.principal_faculty))
        ? Number(formData.principal_faculty)
        : null;

    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
      school_id: sanitizeInput(formData.school_id, 40),
      school_name: sanitizeInput(formData.school_name, 160),
      region: sanitizeInput(formData.region, 80),
      division: sanitizeInput(formData.division, 120),
      district: sanitizeInput(formData.district, 120),
      academic_year: sanitizeInput(formData.academic_year, 20),
      address: sanitizeInput(formData.address, 250),
      contact_number: sanitizeInput(formData.contact_number, 40),
      email: sanitizeInput(formData.email, 150),
      website: sanitizeInput(formData.website, 200),
      principal_faculty: validFacultyId,
      principal_name: sanitizeInput(formData.principal_name, 150),
      principal_title: sanitizeInput(formData.principal_title, 120),
      superintendent_name: sanitizeInput(formData.superintendent_name, 150),
      latitude: lat,
      longitude: lng,
      geofence_radius_meters: radius,
    };

    if (freshLogos.school_logo) payload.school_logo = formData.school_logo;
    if (freshLogos.left_logo) payload.left_logo = formData.left_logo;
    if (freshLogos.right_logo) payload.right_logo = formData.right_logo;

    try {
      const res = await apiClient.put(API_ROUTES.school.settings, payload, { timeout: 15000 });
      updateSchoolInstantly(res.data || payload);
      if (isSafeImageUrl(res.data?.principal_photo_url)) {
        setFormData((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          principal_photo_url: res.data.principal_photo_url,
        }));
      }
      setFreshLogos({ school_logo: false, left_logo: false, right_logo: false });
      setSaveSuccess(true);
      showAlert({
        title: 'Settings Saved',
        message: 'School profile and campus boundary saved to the database.',
        type: 'success',
        autoCloseDuration: 2500,
      });
      if (saveSuccessTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(saveSuccessTimerRef.current);
      saveSuccessTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setSaveSuccess(false);
        saveSuccessTimerRef.current = null;
      }, 3000);
      await refreshSchool();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Save Failed',
        message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not save school settings. Please check your permissions and inputs.'),
        type: 'error',
      });
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  code?: string;
  grade_level_name?: string;
  adviser_name?: string;
}

interface SF1LearnerRow {
  id: number;
  lrn: string;
  name: string;
  sex: string;
  birthdate: string;
  age: number | string;
  birth_place?: string;
  mother_tongue: string;
  ethnic_group: string;
  religion: string;
  address?: string;
  house_street?: string;
  house_street_sitio?: string;
  barangay?: string;
  municipality_city?: string;
  province?: string;
  father_name: string;
  mother_maiden_name: string;
  guardian_name: string;
  guardian_rel?: string;
  guardian_relationship?: string;
  parent_contact: string;
  remarks: string;
}

interface SF1ReportResponse {
  school_id: string;
  school_name: string;
  region: string;
  division: string;
  district: string;
  academic_year: string;
  grade_level: string;
  section_name: string;
  adviser_name: string;
  school_head: string;
  school_address?: string;
  school_contact?: string;
  school_email?: string;
  left_logo?: string | null;
  right_logo?: string | null;
  school_logo?: string | null;
  students: SF1LearnerRow[];
  males: SF1LearnerRow[];
  females: SF1LearnerRow[];
  total_male: number;
  total_female: number;
  total_combined: number;
}

export interface SF1ReportTabProps {
  sectionId?: number | string;
  activeReportId?: string;
  onSelectReport?: (reportId: string) => void;
}

const sanitizeSearchText = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 80);

const parseGuardianFields = (name?: string, rel?: string) => {
  const roles = ['MOTHER', 'FATHER', 'AUNT', 'UNCLE', 'GRANDMOTHER', 'GRANDFATHER', 'GUARDIAN'];
  const cleanName = String(name || '').trim();
  const cleanRel = String(rel || '').trim();

  if (roles.includes(cleanName.toUpperCase()) && !roles.includes(cleanRel.toUpperCase())) {
    return { gName: cleanRel, gRel: cleanName };
  }
  return {
    gName: cleanName,
    gRel: cleanRel.toLowerCase() === 'mather' ? 'Mother' : cleanRel,
  };
};

const splitAddressParts = (st: SF1LearnerRow) => {
  const street = st.house_street_sitio || st.house_street || '';
  const brgy = st.barangay || '';
  const city = st.municipality_city || '';
  const prov = st.province || '';

  if (street || brgy || city || prov) {
    return { street, brgy, city, prov };
  }

  const parts = String(st.address || '')
    .split(',')
    .map((p) => p.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);

  return {
    street: parts[0] || '',
    brgy: parts[1] || '',
    city: parts[2] || '',
    prov: parts[3] || '',
  };
};

export const SF1ReportTab: React.FC<SF1ReportTabProps> = ({
  sectionId,
  activeReportId = 'sf1',
  onSelectReport,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const { school: globalSchool } = useSchool();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const cachedSectionsPayload = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.school.sections, { page_size: 250 });
  const initialSections: SectionOption[] = Array.isArray(cachedSectionsPayload)
    ? cachedSectionsPayload
    : cachedSectionsPayload?.results || [];

  const [sections, setSections] = useState<SectionOption[]>(initialSections);
  const [selectedSectionId, setSelectedSectionId] = useState<string>(
    sectionId ? String(sectionId) : initialSections[0] ? String(initialSections[0].id) : ''
  );

  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [groupingMode, setGroupingMode] = useState<'COMBINED' | 'SEPARATED'>('COMBINED');

  const [reportData, setReportData] = useState<SF1ReportResponse | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isExportingPdf, setIsExportingPdf] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isPrinting, setIsPrinting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [auditMeta, setAuditMeta] = useState(() => buildAuditStamp('SF1'));
  const [pageConfig, setPageConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>(DEFAULT_DEPED_LANDSCAPE_SETUP);
  const [isPageSetupOpen, setIsPageSetupOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const reportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const { widthIn: pageWidthInches, heightIn: pageHeightInches } = useMemo(
    () => resolvePaperDimensionsInches(pageConfig),
    [pageConfig]
  );

  const refreshAuditMeta = useCallback(() => {
    const next = buildAuditStamp('SF1', reportData?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
    setAuditMeta(next);
    return next;
  }, [reportData?.school_id, globalSchool.school_id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sectionId) {
      setSelectedSectionId(String(sectionId));
    }
  }, [sectionId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.school.sections, {
        params: { page_size: 250 },
        signal: controller.signal,
      })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const list: SectionOption[] = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data?.results || [];
        setSections(list);
        if (list.length > 0) {
          setSelectedSectionId((prev) => prev || String(list[0].id));
        } else {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load class sections.'));
        setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const fetchSF1 = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      if (!selectedSectionId) return;

      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const endpoint = `${API_ROUTES.reports.sf1}${encodeURIComponent(selectedSectionId)}/`;
      const warmHit = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<SF1ReportResponse>(endpoint) : undefined;

      if (warmHit) {
        setReportData(warmHit);
        setLoading(false);
        if (silent) setRefreshing(true);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<SF1ReportResponse>(endpoint, {
          params: bypassCache ? { nocache: 1 } : undefined,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const payload = res.data;
        setReportData(payload);
        const stamp = buildAuditStamp('SF1', payload?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
        setAuditMeta(stamp);
        void logOfficialReportAudit({
          reportName: 'SF1',
          trackingId: stamp.trackingId,
          printedAt: stamp.printedAt,
          action: 'VIEW',
          sectionId: selectedSectionId,
        });
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load DepEd SF1 School Register.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [selectedSectionId, globalSchool.school_id]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchSF1(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchSF1]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforePrint = () => {
      refreshAuditMeta();
      setIsPrinting(true);
    };
    const handleAfterPrint = () => {
      setIsPrinting(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
    window.addEventListener('afterprint', handleAfterPrint);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
      window.removeEventListener('afterprint', handleAfterPrint);
    };
  }, [refreshAuditMeta]);

  const cleanSearch = useMemo(() => sanitizeSearchText(searchQuery).toLowerCase(), [searchQuery]);

  const { maleLearners, femaleLearners, combinedLearners } = useMemo(() => {
    if (!reportData) {
      return { maleLearners: [], femaleLearners: [], combinedLearners: [] };
    }
    const rawAll = Array.isArray(reportData.students) ? reportData.students : [];
    const rawMales = Array.isArray(reportData.males)
      ? reportData.males
      : rawAll.filter((s) => String(s.sex || '').toUpperCase().startsWith('M'));
    const rawFemales = Array.isArray(reportData.females)
      ? reportData.females
      : rawAll.filter((s) => !String(s.sex || '').toUpperCase().startsWith('M'));

    const match = (s: SF1LearnerRow) =>
      !cleanSearch ||
      String(s.name || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) ||
      String(s.lrn || '').toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch);

    const sortedAll = [...rawAll].filter(match).sort((a, b) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || ''));
    const sortedM = [...rawMales].filter(match).sort((a, b) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || ''));
    const sortedF = [...rawFemales].filter(match).sort((a, b) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || ''));

    return {
      maleLearners: sortedM,
      femaleLearners: sortedF,
      combinedLearners: sortedAll,
    };
  }, [reportData, cleanSearch]);

  const activeLearnerList = useMemo(
    () => (groupingMode === 'COMBINED' ? combinedLearners : [...maleLearners, ...femaleLearners]),
    [groupingMode, combinedLearners, maleLearners, femaleLearners]
  );

  const maleCount = reportData?.total_male ?? maleLearners.length;
  const femaleCount = reportData?.total_female ?? femaleLearners.length;
  const totalCount = reportData?.total_combined ?? maleCount + femaleCount;

  const paginatedLearners = useMemo(() => {
    if (!reportData) return [];
    if (pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless' || activeLearnerList.length === 0) {
      return [activeLearnerList];
    }
    const baseFirstRows = pageConfig.orientation === 'portrait' ? 26 : 18;
    const baseNextRows = pageConfig.orientation === 'portrait' ? 36 : 26;
    const heightScale = pageHeightInches / 8.5;
    const rowsFirst = Math.max(10, Math.floor(baseFirstRows * heightScale));
    const rowsNext = Math.max(14, Math.floor(baseNextRows * heightScale));

    if (activeLearnerList.length <= rowsFirst) {
      return [activeLearnerList];
    }

    const pages: SF1LearnerRow[][] = [];
    pages.push(activeLearnerList.slice(0, rowsFirst));
    let idx = rowsFirst;
    while (idx < activeLearnerList.length) {
      pages.push(activeLearnerList.slice(idx, idx + rowsNext));
      idx += rowsNext;
    }
    return pages;
  }, [reportData, activeLearnerList, pageConfig.layoutMode, pageConfig.orientation, pageHeightInches]);

  const getBaseFilename = () => {
    const sectionClean = (reportData?.section_name || 'Section').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
    const syClean = (reportData?.academic_year || 'SY').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');
    return `DepEd_SF1_${sectionClean}_${syClean}`;
  };

  const handleDirectPrint = () => {
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF1',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'PRINT',
      sectionId: selectedSectionId,
    });
    setIsPrinting(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      window.print();
      setTimeout(() => setIsPrinting(false), 400);
    }, 180);
  };

  const handleExportPdf = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData || !reportRef.current) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF1',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'PDF',
      sectionId: selectedSectionId,
    });

    setIsExportingPdf(true);
    setIsPrinting(true);
    try {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
      await exportElementToLocalPdf({
        element: reportRef.current,
        filename: `${getBaseFilename()}.pdf`,
        pageWidthInches,
        pageHeightInches,
        orientation: pageConfig.orientation,
        pageColor: pageConfig.pageColor,
        pageless: pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless',
        usePicker,
      });
    } catch {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Opening Print Dialog',
        message: 'Choose "Save as PDF" in your browser print dialog.',
        type: 'info',
      });
      handleDirectPrint();
    } finally {
      setIsPrinting(false);
      setIsExportingPdf(false);
    }
  };

  const buildCsvRows = () => {
    if (!reportData) return { headers: [] as string[], rows: [] as Array<Array<string | number>> };
    const headers = [
      'No',
      'LRN',
      'Learner Name (Last, First, Middle)',
      'Sex',
      'Birth Date',
      'Age',
      'Mother Tongue',
      'IP (Ethnic Group)',
      'Religion',
      'House # / Street / Sitio / Purok',
      'Barangay',
      'Municipality / City',
      'Province',
      'Father Name',
      'Mother Maiden Name',
      'Guardian Name',
      'Relationship',
      'Contact Number',
      'Remarks',
    ];
    const rows = activeLearnerList.map((st, idx) => {
      const addr = splitAddressParts(st);
      const { gName, gRel } = parseGuardianFields(st.guardian_name, st.guardian_relationship || st.guardian_rel);
      return [
        idx + 1,
        st.lrn || '',
        st.name || '',
        st.sex || '',
        st.birthdate || '',
        st.age ?? '',
        st.mother_tongue || '',
        st.ethnic_group || '',
        st.religion || '',
        addr.street,
        addr.brgy,
        addr.city,
        addr.prov,
        st.father_name || '',
        st.mother_maiden_name || '',
        gName,
        gRel,
        st.parent_contact || '',
        st.remarks || '',
      ];
    });
    return { headers, rows };
  };

  const handleExportCsv = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF1',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'CSV',
      sectionId: selectedSectionId,
    });
    const { headers, rows } = buildCsvRows();
    const filename = `${getBaseFilename()}.csv`;

    if (usePicker) {
      const escapeCell = (val: unknown) => `"${String(val ?? '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
      const csvString =
        '\uFEFF' + [headers.map(escapeCell).join(','), ...rows.map((r) => r.map(escapeCell).join(','))].join('\r\n');
      const blob = new Blob([csvString], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
      await saveBlobWithOptionalPicker(blob, filename, 'text/csv', 'csv', 'CSV Spreadsheet (*.csv)');
    } else {
      exportToCsv(filename, headers, rows);
    }
  };

  const handleExportExcel = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData || !reportRef.current) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF1',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'EXCEL',
      sectionId: selectedSectionId,
    });
    await exportElementToExcel(reportRef.current, getBaseFilename(), meta, usePicker);
  };

  const handleExportWord = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData || !reportRef.current) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF1',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'WORD',
      sectionId: selectedSectionId,
    });
    await exportElementToWord(reportRef.current, getBaseFilename(), meta, usePicker);
  };

  const handleExportJson = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF1',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'JSON',
      sectionId: selectedSectionId,
    });
    await exportReportJson(getBaseFilename(), meta, reportData, usePicker);
  };

  const renderLearnerRow = (st: SF1LearnerRow, rowNum: number) => {
    const addr = splitAddressParts(st);
    const { gName, gRel } = parseGuardianFields(st.guardian_name, st.guardian_relationship || st.guardian_rel);
    return (
      <tr key={`${st.id || st.lrn}-${rowNum}`}>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{rowNum}</td>
        <td style={{ ...tdCenter, fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700 }}>{st.lrn}</td>
        <td style={{ ...tdLeft, fontWeight: 700 }}>{st.name}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{st.sex}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{st.birthdate}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{st.age}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{st.mother_tongue}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{st.ethnic_group}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{st.religion}</td>
        <td style={tdLeft}>{addr.street}</td>
        <td style={tdLeft}>{addr.brgy}</td>
        <td style={tdLeft}>{addr.city}</td>
        <td style={tdLeft}>{addr.prov}</td>
        <td style={tdLeft}>{st.father_name}</td>
        <td style={tdLeft}>{st.mother_maiden_name}</td>
        <td style={tdLeft}>{gName}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{gRel}</td>
        <td style={{ ...tdCenter, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>{st.parent_contact}</td>
        <td style={tdCenter}>{st.remarks}</td>
      </tr>
    );
  };

  const schoolName = reportData?.school_name || globalSchool.school_name || '';
  const schoolId = reportData?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id || '';
  const schoolHead = reportData?.school_head || globalSchool.principal_name || '';

  return (
    <div
      className="report-tab-root"
      style={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        width: '100%',
        height: '100%',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgApp,
      }}
    >
      <div className="no-print">
        <ReportHeaderBar
          activeReportId={activeReportId}
          onSelectReport={onSelectReport}
          documentTitle={
            reportData
              ? `SF1_Register_${reportData.section_name}_${reportData.academic_year}`
              : 'DepEd_SF1_School_Register'
          }
          subtitle="Official DepEd School Form 1 (SF1) School Register"
          isSavingPdf={isExportingPdf}
          onOpenPageSetup={() => setIsPageSetupOpen(true)}
          onPrint={handleDirectPrint}
          onSavePdf={() => void handleExportPdf(false)}
          onSavePdfAs={() => void handleExportPdf(true)}
          onDownloadExcel={() => void handleExportExcel(false)}
          onSaveExcelAs={() => void handleExportExcel(true)}
          onDownloadCsv={() => void handleExportCsv(false)}
          onSaveCsvAs={() => void handleExportCsv(true)}
          onDownloadWord={() => void handleExportWord(false)}
          onSaveWordAs={() => void handleExportWord(true)}
          onDownloadJson={() => void handleExportJson(false)}
          onSaveJsonAs={() => void handleExportJson(true)}
        />
      </div>

      <ReportViewerShell
        loading={loading}
        loadingMessage="Generating Official DepEd SF1 School Register..."
        error={error}
        hasData={Boolean(reportData)}
        isPrinting={isPrinting}
        isExportingPdf={isExportingPdf}
        pageWidthInches={pageWidthInches}
        pageHeightInches={pageHeightInches}
        pageConfig={pageConfig}
        sheetClassName="sf1-sheet-page"
        documentId="sf1-official-document"
        reportRef={reportRef}
        leftToolbarContent={
          <>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <BookOpen size={15} color={brand.primary} />
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>Section:</span>
              <select
                aria-label="Select Class Section"
                value={selectedSectionId}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedSectionId(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  padding: '5px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgInput,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                }}
              >
                {sections.map((s) => (
                  <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                    {s.grade_level_name ? `${s.grade_level_name} - ` : ''}
                    {s.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 6,
                  padding: '4px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgInput,
                }}
              >
                <Search size={13} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                <input
                  type="text"
                  maxLength={80}
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search name or LRN..."
                  style={{
                    border: 'none',
                    outline: 'none',
                    background: 'transparent',
                    color: tokens.textPrimary,
                    fontSize: '0.78rem',
                    width: 155,
                  }}
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                padding: 2,
                borderRadius: 6,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
              }}
            >
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setGroupingMode('COMBINED')}
                style={{
                  display: 'inline-flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: 5,
                  padding: '4px 9px',
                  borderRadius: 5,
                  border: 'none',
                  fontSize: '0.72rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  backgroundColor: groupingMode === 'COMBINED' ? brand.buttonBg : 'transparent',
                  color: groupingMode === 'COMBINED' ? '#ffffff' : tokens.textSecondary,
                }}
              >

}) => {
  if (!isSchoolDay) {
    return <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '16px', backgroundColor: '#ffffff' }} />;
  }

  const s = String(status ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
  let src = SVG_DIAGONAL_ONLY;
  let alt = 'Present';

  if (s === 'absent' || s === 'x' || s === '1' || s === 'a') {
    src = SVG_ABSENT;
    alt = 'Absent (X)';
  } else if (s === 'tardy' || s === 'late' || s === '2' || s === 't') {
    src = SVG_TARDY;
    alt = 'Late';
  } else if (s === 'cutting' || s === 'cc' || s === '3' || s === 'c') {
    src = SVG_CUTTING;
    alt = 'Cutting Classes';
  }

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        width: '100%',
        height: '16px',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
      }}
    >
      <img
        src={src}
        alt={alt}
        style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'block', objectFit: 'fill' }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

const sanitizeSearchText = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 80);

export const SF2ReportTab: React.FC<SF2ReportTabProps> = ({
  sectionId,
  activeReportId = 'sf2',
  onSelectReport,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const { school: globalSchool } = useSchool();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const now = useMemo(() => new Date(), []);
  const yearOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const y = now.getFullYear();
    return [y - 1, y, y + 1];
  }, [now]);

  const cachedSectionsPayload = peekApiCache<any>(API_ROUTES.school.sections, { page_size: 250 });
  const initialSections: SectionOption[] = Array.isArray(cachedSectionsPayload)
    ? cachedSectionsPayload
    : cachedSectionsPayload?.results || [];

  const [sections, setSections] = useState<SectionOption[]>(initialSections);
  const [selectedSectionId, setSelectedSectionId] = useState<string>(
    sectionId ? String(sectionId) : initialSections[0] ? String(initialSections[0].id) : ''
  );
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState<string>(
    () => MONTH_NAMES[now.getMonth()] || 'October'
  );
  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState<number>(now.getFullYear());
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');

  const [reportData, setReportData] = useState<SF2ReportData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isExportingPdf, setIsExportingPdf] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isPrinting, setIsPrinting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [auditMeta, setAuditMeta] = useState(() => buildAuditStamp('SF2'));
  const [pageConfig, setPageConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>(DEFAULT_DEPED_LANDSCAPE_SETUP);
  const [isPageSetupOpen, setIsPageSetupOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const reportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const { widthIn: pageWidthInches, heightIn: pageHeightInches } = useMemo(
    () => resolvePaperDimensionsInches(pageConfig),
    [pageConfig]
  );

  const refreshAuditMeta = useCallback(() => {
    const next = buildAuditStamp('SF2', reportData?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
    setAuditMeta(next);
    return next;
  }, [reportData?.school_id, globalSchool.school_id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sectionId) {
      setSelectedSectionId(String(sectionId));
    }
  }, [sectionId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.school.sections, {
        params: { page_size: 250 },
        signal: controller.signal,
      })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const list: SectionOption[] = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data?.results || [];
        setSections(list);
        if (list.length > 0) {
          setSelectedSectionId((prev) => prev || String(list[0].id));
        } else {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load class sections.'));
        setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      controller.abort();
    };
  }, []);

  const fetchSF2 = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      if (!selectedSectionId) return;

      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const endpoint = `${API_ROUTES.reports.sf2}${encodeURIComponent(selectedSectionId)}/`;
      const baseParams = { month: selectedMonth, year: selectedYear };
      const warmHit = !bypassCache ? peekApiCache<SF2ReportData>(endpoint, baseParams) : undefined;

      if (warmHit) {
        setReportData(warmHit);
        setLoading(false);
        if (silent) setRefreshing(true);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<SF2ReportData>(endpoint, {
          params: bypassCache ? { ...baseParams, nocache: 1 } : baseParams,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setReportData(res.data);
        const stamp = buildAuditStamp('SF2', res.data?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
        setAuditMeta(stamp);
        void logOfficialReportAudit({
          reportName: 'SF2',
          trackingId: stamp.trackingId,
          printedAt: stamp.printedAt,
          action: 'VIEW',
          sectionId: selectedSectionId,
        });
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not generate DepEd SF2 Daily Attendance Report.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [selectedSectionId, selectedMonth, selectedYear, globalSchool.school_id]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchSF2(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchSF2]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforePrint = () => {
      refreshAuditMeta();
      setIsPrinting(true);
    };
    const handleAfterPrint = () => {
      setIsPrinting(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
    window.addEventListener('afterprint', handleAfterPrint);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
      window.removeEventListener('afterprint', handleAfterPrint);
    };
  }, [refreshAuditMeta]);

  const cleanSearch = useMemo(() => sanitizeSearchText(searchQuery).toLowerCase(), [searchQuery]);

  const males = useMemo(() => {
    const list = Array.isArray(reportData?.males) ? reportData!.males : [];
    if (!cleanSearch) return list;
    return list.filter(
      (m) => m.name.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch) || m.lrn.toLowerCase().includes(cleanSearch)
    );
  }, [reportData, cleanSearch]);

  const females = useMemo(() => {
    const list = Array.isArray(reportData?.females) ? reportData!.females : [];
    if (!cleanSearch) return list;
    return list.filter(

    );
  }, [reportData, cleanSearch]);

  const dailyAttendanceTotals = useMemo(() => {
    const maxCols = 25;
    const malesCount: number[] = new Array(maxCols).fill(0);
    const femalesCount: number[] = new Array(maxCols).fill(0);
    const combinedCount: number[] = new Array(maxCols).fill(0);

    if (!reportData?.school_days) {
      return { males: malesCount, females: femalesCount, combined: combinedCount };
    }

    reportData.school_days.forEach((day, idx) => {
      if (idx >= maxCols) return;
      let mPresent = 0;
      let fPresent = 0;

      males.forEach((m) => {
        const st = String(m.attendance?.[day.dateNumber] ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (PRESENT_STATUSES.has(st)) mPresent++;
      });

      females.forEach((f) => {
        const st = String(f.attendance?.[day.dateNumber] ?? '').toLowerCase().trim();
        if (PRESENT_STATUSES.has(st)) fPresent++;
      });

      malesCount[idx] = mPresent;
      femalesCount[idx] = fPresent;
      combinedCount[idx] = mPresent + fPresent;
    });

    return { males: malesCount, females: femalesCount, combined: combinedCount };
  }, [reportData, males, females]);

  const fitsOnSinglePage = useMemo(() => {
    if (pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless') return true;
    const printableHeight =
      pageHeightInches - (pageConfig.margins.top || 0.25) - (pageConfig.margins.bottom || 0.25);
    const totalRows = males.length + females.length;
    return 5.4 + totalRows * 0.17 <= printableHeight;
  }, [pageConfig, males.length, females.length, pageHeightInches]);

  const getBaseFilename = () => {
    const secClean = (reportData?.section_name || 'Section').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');

          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 10 }}>

              I certify that this is a true and correct report:
