  DEFAULT_DEPED_LANDSCAPE_SETUP,
  resolvePaperDimensionsInches,
} from '../reports/ReportViewerShell';
import {
  buildAuditStamp,
  exportElementToExcel,
  exportElementToLocalPdf,
  exportElementToWord,
  exportReportJson,
  logOfficialReportAudit,
  saveBlobWithOptionalPicker,
} from '../../utils/reportExporters';
import { useTheme } from '../../context/ThemeContext';
import { useSchool } from '../../context/SchoolContext';
import { useAlert } from '../../context/AlertContext';
import type { PageSetupConfig } from '../../types/pageSetup';
import { Calendar, RefreshCw, Search } from 'lucide-react';

export interface MetricTriplet {
  m: number;
  f: number;
  total: number;
}

export interface SF4SectionRecord {
  section_id: number | string;
  section_name: string;
  grade_level: string;
  adviser_name: string;
  registered_end: MetricTriplet;
  daily_average: MetricTriplet;
  attendance_percentage: MetricTriplet;
  dropped_out_prev: MetricTriplet;
  dropped_out_month: MetricTriplet;
  dropped_out_cumulative: MetricTriplet;
  transferred_out_prev: MetricTriplet;
  transferred_out_month: MetricTriplet;
  transferred_out_cumulative: MetricTriplet;
  transferred_in_prev: MetricTriplet;
  transferred_in_month: MetricTriplet;
  transferred_in_cumulative: MetricTriplet;
}

export interface SF4GradeGroup {
  grade_level: string;
  sections: SF4SectionRecord[];
  subtotal: SF4SectionRecord;
}

export interface SF4ReportData {
  school_id: string;
  school_name: string;
  region: string;
  division: string;
  district: string;
  school_year: string;
  month: string;
  year: number;
  school_head: string;
  school_address?: string;
  school_contact?: string;
  school_email?: string;
  left_logo?: string | null;
  right_logo?: string | null;
  school_logo?: string | null;
  grade_groups: SF4GradeGroup[];
  non_graded_summary: SF4SectionRecord | null;
  total_summary: SF4SectionRecord;
}

interface SF4PageChunk {
  pageNumber: number;
  totalPages: number;
  groups: SF4GradeGroup[];
  isFinalPage: boolean;
}

export interface SF4ReportTabProps {
  activeReportId?: string;
  onSelectReport?: (reportId: string) => void;
}

const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'January',
  'February',
  'March',
  'April',
  'May',
  'June',
  'July',
  'August',
  'September',
  'October',
  'November',
  'December',
];

const getDynamicSchoolYear = (): string => {
  const now = new Date();
  const y = now.getFullYear();
  return now.getMonth() >= 5 ? `${y}-${y + 1}` : `${y - 1}-${y}`;
};

const sanitizeSearchText = (raw: string): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, 80);

export const SF4ReportTab: React.FC<SF4ReportTabProps> = ({
  activeReportId = 'sf4',
  onSelectReport,
}) => {
  const { tokens, brand } = useTheme();
  const { school: globalSchool } = useSchool();
  const { showAlert } = useAlert();

  const now = useMemo(() => new Date(), []);
  const yearOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const cur = now.getFullYear();
    return [cur - 1, cur, cur + 1];
  }, [now]);

  const [schoolYearOptions, setSchoolYearOptions] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedAcademicYear, setSelectedAcademicYear] = useState<string>(
    () => globalSchool.academic_year || getDynamicSchoolYear()
  );
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState<string>(
    () => MONTH_NAMES[now.getMonth()] || 'October'
  );
  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState<number>(now.getFullYear());
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');

  const [reportData, setReportData] = useState<SF4ReportData | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isExportingPdf, setIsExportingPdf] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isPrinting, setIsPrinting] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const [auditMeta, setAuditMeta] = useState(() => buildAuditStamp('SF4'));
  const [pageConfig, setPageConfig] = useState<PageSetupConfig>(DEFAULT_DEPED_LANDSCAPE_SETUP);
  const [isPageSetupOpen, setIsPageSetupOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const reportRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);

  const { widthIn: pageWidthInches, heightIn: pageHeightInches } = useMemo(
    () => resolvePaperDimensionsInches(pageConfig),
    [pageConfig]
  );

  const refreshAuditMeta = useCallback(() => {
    const next = buildAuditStamp('SF4', reportData?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
    setAuditMeta(next);
    return next;
  }, [reportData?.school_id, globalSchool.school_id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    apiClient
      .get(API_ROUTES.school.schoolYears, { signal: controller.signal })
      .then((res) => {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        const list = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data?.results || [];
        const codes = list
          .map((item: any) => (typeof item === 'string' ? item : item?.code || item?.name || ''))
          .filter(Boolean);
        setSchoolYearOptions(codes);
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, []);

  const availableSchoolYears = useMemo(
    () =>
      Array.from(
        new Set(
          [
            ...schoolYearOptions,
            reportData?.school_year,
            globalSchool.academic_year,
            selectedAcademicYear,
            getDynamicSchoolYear(),
          ].filter(Boolean)
        )
      ) as string[],
    [schoolYearOptions, reportData?.school_year, globalSchool.academic_year, selectedAcademicYear]
  );

  const fetchSF4 = useCallback(
    async (silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const baseParams = {
        month: selectedMonth,
        year: selectedYear,
        school_year: selectedAcademicYear,
      };
      const warmHit = !bypassCache
        ? peekApiCache<SF4ReportData>(API_ROUTES.reports.sf4, baseParams)
        : undefined;

      if (warmHit) {
        setReportData(warmHit);
        setLoading(false);
        if (silent) setRefreshing(true);
      } else if (!silent) {
        setLoading(true);
      } else {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }
      setError(null);

      try {
        const res = await apiClient.get<SF4ReportData>(API_ROUTES.reports.sf4, {
          params: bypassCache ? { ...baseParams, nocache: 1 } : baseParams,
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;
        setReportData(res.data);
        const stamp = buildAuditStamp('SF4', res.data?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id);
        setAuditMeta(stamp);
        void logOfficialReportAudit({
          reportName: 'SF4',
          trackingId: stamp.trackingId,
          printedAt: stamp.printedAt,
          action: 'VIEW',
        });
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };
        if (controller.signal.aborted || anyErr?.name === 'CanceledError' || anyErr?.code === 'ERR_CANCELED') {
          return;
        }
        if (!silent) {
          setError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not load DepEd SF4 School Summary Report.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (!controller.signal.aborted) {
          setLoading(false);
          setRefreshing(false);
        }
      }
    },
    [selectedMonth, selectedYear, selectedAcademicYear, globalSchool.school_id]
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    void fetchSF4(false, false);
    return () => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
    };
  }, [fetchSF4]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforePrint = () => {
      refreshAuditMeta();
      setIsPrinting(true);
    };
    const handleAfterPrint = () => {
      setIsPrinting(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
    window.addEventListener('afterprint', handleAfterPrint);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
      window.removeEventListener('afterprint', handleAfterPrint);
    };
  }, [refreshAuditMeta]);

  const filteredGradeGroups = useMemo(() => {
    const groups = Array.isArray(reportData?.grade_groups) ? reportData!.grade_groups : [];
    const q = sanitizeSearchText(searchQuery).toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return groups;

    return groups
      .map((g) => ({
        ...g,
        sections: (g.sections || []).filter(
          (s) =>
            s.section_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            s.adviser_name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
            s.grade_level.toLowerCase().includes(q)
        ),
      }))
      .filter((g) => g.sections.length > 0 || g.grade_level.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }, [reportData, searchQuery]);

  const paginatedPages = useMemo<SF4PageChunk[]>(() => {
    if (pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless' || filteredGradeGroups.length === 0) {
      return [{ pageNumber: 1, totalPages: 1, groups: filteredGradeGroups, isFinalPage: true }];
    }

    const printableHeight = Math.max(
      3.5,
      pageHeightInches - (pageConfig.margins.top || 0.25) - (pageConfig.margins.bottom || 0.25)
    );
    const rowH = 0.22;
    const totalRows = filteredGradeGroups.reduce(
      (acc, g) => acc + (g.sections.length > 0 ? g.sections.length + 1 : 1),
      3
    );

    if (totalRows * rowH + 3.6 <= printableHeight) {
      return [{ pageNumber: 1, totalPages: 1, groups: filteredGradeGroups, isFinalPage: true }];
    }

    const rawPages: Array<{ groups: SF4GradeGroup[] }> = [];
    let currentGroups: SF4GradeGroup[] = [];
    let currentRows = 0;

    filteredGradeGroups.forEach((grp) => {
      const grpRows = grp.sections.length > 0 ? grp.sections.length + 1 : 1;
      const cap = rawPages.length === 0 ? 18 : 26;
      if (currentRows + grpRows <= cap || currentGroups.length === 0) {
        currentGroups.push(grp);
        currentRows += grpRows;
      } else {
        rawPages.push({ groups: currentGroups });
        currentGroups = [grp];
        currentRows = grpRows;
      }
    });

    if (currentGroups.length > 0) {
      rawPages.push({ groups: currentGroups });
    }

    const total = rawPages.length;
    return rawPages.map((p, idx) => ({
      pageNumber: idx + 1,
      totalPages: total,
      groups: p.groups,
      isFinalPage: idx === total - 1,
    }));
  }, [filteredGradeGroups, pageConfig, pageHeightInches]);

  const getBaseFilename = () => `DepEd_SF4_${reportData?.month || selectedMonth}_${selectedYear}`;

  const handleDirectPrint = () => {
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF4',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'PRINT',
    });
    setIsPrinting(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      window.print();
      setTimeout(() => setIsPrinting(false), 400);
    }, 180);
  };

  const handleExportPdf = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData || !reportRef.current) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF4',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'PDF',
    });

    setIsExportingPdf(true);
    setIsPrinting(true);
    try {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
      await exportElementToLocalPdf({
        element: reportRef.current,
        filename: `${getBaseFilename()}.pdf`,
        pageWidthInches,
        pageHeightInches,
        orientation: pageConfig.orientation,
        pageColor: pageConfig.pageColor,
        pageless: pageConfig.layoutMode === 'pageless',
        usePicker,
      });
    } catch {
      showAlert({
        title: 'Opening Print Dialog',
        message: 'Choose "Save as PDF" in your browser print dialog.',
        type: 'info',
      });
      handleDirectPrint();
    } finally {
      setIsPrinting(false);
      setIsExportingPdf(false);
    }
  };

  const buildCsvData = () => {
    if (!reportData) return { headers: [] as string[], rows: [] as Array<Array<string | number>> };
    const headers = [
      'Name of Adviser',
      'Grade Level',
      'Section',
      'Registered End M',
      'Registered End F',
      'Registered End T',
      'Daily Avg M',
      'Daily Avg F',
      'Daily Avg T',
      'Attendance % M',
      'Attendance % F',
      'Attendance % T',
      'Dropped Out Cum T',
      'Transferred Out Cum T',
      'Transferred In Cum T',
    ];
    const rows: Array<Array<string | number>> = [];
    filteredGradeGroups.forEach((grp) => {
      grp.sections.forEach((s) => {
        rows.push([
          s.adviser_name,
          s.grade_level,
          s.section_name,
          s.registered_end.m,
          s.registered_end.f,
          s.registered_end.total,
          s.daily_average.m,
          s.daily_average.f,
          s.daily_average.total,
          s.attendance_percentage.m,
          s.attendance_percentage.f,
          s.attendance_percentage.total,
          s.dropped_out_cumulative.total,
          s.transferred_out_cumulative.total,
          s.transferred_in_cumulative.total,
        ]);
      });
    });
    return { headers, rows };
  };

  const handleExportCsv = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF4',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'CSV',
    });
    const { headers, rows } = buildCsvData();
    const filename = `${getBaseFilename()}.csv`;

    if (usePicker) {
      const escapeCell = (val: unknown) => `"${String(val ?? '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
      const csvString =
        '\uFEFF' + [headers.map(escapeCell).join(','), ...rows.map((r) => r.map(escapeCell).join(','))].join('\r\n');
      const blob = new Blob([csvString], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
      await saveBlobWithOptionalPicker(blob, filename, 'text/csv', 'csv', 'CSV Spreadsheet (*.csv)');
    } else {
      exportToCsv(filename, headers, rows);
    }
  };

  const handleExportExcel = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData || !reportRef.current) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF4',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'EXCEL',
    });
    await exportElementToExcel(reportRef.current, getBaseFilename(), meta, usePicker);
  };

  const handleExportWord = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData || !reportRef.current) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF4',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'WORD',
    });
    await exportElementToWord(reportRef.current, getBaseFilename(), meta, usePicker);
  };

  const handleExportJson = async (usePicker = false) => {
    if (!reportData) return;
    const meta = refreshAuditMeta();
    void logOfficialReportAudit({
      reportName: 'SF4',
      trackingId: meta.trackingId,
      printedAt: meta.printedAt,
      action: 'JSON',
    });
    await exportReportJson(getBaseFilename(), meta, reportData, usePicker);
  };

  const renderTripletCells = (triplet?: MetricTriplet) => (
    <>
      <td style={tdNum}>{triplet ? triplet.m : 0}</td>
      <td style={tdNum}>{triplet ? triplet.f : 0}</td>
      <td style={tdNumBold}>{triplet ? triplet.total : 0}</td>
    </>
  );

  const renderSectionMetricCols = (rec?: SF4SectionRecord | null) => (
    <>
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.registered_end)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.daily_average)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.attendance_percentage)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.dropped_out_prev)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.dropped_out_month)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.dropped_out_cumulative)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.transferred_out_prev)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.transferred_out_month)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.transferred_out_cumulative)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.transferred_in_prev)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.transferred_in_month)}
      {renderTripletCells(rec?.transferred_in_cumulative)}
    </>
  );

  const schoolName = reportData?.school_name || globalSchool.school_name || '';
  const schoolId = reportData?.school_id || globalSchool.school_id || '';
  const schoolHead = reportData?.school_head || globalSchool.principal_name || '';

  return (
    <div
      className="report-tab-root"
      style={{
        display: 'flex',
        flexDirection: 'column',
        width: '100%',
        height: '100%',
        backgroundColor: tokens.bgApp,
      }}
    >
      <div className="no-print">
        <ReportHeaderBar
          activeReportId={activeReportId}
          onSelectReport={onSelectReport}
          documentTitle={
            reportData
              ? `SF4_Movement_Attendance_${reportData.month}_${reportData.year}`
              : 'DepEd_SF4_Monthly_Movement'
          }
          subtitle="Official DepEd School Form 4 (SF4) Monthly Learner's Movement and Attendance"
          isSavingPdf={isExportingPdf}
          onOpenPageSetup={() => setIsPageSetupOpen(true)}
          onPrint={handleDirectPrint}
          onSavePdf={() => void handleExportPdf(false)}
          onSavePdfAs={() => void handleExportPdf(true)}
          onDownloadExcel={() => void handleExportExcel(false)}
          onSaveExcelAs={() => void handleExportExcel(true)}
          onDownloadCsv={() => void handleExportCsv(false)}
          onSaveCsvAs={() => void handleExportCsv(true)}
          onDownloadWord={() => void handleExportWord(false)}
          onSaveWordAs={() => void handleExportWord(true)}
          onDownloadJson={() => void handleExportJson(false)}
          onSaveJsonAs={() => void handleExportJson(true)}
        />
      </div>

      <ReportViewerShell
        loading={loading}
        loadingMessage="Consolidating Official DepEd SF4 Summary..."
        error={error}
        hasData={Boolean(reportData)}
        isPrinting={isPrinting}
        isExportingPdf={isExportingPdf}
        pageWidthInches={pageWidthInches}
        pageHeightInches={pageHeightInches}
        pageConfig={pageConfig}
        sheetClassName="sf4-sheet-page"
        documentId="sf4-official-document"
        reportRef={reportRef}
        leftToolbarContent={
          <>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>SY:</span>
              <select
                aria-label="Select School Year"
                value={selectedAcademicYear}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedAcademicYear(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  padding: '5px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgInput,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                }}
              >
                {availableSchoolYears.map((sy) => (
                  <option key={sy} value={sy}>
                    {sy}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
              <Calendar size={15} color={brand.primary} />
              <select
                aria-label="Select Month"
                value={selectedMonth}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedMonth(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  padding: '5px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgInput,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                }}
              >
                {MONTH_NAMES.map((m) => (
                  <option key={m} value={m}>
                    {m}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>

              <select
                aria-label="Select Year"
                value={selectedYear}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedYear(Number(e.target.value))}
                style={{
                  padding: '5px 10px',
                  borderRadius: 6,
                  fontSize: '0.80rem',
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                  backgroundColor: tokens.bgInput,
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                }}
              >
                {yearOptions.map((y) => (
                  <option key={y} value={y}>
                    {y}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <div
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '4px 10px',
                borderRadius: 6,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgInput,
              }}
            >
              <Search size={13} color={tokens.textMuted} />
              <input
                type="text"
                maxLength={80}
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search section or adviser..."
                style={{
                  border: 'none',
                  outline: 'none',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  color: tokens.textPrimary,
                  fontSize: '0.78rem',
                  width: 155,
                }}
              />
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => void fetchSF4(true, true)}
              disabled={loading || refreshing}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                gap: 6,
                padding: '5px 10px',
                borderRadius: 6,
                fontSize: '0.76rem',
                fontWeight: 700,
                cursor: 'pointer',
                backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                border: `1px solid ${tokens.borderStrong}`,
                color: tokens.textPrimary,
              }}
            >
              <RefreshCw size={13} className={refreshing ? 'animate-spin' : ''} />
              <span>Refresh</span>
            </button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {reportData &&
          paginatedPages.map((page) => (
            <div
              key={`sf4-page-${page.pageNumber}`}
              className="sf4-sheet-page"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: pageConfig.pageColor || '#ffffff',
                color: '#000000',
                width: isPrinting ? '100%' : `${pageWidthInches}in`,

type ModalFormTab = 'BASIC' | 'ADDRESS' | 'PARENTS' | 'DEPED';

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 150): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const maskQrToken = (token?: string): string => {
  const clean = String(token || '').trim();
  if (!clean) return '';
  return clean.length <= 4 ? 'Linked' : `••••${clean.slice(-4)}`;
};

      }
    } catch {

  const loadStudents = useCallback(
    async (page: number, size: number, silent = false, bypassCache = false) => {
      abortRef.current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      abortRef.current = controller;

      const isAll = size >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE;
      const baseParams: Record<string, string | number> = {

      };
      if (debouncedSearch) baseParams.search = debouncedSearch;

          setTotalCount(Number(cached.count) || 0);
        } else if (Array.isArray(cached)) {
          setStudents(cached);
          setTotalCount(cached.length);
        }
        setLoading(false);
      } else if (!silent) {

          setStudents(res.data.results);

        }
      } catch (err: unknown) {
        const anyErr = err as { name?: string; code?: string };

      } finally {

      }
    },

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (!isInteracting.current && document.visibilityState === 'visible') {
        void loadStudents(currentPage, pageSize, true, true);
        void loadMetrics(true);
      }
    }, 20000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [currentPage, pageSize, loadStudents, loadMetrics]);

  const modalAvailableSections = useMemo(() => {
    if (!formData.grade_level_id) return sections;
    return sections.filter((sec) => {
      const glId =
        typeof sec.grade_level === 'object' && sec.grade_level !== null ? sec.grade_level.id : sec.grade_level;
      return String(glId) === String(formData.grade_level_id);
    });
  }, [sections, formData.grade_level_id]);

  const handleCopy = async (val: string) => {
    if (!val) return;
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(val);
      setCopiedValue(val);
      if (copyTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(copyTimerRef.current);
      copyTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setCopiedValue((prev) => (prev === val ? null : prev));
        copyTimerRef.current = null;
      }, 2000);
    } catch {
      // Ignore clipboard failure
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadCsvTemplate = () => {
    exportToCsv(
      'AttendSure_ClassList_Import_Template.csv',
      [
        'lrn',
        'first_name',
        'middle_name',
        'last_name',
        'suffix',
        'sex',
        'birthdate',
        'section_name',
        'grade_level',
        'parent_contact',
        'barangay',
        'municipality_city',
        'province',
      ],
      [
        [
          '128936000001',
          'FirstName',
          'MiddleName',
          'LastName',
          '',
          'Male',
          '2012-06-15',
          sections[0]?.name || 'SectionA',
          sections[0]?.grade_level_name || 'Grade 7',
          '09170000000',
          'BarangayName',
          'CityName',
          'ProvinceName',
        ],
      ]
    );
  };

  const handleOpenCsvImport = () => {
    setCsvFile(null);
    setImportSummary(null);
    setImportError(null);
    setImportDefaultSectionId(selectedSectionFilter !== 'ALL' ? selectedSectionFilter : '');
    setAutoCreateSections(true);
    setIsImportModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleRunCsvImport = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setImportError(null);
    setImportSummary(null);

    if (!csvFile) {
      setImportError('Please select a .csv class list file first.');
      return;
    }
    if (!csvFile.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv')) {
      setImportError('Only .csv spreadsheet files are accepted.');
      return;
    }
    if (csvFile.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      setImportError('CSV file must be 5 MB or smaller.');
      return;
    }

    setImportingCsv(true);
    try {
      const payload = new FormData();
      payload.append('file', csvFile);
      if (importDefaultSectionId) {
        payload.append('section_id', importDefaultSectionId);
      }
      payload.append('auto_create_sections', String(autoCreateSections));

      const res = await apiClient.post<CsvImportSummary>(API_ROUTES.students.bulkImport, payload, {
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' },
      });
      setImportSummary(res.data);
      loadAcademicLookups();
      await loadMetrics(true);
      await loadStudents(1, pageSize, false, true);
      setCurrentPage(1);
    } catch (err) {
      setImportError(extractApiError(err, 'Could not import CSV class list.'));
    } finally {
      setImportingCsv(false);
    }
  };

  const handleExportCsv = async () => {
    setIsExporting(true);
    try {
      const params: Record<string, string | number> = { page_size: 'ALL' };
      if (debouncedSearch) params.search = debouncedSearch;
      if (selectedSectionFilter !== 'ALL') params.section_id = selectedSectionFilter;

      const res = await apiClient.get(API_ROUTES.students.list, { params });
      const list: Student[] = Array.isArray(res.data) ? res.data : res.data?.results || [];

      exportToCsv(
        `AttendSure_Students_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`,
        [
          'LRN',
          'Full Name',
          'Sex',
          'Birthdate',
          'Class Section',
          'QR Card Status',
          'Parent Contact',
          'Father Name',
          'Mother Maiden Name',
          'Barangay',
          'Municipality / City',
          'Status',
        ],
        list.map((s) => [
          s.lrn,
          s.full_name || `${s.last_name}, ${s.first_name}`,
          s.sex || '',
          s.birthdate || '',
          s.current_section || 'Unassigned',
          s.qr_token ? 'Linked' : 'Not Linked',
          s.parent_contact || '',
          s.father_name || '',
          s.mother_maiden_name || '',
          s.barangay || '',
          s.municipality_city || '',
          s.is_active ? 'ACTIVE' : 'INACTIVE',
        ])
      );
    } catch (err) {
      showAlert({ title: 'Export Failed', message: extractApiError(err), type: 'error' });
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const handlePhotoUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
      setFormError('Please upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP photo.');
      return;
    }
    if (file.size > 2.5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      setFormError('Photo size must be 2.5 MB or smaller.');
      return;
    }
    setFormError(null);
    setPhotoRemoved(false);
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onloadend = () => {
      const result = typeof reader.result === 'string' ? reader.result : '';
      if (!isSafeImageUrl(result)) {
        setFormError('Selected file is not a valid image.');
        return;
      }
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, photo: result }));
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setEditingStudent(null);
    setFormError(null);
    setPhotoRemoved(false);
    setFormTab('BASIC');
    setFormData({
      lrn: '',
      first_name: '',
      middle_name: '',
      last_name: '',
      suffix: '',
      sex: 'Male',
      birthdate: '2012-01-01',
      grade_level_id: gradeLevels[0] ? String(gradeLevels[0].id) : '',
      section_id: '',
      qr_token: '',
      photo: null,
      house_street_sitio: '',
      barangay: '',
      municipality_city: '',
      province: '',
      father_name: '',
      mother_maiden_name: '',
      guardian_name: '',
      guardian_relationship: 'Mother',
      parent_contact: '',
      mother_tongue: '',
      ethnic_group: '',
      religion: '',
    });
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (st: Student) => {
    setEditingStudent(st);
    setFormError(null);
    setPhotoRemoved(false);
    setFormTab('BASIC');

    const exactSecId = st.current_section_id ?? st.section_id;
    const matchedSec =
      (exactSecId ? sections.find((s) => s.id === exactSecId) : undefined) ||
      sections.find((s) => s.name === st.current_section);
    const glVal =
      matchedSec && typeof matchedSec.grade_level === 'object' && matchedSec.grade_level !== null
        ? matchedSec.grade_level.id
        : matchedSec?.grade_level;

    setFormData({
      lrn: st.lrn || '',
      first_name: st.first_name || '',
      middle_name: st.middle_name || '',
      last_name: st.last_name || '',
      suffix: st.suffix || '',
      sex: st.sex === 'Female' || st.sex === 'F' ? 'Female' : 'Male',
      birthdate: st.birthdate || '2012-01-01',
      grade_level_id: glVal ? String(glVal) : gradeLevels[0] ? String(gradeLevels[0].id) : '',
      section_id: exactSecId ? String(exactSecId) : matchedSec ? String(matchedSec.id) : '',
      qr_token: '',
      photo: isSafeImageUrl(st.photo_url || st.photo) ? st.photo_url || st.photo || null : null,
      house_street_sitio: st.house_street_sitio || '',
      barangay: st.barangay || '',
      municipality_city: st.municipality_city || '',
      province: st.province || '',
      father_name: st.father_name || '',
      mother_maiden_name: st.mother_maiden_name || '',
      guardian_name: st.guardian_name || '',
      guardian_relationship: st.guardian_relationship || 'Mother',
      parent_contact: st.parent_contact || '',
      mother_tongue: st.mother_tongue || '',
      ethnic_group: st.ethnic_group || '',
      religion: st.religion || '',
    });
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFormError(null);

    if (formData.lrn.trim().length !== 12) {
      setFormError('LRN must be 12 digits.');
      setFormTab('BASIC');
      return;
    }
    if (!formData.first_name.trim() || !formData.last_name.trim()) {
      setFormError('First name and last name are required.');
      setFormTab('BASIC');
      return;
    }
    if (!formData.section_id) {
      setFormError('Please select a class section.');
      setFormTab('BASIC');
      return;
    }

    const cleanParentPhone = formData.parent_contact.trim().replace(/[\s-]/g, '');
    if (!cleanParentPhone) {
      setFormError('Parent mobile number is required in the "3. Guardian" tab.');
      setFormTab('PARENTS');
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
        lrn: formData.lrn.trim(),
        first_name: sanitizeInput(formData.first_name, 100),
        middle_name: sanitizeInput(formData.middle_name, 100),
        last_name: sanitizeInput(formData.last_name, 100),
        suffix: sanitizeInput(formData.suffix, 20),
        sex: formData.sex,
        birthdate: formData.birthdate,
        mother_tongue: sanitizeInput(formData.mother_tongue, 80),
        ethnic_group: sanitizeInput(formData.ethnic_group, 80),
        religion: sanitizeInput(formData.religion, 80),
        house_street_sitio: sanitizeInput(formData.house_street_sitio, 150),
        barangay: sanitizeInput(formData.barangay, 100),
        municipality_city: sanitizeInput(formData.municipality_city, 100),
        province: sanitizeInput(formData.province, 100),
        father_name: sanitizeInput(formData.father_name, 150),
        mother_maiden_name: sanitizeInput(formData.mother_maiden_name, 150),
        guardian_name: sanitizeInput(formData.guardian_name, 150),
        guardian_relationship: sanitizeInput(formData.guardian_relationship, 60),
        parent_contact: sanitizeInput(cleanParentPhone, 20),
        section_id: Number(formData.section_id),
      };

      if (formData.photo && formData.photo.startsWith('data:image/') && isSafeImageUrl(formData.photo)) {
        payload.photo = formData.photo;
      } else if (photoRemoved && editingStudent) {
        payload.photo = null;
        payload.remove_photo = true;
      }

      if (editingStudent) {
        await apiClient.patch(`${API_ROUTES.students.list}${editingStudent.id}/`, payload);
        showAlert({ title: 'Student Updated', message: 'Student profile saved.', type: 'success' });
      } else {
        await apiClient.post(API_ROUTES.students.list, payload);
        showAlert({ title: 'Student Enrolled', message: 'New student enrolled successfully.', type: 'success' });
      }

      setIsModalOpen(false);
      await loadMetrics(true);
      await loadStudents(currentPage, pageSize, false, true);
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(extractApiError(err, 'Failed to save student record.'));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = (st: Student) => {
    showConfirm({
      title: 'Delete Student Record',
      message: `Permanently delete ${st.full_name} (LRN: ${st.lrn})?`,
      confirmLabel: 'Delete Student',
      isDestructive: true,
      onConfirm: async () => {
        try {
          await apiClient.delete(`${API_ROUTES.students.list}${st.id}/`);
          showAlert({ title: 'Student Removed', message: `${st.full_name} was removed from the class list.`, type: 'info' });
          await loadMetrics(true);
          await loadStudents(currentPage, pageSize, true, true);
        } catch (err) {
          showAlert({ title: 'Delete Failed', message: extractApiError(err, 'Could not delete student record.'), type: 'error' });
        }
      },
    });
  };

  const totalPages = pageSize >= ALL_ROWS_SIZE ? 1 : Math.max(1, Math.ceil(totalCount / pageSize));
  const activeSchoolName = school.school_name || 'Official Student Pass';

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 16, padding: 'clamp(12px, 2vw, 20px)' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 210px), 1fr))', gap: 12 }}>
        <StatsCard
          label="REGISTERED STUDENTS"
          value={metrics.total.toLocaleString()}
          helpText="Students in your accessible scope"
          badge={<GraduationCap size={18} color={brand.primary} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="ACTIVE CLASS LIST"
          value={metrics.active.toLocaleString()}
          valueColor={brand.success}
          helpText="Cleared for classroom QR scanning"
          badge={<User size={18} color={brand.success} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="QR CARDS LINKED"
          value={`${metrics.paired.toLocaleString()} / ${metrics.active.toLocaleString()}`}
          valueColor={brand.primary}
          helpText="Active signed QR tokens"
          badge={<CreditCard size={18} color={brand.primary} />}
        />
        <StatsCard
          label="CLASS SECTIONS"
          value={metrics.total_sections.toLocaleString()}
          valueColor={brand.secondary}
          helpText="Assigned active sections"
          badge={<BookOpen size={18} color={brand.secondary} />}
        />
      </div>

      <div
        style={{
          ...ui.card,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          alignItems: 'center',
          flexWrap: 'wrap',
          gap: 12,
          padding: '12px 16px',
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <select
            aria-label="Filter by class section"
            value={selectedSectionFilter}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setSelectedSectionFilter(e.target.value);
              setCurrentPage(1);
            }}
            style={{ ...ui.input, width: 'auto', minWidth: 220, fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer' }}
          >
            <option value="ALL">All Class Sections</option>
            {sections.map((sec) => (
              <option key={sec.id} value={sec.id}>
                {sec.grade_level_name ? `${sec.grade_level_name} - ` : ''}
                {sec.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>

          <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: 250 }}>
            <Search
              size={14}
              color={tokens.textMuted}
              style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 10, top: '50%', transform: 'translateY(-50%)' }}
            />
            <input
              type="text"
              maxLength={60}
              placeholder="Search student name or LRN..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              style={{ ...ui.input, paddingLeft: 32 }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleExportCsv}
            disabled={isExporting || totalCount === 0}
            style={ui.btnSecondary}
          >
            {isExporting ? <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Download size={14} />}
            <span>Export CSV ({totalCount.toLocaleString()})</span>
          </button>

          {canManageStudents && (
            <>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleOpenCsvImport}
                style={ui.btnSecondary}
              >
                <Upload size={14} color={brand.primary} />
                <span>Import CSV Class List</span>
              </button>

              <button type="button" onClick={handleOpenCreate} style={ui.btnPrimary}>
                <Plus size={15} />
                <span>Add Student</span>
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style={{ ...ui.card, padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        {error && (
          <div
            style={{
              ...ui.subtleBox,
              margin: 14,
              backgroundColor: tokens.dangerLight,
              borderColor: brand.danger,
              color: brand.danger,
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              gap: 8,
              fontWeight: 600,
            }}
          >
            <AlertCircle size={16} />
            <span>{error}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {loading ? (
          <div style={{ padding: 48, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            <Loader2 size={26} className="animate-spin" color={brand.primary} style={{ margin: '0 auto 8px', display: 'block' }} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.base, fontWeight: 600 }}>Loading student records...</span>
          </div>
        ) : students.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ padding: 48, textAlign: 'center', color: tokens.textMuted }}>
            <User size={36} style={{ margin: '0 auto 8px', display: 'block' }} />
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>No Students Found</div>
            <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.sm, marginTop: 2 }}>No student records match your current filter.</div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
            <table style={{ width: '100%', minWidth: 740, borderCollapse: 'collapse', textAlign: 'left' }}>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Student</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>LRN</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Class Section</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>QR ID Card</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Parent Contact</th>
                  <th style={ui.th}>Status</th>
                  <th style={{ ...ui.th, textAlign: 'right' }}>Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {students.map((row) => {
                  const fullName = row.full_name || `${row.first_name} ${row.last_name}`;
                  return (
                    <tr key={row.id}>
                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
                          <ProfileAvatar photoUrl={row.photo_url || row.photo} name={fullName} size={36} iconSize={17} />
                          <div>
                            <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>{fullName}</div>
                            <div style={{ fontSize: fonts.size.xs, color: tokens.textMuted }}>
                              {row.sex}
                              {row.grade_level_name ? ` • ${row.grade_level_name}` : ''}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <div
                          style={{
                            display: 'inline-flex',
                            alignItems: 'center',
                            gap: 6,
                            padding: '3px 8px',
                            backgroundColor: tokens.bgSurfaceSubtle,
                            borderWidth: 1,
                            borderStyle: 'solid',
                            borderColor: tokens.borderSubtle,
                            borderRadius: 6,
                            fontFamily: fonts.mono,
                            fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
                            fontWeight: 700,
                          }}
                        >
                          <span>{row.lrn}</span>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleCopy(row.lrn)}
                            title="Copy LRN"
                            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 0, display: 'flex' }}
                          >
                            {copiedValue === row.lrn ? (
                              <Check size={12} color={brand.success} />
                            ) : (
                              <Copy size={12} color={tokens.textMuted} />
                            )}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6, fontWeight: 700, color: tokens.textPrimary }}>
                          <BookOpen size={14} color={brand.primary} />
                          <span>{row.current_section || 'Unassigned'}</span>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        {row.qr_token ? (
                          <span
                            style={{
                              display: 'inline-flex',
                              alignItems: 'center',
                              gap: 5,
                              fontWeight: 700,
                              color: brand.success,
                              fontFamily: fonts.mono,
                              fontSize: fonts.size.sm,
                            }}
                          >
                            <CreditCard size={13} /> {maskQrToken(row.qr_token)}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, color: tokens.textMuted, fontSize: fonts.size.sm }}>
                            <CreditCard size={13} /> Not Linked
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5, fontSize: fonts.size.sm, color: tokens.textSecondary }}>
                          <Phone size={13} color={tokens.textMuted} /> {row.parent_contact || '—'}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td style={ui.td}>
                        <span style={ui.badge(row.is_active ? tokens.successLight : tokens.dangerLight, row.is_active ? brand.success : brand.danger)}>
                          {row.is_active ? 'ACTIVE' : 'INACTIVE'}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      <td style={{ ...ui.td, textAlign: 'right' }}>
                        <div style={{ display: 'inline-flex', gap: 6 }}>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setBadgeStudent(row)}
                            title="View / Print Student QR ID"
                            style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, padding: '6px 8px' }}
                          >
                            <QrCode size={14} color={brand.primary} />
                          </button>

                          {canManageStudents && (
                            <>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(row)}
                                title="Edit Student"
                                style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, padding: '6px 8px' }}
                              >
                                <Pencil size={14} color={brand.primary} />
                              </button>
                              <button
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => handleDelete(row)}
                                title="Delete Student"
                                style={{ ...ui.btnSecondary, padding: '6px 8px', color: brand.danger }}
                              >
                                <Trash2 size={14} />
                              </button>
                            </>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}

        <Pagination
          currentPage={currentPage}
          totalPages={totalPages}
          totalCount={totalCount}
          pageSize={pageSize}

const sanitizeInput = (raw: string, maxLength = 150): string =>
  String(raw || '')
    .replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F<>]/g, '')
    .trim()
    .slice(0, maxLength);

const extractUsers = (raw: unknown): SystemUser[] => {
  if (Array.isArray(raw)) return raw as SystemUser[];
  if (raw && typeof raw === 'object' && Array.isArray((raw as { results?: SystemUser[] }).results)) {
    return (raw as { results: SystemUser[] }).results;
  }
  return [];
};
